f455e17b.title: Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Senior Consultant
f455e17b.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Supply Chain – Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise technologies across supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and IT operations. As part of this team, you will work with clients to support large\-scale digital transformation by bringing together strategy, process design, and technology enablement. Deloitte’s practitioners combine industry knowledge with functional and technical experience to help organizations improve operations, enhance business performance, and navigate complex transformation journeys. Joining this team means collaborating with strategic advisors, solution architects, and delivery specialists focused on solving critical business challenges through Oracle Cloud\-enabled transformation.
   

  

**Level** 
 : Senior Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Supporting and optimizing Oracle Supply Chain Management modules, including Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, and Costing
* Participating in Oracle Supply Chain Management full\-cycle implementations, including requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, functional design, configuration, and testing
* Collaborating with client stakeholders to identify business process improvement opportunities and translate requirements into solution designs
* Supporting end\-to\-end business processes, including Order to Cash and Procure to Pay, to help drive operational efficiency
* Working across delivery teams to support execution, issue resolution, and quality delivery in onsite\-offshore environments


**The team**
 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
   

  

 The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience supporting Oracle Supply Chain Management modules, including Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, Work in Process, Advanced Pricing, Services, Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Costing
* 4\+ years of experience in Oracle Supply Chain Management full\-cycle implementations as a team member or lead
* Experience in requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, business process design, configuration, and testing
* Experience collaborating with clients on business process enhancements
* Experience supporting end\-to\-end Order to Cash and Procure to Pay cycles
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience leading an Oracle applications workstream
* Experience working in onsite\-offshore delivery models


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
   

  

 Requisition code: 351691

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Cloud Native Engineer who bridges the gap between infrastructure automation and cloud\-native application development. * **CI/CD \& Automation:** Design, build, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines across development, staging, and multi\-region production environments.

* **CI/CD Engineering:** Deep experience creating build/release automation across multi\-environment setups (using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, or Jenkins).

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect \- Azure \& Agentic AI Solutions**
*Architecture leadership for Azure deployment, agent design, orchestration and end\-to\-end solution flow*
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Lead Architect to define the target architecture for an enterprise\-grade procurement agentic AI solution. The role will determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, establish architecture principles and guardrails, and advise on agent architecture, orchestration patterns, integration design, and end\-to\-end solution flows. The Lead Architect will work closely with client technology stakeholders, the Solution Lead, AI/ML teams, data engineers, security teams and delivery leadership to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, operable and fit for enterprise deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end target architecture across data, AI/ML, GenAI, agent orchestration, APIs, integration, observability, security and user\-facing application layers.
* Assess client constraints and determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, including services for compute, storage, data processing, model serving, GenAI, integration, secrets, networking, monitoring and CI/CD.
* Define cloud deployment patterns across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent data platforms, AKS, Container Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid, Key Vault, Monitor and related services as appropriate.
* Advise on when to use agents, conventional services, rules engines, workflow orchestration, ML models, optimization services and event\-driven automation rather than forcing all use cases into an agent pattern.
* Translate business workflows into executable solution flows spanning sensing, signal processing, forecasting, recommendation, approval, action and traceability layers.
* Define API and integration architecture for interaction with enterprise source systems, planning tools, data platforms, UI applications, model endpoints and external services.
* Establish non\-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, latency, resilience, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, explainability, auditability and supportability.
* Define identity and access patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, data protection controls, content safety, prompt security and responsible AI controls in collaboration with client security teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical decision records and trade\-off discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.
* Own architecture alignment across environments including development, test, UAT, and production, with clear promotion, rollback and release patterns.
* Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
* Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
* Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud\-native integrations.
* Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
* Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Strong ability to communicate architecture trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real\-world constraints.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
* Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high\-tech industry solutions.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
* Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.


**Key Deliverables**
* Target\-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
* Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
* End\-to\-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
* Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
* Architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
* Production\-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.


**Key Success Metrics**
* Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late\-stage redesign.
* Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
* Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.
* Reduction in integration rework, deployment friction, technical debt and avoidable cloud cost.
* Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.


 If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

As Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll triage tickets, execute runbooks, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents inside the Support team, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support close at hand. If you want to learn AWS at a Tier 1 financial firm by running it for real with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands\-on mid\-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support LPL's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 production support for the AWS landing zone — the run\-the\-cloud function inside CCOE — alongside senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support. Day\-to\-day you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, execute and improve runbooks, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alert routing into ServiceNow and runbook execution, and you escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when the issue is beyond the Support team's remit. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on in tickets, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self\-service paths.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs: own the ticket end\-to\-end if it's Tier 1 / Tier 2 scope, and escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when it's not
* Fulfill account / IAM / access requests for the landing zone and actively turn the repeatable ones into self\-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Execute and improve runbooks for known incident classes; pair with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to feed incident lessons back into durable monitoring and runbook improvements
* Support change\-management execution: change\-window participation, ServiceNow change\-record discipline, and verification of changes against the affected accounts and workloads
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day\-to\-day support work: AI\-assisted ticket triage and routing, conversational self\-service for common account / IAM / access requests via MCP, runbook generation and lookup, and on\-call copilots that summarize recent telemetry and chat during incidents
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on experience working a production cloud operations or cloud support queue (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable ITSM): ticket triage SLAs, runbook execution, account / IAM / access\-request fulfillment, change\-window participation, and primary on\-call response


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate


 LPL Global Business Services, LLP \- PRIVACY POLICY

10b40875.title: Reconciliation Business Delivery Manager (Product Owner)
10b40875.description:
**Job Title:** 
 Reconciliation Business Delivery Manager (Product Owner)
   

  

**Department** 
 : CEFS\-Reconciliation
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The IT Reconciliations Department is managing the reconciliations (Financial, Referential, Systems to Systems, ...) for a number of BNP Paribas's domains (Global Markets, Global Banking, Security Services, Wealth Management, ...) via specialized expert systems (FIS DIM/Intellimatch, Pega PCM, Socrates). Our internal clients are working 24/7 at a worldwide level with a high level of reliability. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is the key partner in all IT functions and has interactions with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. To ensure our efficiency and alignment with the market expectations, we have to ensure that both our architecture and our technologies are up to date and aligned with the most efficient and reliable standards.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Business Delivery Manager within Reconciliation IT plays the role of expert (IT \& functional) to take charge of managing end to end value change, organization efficiency to lead our main teams and systems, managing the Group reconciliations at international level.
   

  

 Will actively participate to the consolidation of our current systems and structure base while being a source of propositions to lead the area. The position has a strong focus on stability, flexibility, and expertise to always guarantee the proper Clients’ expectations. Working in an international Clients base environment but also as part of an Offshore organization, the capacity to interact in a respectful and easy way with both his/her Clients, Management, and team to find compromises while guaranteeing the proper organization and seamless relations is a must.
   

  

 The key interactions are with the Project Sponsor, operations team, delivery teams. Working in a very quality oriented environment, the position requires Agile knowledge as well as Costs and Clients’ benefits concepts.
   

  

 This position requires strong leadership, communication, and adaptability to navigate the complexities of working in a globally distributed environment.
   

  

 The Business Delivery Manager shall also be in charge of upskilling his/her team in full alignment with the expected target organization where in which the Offshore team becomes more involved in critical projects lead in full autonomy whenever possible. This first part of his/her missions shall not exceed 3 to 4 years to enable stabilization of resources to secure efficiency and autonomy. He/She will own the complete product lifecycle – from vision and roadmap definition, through backlog grooming and agile delivery, to post‑release optimization – guaranteeing a best‑in‑class, secure user experience. The role requires tight collaboration with business, compliance, risk, UX, data‑analytics and infrastructure teams, and regular communication of progress, risks and outcomes to senior leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Takes responsibility of the teams, systems and domains he/she is in charge of,
* The capacity to lead multi\-skilled team members and stay focused on target is a necessary skill.
* Is involved to frame the project upfront, define the most adequate governance to lead the project to success.
* When relevant, consolidate the design solution to deliver with architects, with proper sign off from clients and relevant contributors.
* Ensure effective communication, continuous alignment of all the contributors and timely running of governance routines.
* Be a single point of contact for the clients and the central instances as well as manage the demand reception and comprehension/ challenging along with BOW
* Own and maintain the backlog and roadmaps for all products in the portfolio. Run regular grooming sessions with the stakeholders and development teams.
* Own, design, champion, and drive alignment on the to\-be vision for the portfolio.
* Work with the delivery leads for estimation and for prioritization along with clients based on capacity.
* Secure the staffing with the support of the of line managers and/or relevant governance body in charge of allocating resources.
* Ensures a respectful and efficient ambiance in his/her team,
* Has good relationships with Senior Management as he/she will have frequent Management meetings,
* Able to manage day to day task and accountable and responsible for deliveries from offshore.
* Ensures both the upskilling of his/her team to bring local autonomies on Projects Management as well as secures the enhanced skills of his/her team to reduce turnover.
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, demos and retrospectives while removing impediments to maintain delivery velocity.
* Orchestrate UAT, regression testing and production releases, maintaining release documentation, change‑control artefacts and post‑release monitoring.


**Contributing Responsibilities**
* Ensures seamless relations with his/her functional Management (Offshore)
* Gain an in\-depth understanding of projects and analyse customer expectations.
* Interact with functional and technical architects to design enterprise solutions.
* Be able to provide Project progress KPI, allowing to demonstrate adherence (or not) to initial plan
* Proactively propose and set\-up mitigation plans.
* Be capable of challenging a governance/organization in place if the audit of the project shows an opportunity to be more efficient.


**Specific Qualifications**
* At least 10 \- 12 years of Hands\-on work experience in an Enterprise environment, preferably working in multi\-location IT teams, with 5 yrs of experience in Product owner role
* A proven experience in multi\-expertise team management in an international environment,
* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,
* A very good English level is mandatory,
* Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field; Master’s degree or certifications such as CSPO, PMP, AWS, TOGAF are a plus.


**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
 Technical \& Soft Skills:
   

  

* Knowledge of Reconciliation, types of reconciliation, basic reconciliation reports and various applied for reconciliation setup etc
* Working knowledge of reconciliation tools like IntelliMatch, Duco, Gresham, TLM
* Agile Methodology,
* Budgets \& Projects Management,
* Capacity to structure, synthesize and summarize concepts,
* Resilience in a strong pressure environment,
* Strong track record in successful interactions with peers in a non\-hierarchical framework.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong communication and reporting skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and negotiation skills.
* Capacity to interact with senior members of the organization.
* Strong capacity to motivate his/her team for upskilling


**Behavioral Skills**
* End to end application tech \& functional ownership, maintain book of work, collaboration with global teams.
* Lead a team of developers and provide technical guidance, code review, and mentoring.
* Organized and delivery\-focused, with attention to detail.
* Solid work ethic, high level of motivation and resilience.
* Comfortable operating with a strong level of autonomy, self\-driven
* Showing strong leadership and assertiveness
* Strong empathy and people care.
* Coaching \& mentoring techniques


**Specific Qualifications (if Required)**
* Exposure to Banking domain is a plus
* Exposure to migrating legacy applications to latest tech stack
* Good to have exposure to cloud platforms, and containerization technologies.


**Location:** 
 Mumbai, Bengaluru (Preferred)
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is a top\-ranking bank in Europe with an international profile. It operates in 71 countries and has almost 199 000 employees. The Group ranks highly in its three core areas of activity: Domestic Markets and International Financial Services (whose retail banking networks and financial services are grouped together under Retail Banking \& Services) and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, centered on corporate and institutional clients. The Group helps all its clients (retail, associations, businesses, SMEs, large corporate and institutional) to implement their projects by providing them with services in financing, investment, savings and protection. In its Corporate \& Institutional Banking and International Financial Services activities, BNP Paribas enjoys leading positions in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas and has a solid and fast\-growing network in the Asia/Pacific region.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 6000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

83d4e70f.title: DCOS / DCIM Delivery Manager
83d4e70f.description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This is a global role requiring close collaboration across multiple regions and continents. The DCIM Delivery Manager coordinates multidisciplinary activities associated with the AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara Centers of Excellence, supporting pre‑commissioning and commissioning activities for Equinix critical infrastructure construction projects worldwide.
   

  

 The role is accountable for delivering DCIM and DCOS outcomes to operations at Ready for Service (RFS), ensuring solutions are implemented in line with Equinix global standards, with a strong focus on quality, consistency, and operational readiness.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 DCIM \& DCOS Delivery
   

  

* Lead DCIM and DCOS delivery for Equinix Global Data Center (GDC) projects
* Act as the primary point of contact for the Centers of Excellence on AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara platforms
* Partner with GOE to track product updates and ensure timely and appropriate adoption within GDC projects
* Design and implement new AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara solutions that improve business efficiency, data quality, and operational outcomes
* Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting assistance to the global DCOS Delivery team


 DCIM Integration \& Onboarding
   

  

* Develop and approve Data Center SmartView electrical hierarchies for DCIM onboarding
* Coordinate with DCOS System Integrators to:
+ Perform initial DCOS\-to\-DCIM asset synchronisation and review outcomes
+ Enable and validate data collection within DCIM
+ Conduct structured data sanity checks to ensure accuracy and completeness


 Validation \& Assurance
   

  

* Validate DCIM alarms in collaboration with site teams, System Integrators, and PSAE/Onboarding teams
* Verify WWDCIM integration configurations, ensuring all points are correctly mapped, and that system\-level calculations (including resiliency, utility power, and PUE) are accurate
* Confirm that Battery Monitoring Systems and Branch Circuit Monitoring (BCM) systems are fully operational prior to DCIM onboarding


 Project \& Commissioning Support
   

  

* Provide clear and structured briefings to stakeholders on DCIM prerequisites, commissioning requirements, and go‑live checklists from project initiation through completion
* Actively participate in DCIM commissioning activities, ensuring alignment with Equinix Global Standards and commissioning best practices
* Collaborate with DCOS DCIM Managers, Global Managers, and Regional Managers to ensure commissioning documentation meets both industry standards and Equinix requirements


 Tracking, Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Manage internal tools to track delivery progress against defined milestones
* Produce program‑level reporting, analytics, and performance metrics for stakeholders
* Maintain, continuously improve, and standardise DCIM commissioning procedures and standards
* Drive specification uplift initiatives related to General Commissioning where DCIM is in scope
* Track, report, and communicate DCIM delivery status across all assigned projects


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in data centre controls and automation, construction, operations, or facilities maintenance
* Strong engineering background within mission‑critical environments such as data centres, power generation, or oil \& gas facilities
* Demonstrated ability to research, evaluate, and apply new technologies, designs, and construction methodologies for critical infrastructure
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with structured data tools such as databases and reporting platforms
* Solid understanding of electrical, mechanical, and monitoring systems supporting critical infrastructure
* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast‑paced, global delivery environment
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience coordinating across cross‑functional and geographically distributed teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality outcomes under tight timelines


 This role is critical to ensuring DCIM and DCOS solutions are delivered to operations with zero open defects at RFS, supporting Equinix’s commitment to operational excellence and global consistency.
   

  

 Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
   

  

 Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

486bf1d2.title: Lead Customer Program Manager
486bf1d2.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

* Work Hours: 7:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Eastern business hours)\*\*


**Impact in this Role**
 At Fictiv/MISUMI Americas, we are building the operating system for custom mechanical parts and assembly \- enabling Fortune 500 companies to scale production across India, Mexico, China, and the US. We deliver highly complex, high\-quality hardware for autonomous vehicles, surgical systems, industrial robots, and beyond.
   

  

 The Lead Customer Program Manager is a people leader role within the Customer Program Management team. You will build, manage, and grow a team of CPMs who are responsible for owning customer programs and projects end\-to\-end \- from initial scoping and kickoff through delivery, escalation management, and long\-term account health.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of three disciplines: customer success, project management, and manufacturing expertise. Your team’s job is to be the trusted partner for our customers \- understanding their manufacturing needs deeply, keeping programs on track, and ensuring every commitment we make is one we keep. Your job as Lead CPM is to make sure your team does that exceptionally well, consistently.
   

  

 You will coach and develop your team, set standards for how programs are run and how customers are managed, resolve escalations, and partner cross\-functionally to remove blockers. You bring both the credibility of deep program management and manufacturing experience and the leadership maturity to develop others and elevate the team around you.
   

  

 You will report to the Manager of Customer Program Management. This role has a hybrid model (Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday in office, Thursday and Friday remote).
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Team Leadership \& People Management
* Directly manage a team of Customer Program Managers (Junior to Mid Level), owning their performance, development, and day\-to\-day effectiveness
* Set clear goals and performance expectations for each direct report; conduct regular 1:1s and formal reviews
* Build structured development plans for each team member, identifying skill gaps, creating growth opportunities, and actively coaching toward them with the goal of accelerating each individual's potential, not just managing their current performance
* Serve as the first line of escalation for your team: step in on complex programs, difficult customer situations, or cross\-functional blockers as needed
* Create and maintain onboarding frameworks, training materials, and capability\-building resources for new and growing CPMs
* Actively participate in recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding new team members as the team scales
* Foster a high\-accountability, high\-support team environment rooted in the MISUMI Americas values: Not Afraid to Fail, Empowerment, Open to Change, Speed / Bias Toward Action, and Grit
* Customer Program \& Project Oversight
* Maintain visibility across your team’s full portfolio of customer programs and projects \- monitoring health, tracking risks, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
* Set and uphold team standards for how programs are planned, communicated, and executed: scope management, change control, risk identification, and status reporting
* Step in directly on strategic, high\-complexity, or at\-risk customer accounts to guide recovery, lead customer conversations, or provide senior presence
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure smooth program onboarding, renewals, and escalation resolution
* Champion a consistent customer experience across the team \- ensuring customers always have a responsive, knowledgeable, proactive point of contact
* Customer Success \& Relationship Management
* Model and coach a customer success mindset within the team: proactive communication, anticipating needs, building trust, and driving long\-term account health
* Ensure the team is measuring the right things \- on\-time delivery, customer satisfaction, escalation rate, response time \- and improving over time
* Guide your team in navigating difficult customer conversations: how to deliver bad news, manage expectations, and turn friction into stronger relationships
* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders on key accounts; represent the CPM team in strategic customer interactions as needed
* Supply Chain \& Customer Operations
* Maintain a working understanding of supply chain operations \- supplier management, lead times, procurement constraints, and fulfillment workflows \- to help your team navigate program risks and set accurate customer expectations
* Oversee customer operations health across the portfolio: order management, delivery performance, issue resolution timelines, and escalation response
* Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality teams to resolve cross\-functional blockers affecting customer programs and ensure your team has the right internal connections to act effectively
* Coach your team to think beyond program execution \- understanding how supply chain and operational decisions upstream directly impact customer experience downstream
* Identify systemic supply chain or operations issues that recur across programs and work with leadership to address root causes, not just individual incidents
* Team Effectiveness \& Execution Consistency
* Stay close to how standards and tooling are evolving across the CPM team, and make sure your team is aligned, trained, and applying them consistently
* Own adoption. When new processes or tools are introduced, drive uptake within your team \- close gaps, address resistance, and follow through until it becomes standard practice
* Coach individuals toward stronger execution habits. Where gaps are recurring, treat them as a development opportunity before escalating
* Keep a pulse on execution quality across your team's programs and bring that ground\-level visibility into broader team conversations about what is working and what needs attention


**Experience**
**Required**
* 7–13 years of total work experience, with a minimum of 5 years managing customer\-facing programs or projects in a fast\-paced hardware product development or contract manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering required
* Minimum 2 years in a team lead, senior lead, or people management role with direct reports \- owning performance reviews, development plans, and day\-to\-day team management
* Proven track record of running complex, multi\-stakeholder customer programs end\-to\-end, with full accountability for scope, cost, timeline, and customer satisfaction
* Direct experience working with US\-based or European\-based customers from India on a US business hours schedule


**Preferred**
* Experience at a contract manufacturer, digital manufacturing platform, or hardware supply chain company
* Exposure to low\-volume / prototype builds and high\-mix, high\-velocity manufacturing environments
* Familiarity with the hardware product development lifecycle: EVT, DVT, PVT, MP
* Experience with CRM/ERP tools (Salesforce, Odoo), project management tools (Jira, Asana), and data platforms like Sigma


**Core Skills \& Competencies**
* People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and grow a team; sets clear expectations, holds accountability, invests in development, and creates a culture of performance and support
* Customer Success Mindset: Deep instinct for what makes customers stay, grow, and refer; coaches the team to be proactive, solutions\-oriented, and relationship\-driven
* Project \& Program Management: Strong command of program fundamentals \- scope, risk, timeline, change management \- and the ability to set and enforce standards across a team
* Manufacturing Expertise: Enough technical depth to guide the team through complex manufacturing decisions, support difficult customer conversations, and build credibility with engineering and operations
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English; able to communicate at the right level for the audience \- from a customer VP to a junior CPM to an internal engineering team
* Judgment \& Escalation: Knows when to delegate, when to coach, and when to step in directly; trusted by the team and by leadership to make the right call

26b49622.title: Technical account manager
26b49622.description:
**About Refold**
 Refold is building the next\-generation AI platform that replaces enterprise integration and consultants. We're pioneering autonomous AI agents that understand complex enterprise systems, generate production\-ready code, and operate at a scale no consulting firm can match. Today, we're starting with integrations—a $50 B market. Tomorrow, we're building towards a world where AI agents handle any complex cognitive work.
   

  

 Traction: Serving 20\+ enterprise customers with Fortune 500 deployments, processing 10 M\+ API calls/day. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia \& Abhishek Kumar, who sold their previous startup to Netmeds; they have also been featured in Forbes 30 under 30\. They have experience at organisations such as Nomura, Jio Mart, Insta Mojo, IIT Kharagpur, and IIT Roorkee. We are funded by marquee investors, including Eniac Ventures, Tidal Ventures, Karman Ventures, Ahead VC \& Better Capital.
   

  

 We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Enterprise Delivery Lead is the single point of contact who owns the customer journey from kickoff to go\-live and beyond, as the steward of account health, adoption, and success. Sitting at the intersection of program management, customer success, and technical account management, you orchestrate complex, AI\-native integration delivery so customers don't just go live — they adopt, expand, and succeed.
   

  

 You're technical enough to lead the conversation and run technical account management. Your edge is exceptional communication and structured program management. You own onboarding, scoping, planning, adoption, and escalations; partner with the Architects and FDEs who build, and surface expansion signals to the Growth team. We're looking for an outstanding communicator and program manager who thrives in ambiguity and holds the business and technical picture at once.
   

  

 Team: Small, high\-impact delivery team working closely with Architects, Engineers, Product Support, and Founders. You own: Onboarding, scoping, project planning, implementation, adoption, success, escalations, and account health. You'll work with: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 and high\-growth Saa S companies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Own Enterprise Delivery \- Own the enterprise relationship from kick\-off to go\-live \& beyond — managing expectations and maintaining executive alignment. Think like a strategic advisor. Challenge assumptions, pressure\-test what was scoped, and recommend the approach that actually solves the customer's core business problem — not just the one that was asked for. Lead onboarding and scoping. Run post\-sales discovery and alignment workshops to refine requirements, success metrics, and a delivery plan that survives contact with the customer's real systems. Own planning and execution. Plan and manage implementation phases, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication across multiple concurrent engagements. Drive adoption and value realisation. Make sure delivered integrations are actually adopted and track the outcomes that matter, against a clear account\-health framework. Drive expansion and product direction \- Spot and surface expansion opportunities to the growth team, relay customer feedback and platform gaps to Product and Engineering.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Abilities**
 5–8 years in technology consulting, solution delivery, program management, customer success, or technical account management. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management — this is the core of the role. You build trust and drive alignment with everyone from engineers to C\-level executives. Strong, structured program and project management across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements — milestones, dependencies, risks, and crisp status communication. A success\-and\-adoption mindset — you measure yourself by whether the customer adopts, expands usage, and realises value, not just whether the project shipped. Enough technical fluency to lead integration discussions, run technical account management, and challenge assumptions — you don't need to write code, and you have the Architects as your technical depth. A structured thinker who's comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex enterprise environments. A track record of building long\-term, trusted relationships through clarity, confidence, and results.
   

  

**Nice To Have**
 Familiarity with AI / agentic concepts and how AI\-native integration platforms deliver value. Solid understanding of enterprise integrations, workflows, or automation platforms. Experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, or Workday. Familiarity with i Paa S or workflow automation platforms (Workato, Boomi, Mule Soft, Zapier, Merge). Background in management consulting, digital transformation, or business systems analysis. Startup or early\-stage company experience.
   

  

 Why Join Refold AI?
   

  

 Fast\-growing seed\-stage company (raised $6\.5 M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) Founding team opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from day one Cutting\-edge AI \+ infrastructure tech solving complex, high\-value enterprise problems Early traction with Fortune 500 clients and high\-growth software companies Direct line of sight to leadership and future engineering management path Work with a small, exceptional team that ships fast and celebrates bold ideas
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.

9fe443d6.title: Principal Program Manager
9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

68dc8470.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
68dc8470.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

* As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Qualys, you will drive the execution of complex, cross\-functional programs at the intersection of Threat Research, Product, and Platform Engineering. You will own end\-to\-end program delivery, translate deep technical work into measurable business outcomes, and ensure operational excellence in a high\-velocity cybersecurity environment.


 This role demands strong technical acumen, rigorous execution discipline, and the ability to influence across engineering, research, and executive leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Planning \& Execution**
* Define program scope, success criteria, and dependencies; create and execute detailed quarterly and multi\-quarter program plans.
* Drive on\-time delivery of complex technical initiatives across research, engineering, and platform teams.
* Own program governance, milestone tracking, and execution cadence, including sprint planning and reviews.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Act as the primary interface (“API”) between Threat Research, Product Management, Platform Engineering, and Executive stakeholders.
* Identify downstream dependencies early, negotiate timelines, and resolve conflicts to prevent execution bottlenecks.
* Hold engineering and research teams accountable to commitments while fostering strong collaboration and trust.
* Risk, Dependency \& Incident Management
* Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks; define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Translate technical blockers and security risks into clear business impact statements for leadership and product stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness in high\-pressure environments such as SOC, Threat Research, or Incident Response operations.
* Technical Ownership \& Domain Expertise
* Own and manage the Threat Research execution queue, ensuring alignment with product and platform priorities.
* Apply a strong understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape, including CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploit maturity (PoC vs. weaponized exploits), and vulnerability lifecycle.
* Ensure seamless handoff of research outputs into productization and engineering workflows.
* Metrics, Dashboards \& Reporting
* Define and track KPIs to measure program health, delivery performance, risk posture, and operational efficiency.
* Design, script, and maintain automated dashboards using tools such as JIRA, Salesforce, Tableau, APIs, SQL, or Python.
* Deliver clear, data\-driven insights to technical teams and executive leadership.
* Process Excellence \& Tooling
* Configure, maintain, and optimize program management tools (JIRA, Salesforce, Confluence) to support scalable execution.
* Drive continuous improvement of workflows, operating models, and Agile practices to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Own the team’s information architecture in Confluence, enforcing a “documentation\-first” culture—no operational process exists unless it is documented.
* Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Project Management within technology\-driven organizations.
* Strong expertise in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and program execution at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and reporting platforms.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, evolving, and high\-stakes environments.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience working in the cybersecurity domain, including vulnerability management, threat research, SOC, or incident response.
* Familiarity with SQL and/or Python for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience supporting or leading programs involving security research, platform engineering, or cloud\-scale products.

5fe3d811.title: Staff technical program manager - electronics
5fe3d811.description:
**About The Organization**
 Ultraviolette Automotive is seeking a seasoned Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead and grow the Electronics Technical Program Management team. This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing cross\-functional program execution across battery systems, charging infrastructure, wiring harness, vehicle control units, cluster development, and on\-board charger programs. The Staff TPM will mentor a team of Technical Program Managers, drive program governance, and ensure delivery excellence across all electronics sub\-systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6 Technical Program Managers spanning battery engineering, charging infrastructure, wiring harness, VCU/cluster, OBC, and motor/motor controller domains. Own the end\-to\-end program lifecycle for all electronics programs from concept to production — defining milestones, tracking progress, managing risks, and ensuring timely delivery. Establish and drive program governance frameworks, including gate reviews, risk registers, change management, and escalation protocols. Serve as the primary interface between the Electronics Engineering leadership and cross\-functional partners in Mechanical, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality. Drive dependency management across parallel programs to ensure integration timelines are met at the vehicle level. Define and continuously improve the team's program management processes, tools, and reporting cadence. Lead executive\-level program reviews and provide clear visibility into program health, risks, and mitigation strategies. Champion engineering schedule rigor, enabling data\-driven decision\-making and proactive course correction. Partner with Principal Program Manager to support headcount planning, team capability building, and org growth.
   

  

**Requirements**
 12\+ years of experience in program or project management in automotive, EV, or consumer electronics hardware companies. 5\+ years of experience directly managing or leading teams of TPMs or engineers. Deep technical understanding of EV electronics systems including battery management, power electronics, embedded control systems, or charging architecture. Strong command of program management methodologies (Agile, Stage\-Gate, or hybrid frameworks). Demonstrated experience managing multi\-discipline programs with hardware, firmware, and system integration components. Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. Experience with APQP, DFMEA, DVP, or similar automotive development processes is highly desirable. PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent certification is a plus. B. E./B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline required; M. Tech or MBA preferred.

8a8dae70.description:

**Position Summary** 
  

 We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead system\-level documentation, architecture, and compliance activities for medical device projects. The role focuses on program high\-quality while meeting business goals, Leading DHF remediation, and collaborating with cybersecurity, SAP, and software development teams to ensure successful and compliant project execution.
 


  
 **Key Responsibilities** 
* **Program Execution:** 
 Drive new product development (NPD) programs, managing the end\-to\-end process from design to manufacturing and launch.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Lead cross\-functional teams comprising Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical, Marketing, and Operations.
* **Lifecycle Management:** 
 Ensure design controls are applied throughout the lifecycle, maintaining the Design History File (DHF) and ensuring compliance with QMS.
* **Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Actively identify roadblocks, assess risks, and develop mitigation strategies, ensuring project stability.

 Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets, tracking deliverables using \[MS Project or similar software].

 Provide regular updates to executive leadership regarding program status, risks, and budgetary impacts.

 Coordinate prototype development and manage external suppliers/vendors, conducting Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews.

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical), Life Sciences, or a related field.

 Deep understanding of FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (QSR), ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

 Experience in product development lifecycles, preferably with software, hardware, or mechatronics.

 PMP (Project Management Professional) or similar certification preferred.

 Proficiency with PM tools (e.g., MS Project, SmartSheet) and PLM systems

de5dde33.description:

 MSQUARE SOLAR PVT LTD is a growing organization in the renewable energy sector, focused on delivering efficient and reliable solar solutions. The company is committed to supporting clean energy adoption through technically sound and cost\-effective systems for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Team members collaborate closely with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders to design and implement high\-quality solar projects. MSQUARE SOLAR values innovation, technical excellence, and customer satisfaction, offering opportunities to work on impactful, future\-focused energy solutions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Presales Support Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. Daily responsibilities include conducting technical evaluations, creating system layouts and integration plans, preparing cost and performance estimates, and responding to technical queries from potential customers. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity.  Beyond client delivery, you’ll also have the opportunity to participate in internal innovation; contributing to automation, tooling, and best practices that enable scale and elevate how we operate globally. This is an individual contributor position for someone who thrives at the intersection of finance, data, and technology, and is excited to make a global impact from India.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support complex client implementations: execute data conversion projects to extract, transform, and load historical portfolio data from clients’ legacy systems into Addepar
* Build scalable data solutions: Translate client requirements into flexible, sustainable workflows that enable accurate reporting and analysis, with guidance from senior team members
* Contribute to a portfolio of high\-impact projects: Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, prioritizing effectively and driving each to successful completion
* Collaborate across teams: Building knowledge of investment\-related data and partner closely with Services, Sales, Product, and Engineering to deliver tailored client outcomes
* Champion operational excellence: Identify and lead opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve our delivery processes and workflows


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: 2\+ years of experience in technology, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of leading complex data or financial system integration projects
* Technical: Proficiency in Python and SQL. You should be comfortable navigating large datasets, streamlining data flows (ETL), and finding ways to automate repetitive manual tasks to improve efficiency. Experience/familiarity with Databricks and API workflows is a plus.
* Investment\-Savvy:

* Technical Translation: Ability to articulate technical architectures to non\-technical internal teams, converting technical requirements into clear, actionable business value.
* Solutions\-Oriented: Curious problem\-solver who takes initiative and is developing ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments
* Collaborative: Eager to work across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact
* Process\-Minded: Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders


**A Note On Requirements**
 Don’t check every single box? Apply anyway. We are looking for curious, motivated individuals. If you are passionate about the intersection of finance and tech but don't meet every specific qualification listed above, we still want to hear from you and see if your unique skills could be a fit for our team.
   

  

**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.
