93711001.title: Architect - SAP S4 Migration - Asset & PS Specialist
93711001.description:
**Overview**
 The SAP S4 Migration is a comprehensive, multi\-year program spanning over four years, aimed at modernizing the current SAP PIRT landscape. This initiative covers various regions including MENA, LATAM, PGCS, APAC, and Europe. The goal of this program is to prepare the SAP system for the future, aligning it with PepsiCo's digital transformation journey.
   

  

 The project involves planning, executing, and overseeing the successful migration of data and business processes from existing SAP ECC systems to S/4HANA. This will include designing remediation of deprecated functionalities, designing new functionalities for obsolete functionalities, executing data migration objects, and ensuring data quality and integrity throughout the process. This will also be working in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders to align goals and expectations.
   

  

 The project aims to replace legacy systems by implementing the SAP S/4 HANA business suite. This suite will cover various functions including Record to Report (RTR), Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), Order to Cash (OTC), Purchase to Pay (PTP), Make to Deploy (MTD), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Warehouse Management (WM) and Trade Promotional Management (TPM).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure Seamless Migration: Ensure that SAP ECC processes are remediated and migrated to SAP S/4 RTR out any design gaps focussing on G/L, Banking, Assets, Project Systems etc.
* Design and Build: Create design documentation where existing functionalities have become obsolete. Remediate object which are identified by for remediation.
* System Readiness: Prepare the current SAP system for migration by applying necessary updates and configurations, such as SAP notes and pre\-migration checks.
* Data Migration: Oversee the technical migration of data from legacy systems to the SAP S/4HANA environment. Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance throughout the migration process by conducting data validation and reconciliation
* Data Validation: ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Comprehensive Testing: Conduct thorough testing to validate the functionality and performance of the new system, ensuring it meets all business requirements and standards.
* Change Management: Support the Change management in identifies processes and/or transactions which will get impacted.
* Training and Support: Provide training and support to super users for the changes to ensure a smooth transition and effective use of the new system.
* Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve data migration issues promptly, collaborating with data migration and tech team as needed. Track issues throughout the migration life cycle and ensure issue resolution in timely manner for the overall project success
* Promote Collaboration: Foster an environment where communication, teamwork, and innovation are encouraged.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to the internal IT operating model, including technology standards, project life cycle methodology, release management, change management, and other related processes and procedures, SLAs, and controls compliance. Accountable for ensuring proper governance is followed for all RTR areas
* Project Communication: Own project status and communication for all related work in the project. Accountable for ensuring project status reporting is done weekly and senior executive\-level communications are timely and accurate.
* Reuse Asset: Create reuse asset which can be leveraged during migration to optimize the efforts for sectors planned later in the migration journey.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred.
* 9 \- 13 years of experience configuring, deploying and managing SAP ERP with a focus on SAP RTR – General Ledger, Banking, Assets, Project System
* Experienced in 2\-3 Implementation Project in SAP S4 for RTR
* Process knowledge and SAP solution mapping experience for General Ledger \& Banking, Assets, Interfaces to applications like Blackline, Celonis, HFM, Skelta etc.
* Exposure to SAP Profitability Analysis and Product Costing preferred
* Integration across other functional areas, i.e., Procure to pay, Make to Deploy \& Order to Cash
* Prior experience on S4 Migration or experience data validation strategy would be preferred.
* Prior experience in working on solutions for managing ACDOCA growth preferred
* Deep understanding of project test phases and testing automation tools.
* Fully aware of the SAP security design implications through global roles. Familiar to the GRC best practices in large corporations as PepsiCo
* Dispatches standard SAP quality issues with OSS (Online SAP Services) and follows up the required break fixes
* Demonstrated Leadership skills, including planning, organization, prioritization, collaboration
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization
* Ability to work flexible hours based on varying business requirements
* Solves complex problems within their work team
* Strong influencing, facilitating, and consulting skills in working with stakeholders at all levels in the organization and across departments
* Ability to clear obstacles for teams to deliver
* Experience with LATAM, Europe, MENA and APAC preferred

f821eda1.title: Program Manager – Children, Adolescents & Youth
f821eda1.description:
JOB OPENING
 



  





 Program Manager – Children, Adolescents \& Youth
 



  





 ⚠
 **️ Apply only after reading the entire Job Description** 




  





 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
 



 Compensation: ₹45,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and skills)
 



 Languages Required: Telugu \| Hindi \| English (all mandatory)
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: Minimum 5 years
 



 Joining: Immediate
 



  





**About Youngistaan Foundation** 




  





 Youngistaan Foundation is a grassroots organization committed to empowering children, adolescents, youth, and communities through education, health, gender equality, climate action, and more.
 



  





 Since 2014, we have impacted over 5 million lives across 60 cities with the support of 70,000\+ volunteers and 200\+ public and private partners.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced and proactive Program Manager to lead and strengthen Youngistaan Foundation’s programs focused on children, adolescents, and youth in urban slums and communities of Hyderabad.
 



  





 The role will involve overseeing the planning and implementation of programs, developing modules and learning resources, managing teams and volunteers, strengthening partnerships, monitoring program outcomes, and ensuring effective delivery across the organization’s children, adolescent, and youth portfolio.
 



  





 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong ownership, sound judgment, effective execution, and a genuine commitment to working respectfully with children, young people, and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Program Design \& Implementation
 



  





 \* Design, plan, implement, and strengthen programs for children, adolescents, and youth in urban communities
 



 .\* Lead program planning, timelines, deliverables, resource requirements, and implementation strategies
 



 .\* Develop education, life\-skills, social\-emotional learning, leadership, and youth development modules, toolkits, and structured session content
 



 .\* Ensure programs are age\-appropriate, participatory, inclusive, and responsive to community needs
 



 .\* Identify implementation challenges and take timely corrective action.
 



  





**Team \& Volunteer Management.** 




  





 \* Lead and coordinate program teams, facilitators, interns, and volunteers involved in program delivery
 



 .\* Provide guidance, mentoring, and regular feedback to team members
 



 .\* Conduct capacity\-building workshops and training for staff, volunteers, teachers, and community stakeholders
 



 .\* Foster teamwork, accountability, and collaboration across program teams
 



 .\* Support the development of systems and processes that improve program quality and consistency.
 



  





**Monitoring, Evaluation \& Learning** 




  





 \* Establish and track program objectives, indicators, outputs, and outcomes
 



 .\* Maintain accurate program data and documentation
 



 .\* Conduct regular program reviews and identify areas for improvement
 



 .\* Prepare impact assessments, case studies, success stories, and learning documentation
 



 .\* Use program data, participant feedback, and field insights to improve program design and implementation.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Stakeholder Engagement** 




  





 \* Build and maintain relationships with schools, youth groups, NGOs, community organizations, government agencies, and other stakeholders
 



 .\* Develop and strengthen partnerships to expand program reach, improve quality, and support long\-term sustainability
 



 .\* Represent Youngistaan Foundation in relevant meetings, networks, workshops, and forums
 



 .\* Support donor and CSR partner engagement, reporting, presentations, and review meetings.
 



  





**Budget \& Resource Management** 




  





 \* Support program budgeting, resource planning, and expenditure tracking
 



 .\* Ensure effective and responsible use of program resources
 



 .\* Coordinate with the relevant internal teams on procurement, logistics, finance, and administrative requirements
 



 .\* Ensure program activities are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
 



  





**Organizational Alignment** 




  





 \* Ensure programs are aligned with Youngistaan Foundation’s vision, strategy, program objectives, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
 



 .\* Identify opportunities for innovation, collaboration, learning, and scale
 



 .\* Take ownership of program outcomes and proactively address operational and implementation challenges
 



 .\* Contribute to organizational planning, strategy discussions, and program development.
 



  





**Safeguarding** 




  





 \* Ensure that all programs are implemented with a strong focus on child safety, safeguarding, dignity, inclusion, and well\-being
 



 .\* Ensure compliance with Youngistaan Foundation’s safeguarding and child\-protection policies and procedures
 



 .\* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries while working with children, adolescents, youth, and communities
 



 .\* The selected candidate may be required to undergo reference and background verification as part of the organization’s safeguarding process.
 



  





**Requirement:** 




  





**Experience:** 




  





 \* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in program management within the development sector
 



 .\* Demonstrated experience working with children, adolescents, youth, or community\-based programs
 



 .\* Experience in program planning, implementation, team coordination, training, reporting, and stakeholder engagement
 



 .\* Experience managing teams, volunteers, or field\-based program staff
 



 .\* Experience developing and implementing structured programs, modules, learning interventions, or community initiatives
 



 .\* Experience working with CSR partners, donors, NGOs, schools, or government stakeholders will be an advantage.
 



  





**Education** 




  





 \* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work (BSW), Development Studies, Education, Public Health, Sociology, Psychology, or a related field is required
 



 .\* A Master’s degree (MSW, MBA – Social Entrepreneurship, MPH, or equivalent) is preferred and will be given additional consideration.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies.** 




  





 \* Strong skills in program design, implementation, project management, and execution
 



 .\* Strong training facilitation and module development skills
 



 .\* Team management, mentoring, and coordination skills
 



 .\* Strong monitoring, reporting, documentation, and data\-management abilities
 



 .\* Proven ability in networking, advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and partnership\-building
 



 .\* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
 



 .\* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 



 .\* Proficiency in Telugu, Hindi, and English is mandatory
 



 .\* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders
 



 .\* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
 



 .\* Demonstrated ownership and ability to work in a field\-oriented environment
 



 .\* Passion for working with children and young people, with a strong commitment to social impact.
 



  





**Work Requirements.** 




  





 \* Regular field visits across the slum communities are required
 



 \* The role may occasionally require evening or weekend work based on program schedules, community activities, workshops, or events
 



 \* The candidate should be comfortable working directly with children, adolescents, youth, community members, volunteers, and partner organizations.
 



  





**What We Offer.** 




  





 \* Opportunity to be part of one of India’s largest volunteer\-driven movements
 



 \* A collaborative and impact\-driven work culture
 



 \* Opportunity to lead and strengthen programs creating meaningful impact for children, adolescents, youth, and communities
 



 \* Monthly remuneration of ₹45,000 – ₹50,000, based on experience and skills.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Interested candidates may send their CV and a short cover letter to.
 



  





 admin@youngistaanfoundation.org
 



  





 Subject Line:
 



  





 Application – Program Manager (Children, Adolescents \& Youth)
 



  





 Immediate joining is preferred.
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly for further steps.
 



  





**⚠️ Important** 




  





 Youngistaan Foundation never asks for any payment or fees at any stage of the hiring process.
 



 Please be aware of fraudulent activity and report it immediately.
 



 youngistaanfoundation.org. admin@youngistaanfoundation.org

Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 Are you a strategic leader with a passion for driving impactful solution delivery and building high\-performing teams? We’re looking for a
 **Manager of Solution Consulting** 
 to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you’ll lead and mentor a team of Solution Consultants, ensuring consistent and successful service delivery across engagements. You'll partner closely with cross\-functional teams, align consulting efforts with product capabilities, and champion best practices that elevate our customer experience. If you thrive in a fast\-paced SaaS environment and are excited about shaping the future of solution consulting, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in Technology Consulting, Sales Enablement or Financial Services with broad scope of understanding and exposure to all sectors
* Understanding of enterprise SaaS business and implementation models and process
* Passionate problem solver with the ability to balance both quantitative and qualitative elements to devise an overall solution
* Ability to understand a client’s business case for purchasing a software platform, consult on solution approach and oversee implementation and delivery of work product
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving expertise
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers and stakeholders at all levels
* Advanced proficiency with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of data systems and structures
* Experience with all aspects of the Seismic platform
* Proficiency with Salesforce.com, and a solid understanding of Salesforce Object structure a plus
* Bachelor’s Degree required, with a preference for technical, engineering and CS backgrounds
* Strong understanding of project management and risk mitigation principles.
* Proficiency in resource planning and team management
* Ability to leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and deliver high\-quality outcomes while establishing an AI first mindset with the team
* Strong understanding of integrating software for bidirectional flow of information


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Ensure consistent, efficient, and excellent solution delivery by empowering Solution Consultants in your practice area with product and industry knowledge, skills, and measures.
* Develop, refine, and maintain a delivery framework, methodology content, and best practice tools and templates for your practice area.
* Drive the reliability of consulting efforts and delivery across regions for successful ongoing Services engagements.
* Serve as the primary contact with the Product team to drive alignment and provide bi\-directional input and feedback on product and platform capabilities within your practice area.
* Lead a team of Solution Consultants, architects and engineers providing guidance to enhance their thought leadership capabilities across all Solution Consulting resources.
* Collaborate with the Practice leadership to ensure high utilization across the Practice team, effectively balancing project staffing needs to achieve revenue goals and margin targets.
* Develop training and certification programs for new Solution Consultants in your practice area.
* Participate in calls with prospects and existing customers to discuss services opportunities.
* Actively manage staffing requests on an ongoing basis to ensure projects get staffed with the right resources in a timely manner.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

* Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* Cisco Duo

**Preferred Qualifications**

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. * Expert\-level proficiency in designing microservices architectures and RESTful / GraphQL APIs.
* Deep hands\-on experience with React (frontend architecture) and .NET and/or Python (backend services).
* Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL database platforms, including data modeling, partitioning, indexing, performance optimization, and selection of appropriate persistence patterns for distributed, cloud\-native applications.
* Working knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including monitoring strategies, distributed tracing, telemetry standards, and production diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
* Advanced understanding of Domain\-Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed systems patterns.
* Hands\-on knowledge and experience in designing and implementing AI\-enabled solutions using AI agent frameworks, Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search, and LLMs/SLMs.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.
* Working knowledge of OpenID Connect / OAuth 2\.0 and fine\-grained authorization in multi\-tenant SaaS environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including API\-led connectivity, event\-driven messaging, asynchronous communication patterns, data synchronization, system interoperability, and integration platform technologies used to connect cloud, SaaS, and custom applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience presenting designs to senior technology stakeholders.
* Professional services or B2B SaaS product experience is advantageous.
* Experience with BPM and integration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Boomi, MuleSoft) is highly desirable.
* Experience architecting Agentic AI solutions is preferred.

* Python
* Domain\-Driven Design
* Event\-Driven Architecture

aae711c5.title: Staff Data Engineer- Cloud Data Platform
aae711c5.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting\-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.


Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data\-rich world.


ELLKAY's experience, customer\-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.

**Job Description:**


The Staff Data Engineer – Cloud Data Platform will design, develop, and operate scalable cloud\-based data pipelines and processing capabilities for ELLKAY’s shared Data Platform and Data Lake.


This is a hands\-on engineering position responsible for converting the Data Platform architecture into production\-ready ingestion, transformation, data\-quality, and data\-serving capabilities. The engineer will work with the Director, Staff Engineers, Architects, and product teams to onboard healthcare data workloads through reusable platform patterns.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* **Build scalable batch, incremental, streaming, and near\-real\-time data pipelines.**
* Develop ingestion capabilities for databases, files, SFTP, APIs, healthcare messages, events, and partner data.
* Implement raw, standardized, curated, and product\-serving data layers.
* Preserve original source data and maintain traceability between source and transformed records.
* Develop transformation, normalization, mapping, reconciliation, and validation workflows.
* Implement data\-quality rules, exception handling, lineage, metadata, and audit controls.
* Build solutions using AWS, Snowflake, SQL, Python, Spark or equivalent cloud data technologies.
* Develop reusable pipeline templates, libraries, configuration patterns, and CI/CD components.
* Implement automated unit, integration, regression, reconciliation, and performance tests.
* Establish monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Optimize data\-processing performance, storage utilization, and cloud cost.
* Support healthcare migration, LKOasis, LKOpera, eMPI, interoperability, analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, production support, root\-cause analysis, and performance tuning.
* Produce clear technical documentation and onboarding instructions for reusable platform components.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers without direct employee\-management responsibility.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience in data engineering and cloud data platforms.
* Experience developing production\-grade ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Strong SQL and Python skills.
* Experience with AWS, Snowflake, Spark, or equivalent modern data technologies.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, metadata, monitoring, and CI/CD.
* Experience working with large, complex, or regulated datasets.
* Healthcare data experience is preferred but not required.

 **Additional Information:**


ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams.  

Any alternative work arrangements may be considered at the company’s discretion based on role requirements and business needs.  

For more information about our company, please visit www.ELLKAY.com.  

ELLKAY is a Smoke\-Free Workplace.


ELLKAY, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

ee900438.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands\-on Full\-Stack Software Engineer who will cover frontend UI, backend architecture, cloud deployment, and DevOps engineering all under one hat. Since our team already includes dedicated AI Engineers and Data Engineers, your primary mission is to be the foundational software engineering anchor: building the robust, scalable, and secure user interfaces, infrastructure, integrations, and server\-side logic that allows our AI solutions to thrive in a production environment.
   

  

**Description Of The Area**
 At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high\-value AI solutions spanning advanced agentic frameworks, Generative AI applications, and classical Machine Learning. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building these innovative AI applications end\-to\-end to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
   

  

 In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through agentic SDLC).
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Frontend Architecture \& Generative UI:** 
 Develop highly scalable, reusable UI components using expert\-level TypeScript and modern frameworks (React/Next.js or Angular 16\+). Shift from static layouts to flexible, dynamic interfaces that gracefully handle unpredictable data and real\-time LLM streams.
   

  

**Core Backend Engineering \& API Design:** 
 Design and build highly scalable, reusable backend services and APIs (using Python) that serve as the backbone for multi\-agent workflows and GenAI applications. Build, host, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and standard APIs to standardize data exchange.
   

  

**Cloud Architecture \& DevOps Excellence:** 
 Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS) tailored for diverse AI workloads. Apply Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform. Build, maintain, and optimize fully automated CI/CD pipelines and manage application containerization (Docker).
   

  

**Agentic SDLC \& Engineering Excellence:** 
 Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full\-stack development cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human\-written and AI\-generated code.
   

  

**Qualifications / Education / Experience**
**Experience:** 
 7\+ years of strong software engineering experience with a demonstrable focus on backend development, cloud infrastructure, advanced frontend architecture, and DevOps.
   

  

**AI Integration Experience:** 
 Proven experience building backends for complex solutions and AI / LLM\-powered applications, managing streaming responses, and translating non\-deterministic AI outputs into safe, functional user interfaces.
   

  

**Agentic Workflow:** 
 Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
   

  

 Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., PhD, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 Be a passionate builder, staying continuously up\-to\-date with the latest developments in cloud computing, backend architectures, frontend paradigms, and AI integrations.
   

  

 Be team\-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, thriving in a fast\-paced environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary.
   

  

 Have a deep sense of accountability, capable of diagnosing complex system\-level issues across the entire stack, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
   

  

**Skills**
**Must\-have:**
 Software Engineering Best Practices: Robust automated testing (TDD) to verify both code written by AI agents and dynamic UI components generated at runtime.
   

  

 Frontend \& User Interface: Deep expertise in TypeScript and a major framework (React/Next.js or Angular 16\+). Strong capability in complex state management and handling real\-time data flow.
   

  

 Backend Programming: Advanced, production\-grade proficiency in Python. Excellent enterprise API design and microservices architecture skills.
   

  

 Cloud \& DevOps: Deep expertise in AWS (IAM, Lambda, S3, ECS, etc.), Docker, CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions), and Terraform.
   

  

 APIs and integrations: Building API\-driven applications and integrating different enterprise systems into one solution.
   

  

**Should\-have:**
 Data \& AI Tooling: Experience integrating with modern databases (Snowflake, OpenSearch). Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), graph databases, and Generative UI libraries.
   

  

 aSDLC: leveraging Agentic AI in the Software Development Lifecycle
   

  

 Building scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available systems.
   

  

**Could\-have:**
 Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
   

  

**Additional Qualifications**
**Security Mindset:** 
 Strong understanding of enterprise security risks, IAM, and safe data handling along with a strong understanding of responsible AI deployment.
   

  

**Communication:** 
 Be an excellent problem solver, detail\-oriented, and a great communicator, able to present complex technical matters clearly to diverse audiences. Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1\+.
   

  

 Be deeply interested in developments in AI, staying up\-to\-date with the latest developments in agentic SDLC, cloud computing, and software development practices.
   

  

 Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1\+.
   

  

 Working Hours: Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
   

  

 \#Hyd2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

d66c616a.title: Cloud Engineer
d66c616a.description:
**About The Company**
 NotionAce Consulting FZE is a leading cloud and enterprise technology consulting firm headquartered in Dubai. As a certified Oracle Cloud partner, our organization specializes in delivering comprehensive managed services, ERP modernization, and security operations tailored for enterprise clients across the UAE and the broader Middle East region. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, underscoring our dedication to maintaining the highest standards of security and operational integrity. We pride ourselves on fostering innovative solutions that enable our clients to leverage the full potential of cloud technologies, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient IT environments.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Network Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will take ownership of the networking and firewall layers across our OCI managed services accounts. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless connectivity, optimal network performance, and robust security for our clients’ cloud infrastructure. The Cloud Network Engineer will serve as the primary escalation point for connectivity, firewall, and network\-related issues, providing expert troubleshooting and resolution. The position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge cloud technologies, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and contribute to the design and implementation of secure, scalable cloud networks for diverse enterprise environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To qualify for this role, candidates should possess 4 to 6 years of experience in cloud or network engineering, with at least 2 years of hands\-on experience managing firewalls. A strong practical understanding of TCP/IP, routing, NAT, DNS, and VPN technologies is essential, along with the ability to analyze packet captures and diagnose network paths comprehensively. Experience with FortiGate firewalls and FortiManager is required, with exposure to policy management, NAT rules, IPSec tunnels, and SSL VPNs. Candidates should have working knowledge of a major cloud platform’s networking stack, preferably OCI, although experience with AWS VPC or Azure VNet is also acceptable. Prior experience in a managed services, MSP, or enterprise support environment, especially within ticket\-based workflows and SLA\-driven processes, is highly valued. Excellent written English communication skills are necessary for effective interaction with client IT teams and documentation purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring and managing network security across OCI environments, including VCNs, subnets, route tables, security lists, NSGs, service gateways, and load balancers. They will administer FortiGate firewalls and FortiManager, implementing policy changes, NAT rules, and establishing secure IPSec site\-to\-site tunnels and SSL VPNs. Handling day\-to\-day access requests such as port openings, IP/subnet whitelisting, and RDP/SSH/ICMP access between on\-premises and cloud segments with proper change control is a core part of the role. Troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues, including packet loss, latency, DNS resolution failures, routing challenges, and tunnel stability, will be a key responsibility. The engineer will support the design and deployment of landing zones and VCNs for new client environments, including CIDR planning and hub\-and\-spoke topologies. Working within an SLA\-driven ticketing system (Jira Service Management), they will document resolutions and develop runbooks to streamline routine changes. Collaboration with OCI infrastructure, database, and SOC teams on migrations and deployments is also expected to ensure smooth operations and security compliance.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Joining NotionAce Consulting offers a competitive benefits package that includes health insurance, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We support ongoing certifications and training to enhance your skills and career growth. Our organization values work\-life balance and provides flexible working arrangements where applicable. Additionally, you will have the chance to work on innovative projects with leading cloud technologies, contributing to the digital transformation of enterprise clients across the Middle East. We foster a culture of continuous learning, recognition, and advancement, ensuring our team members are motivated and empowered to excel in their roles.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 NotionAce Consulting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected regardless of race, gender, age, religion, national origin, or disability. We believe that a diverse team fosters innovation and drives better business outcomes. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and provide equal employment opportunities to ensure fair treatment and advancement within our organization.

e955f82e.title: Senior Solution Architect
e955f82e.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solution Architect based in India.**
 This is a senior, globally focused opportunity for an experienced maintenance and SAP EAM professional who wants to shape the future of industrial maintenance. You will translate real\-world plant processes into scalable mobile, digital, and AI\-enabled solutions. The role combines onsite discovery, process consulting, solution architecture, value engineering, and strategic customer engagement. You will work directly with maintenance, reliability, IT, and operations leaders across major industrial environments. You will also strengthen existing implementations by identifying opportunities to improve adoption, digitize additional workflows, and unlock further value. With global travel and significant ownership of solution design, this role offers the chance to influence how complex industrial organizations modernize maintenance operations.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end solution design for enterprise maintenance environments, defining how mobile, digital, and AI capabilities transform existing workflows.
* Conduct onsite discovery sessions, assessments, workshops, and gap analyses with maintenance, reliability, operations, and IT stakeholders.
* Map current maintenance and repair processes and define detailed future\-state workflows, including work order execution, notifications, confirmations, time and materials, measurements, parts handling, and offline field operations.
* Define how AI\-enabled capabilities can automate manual steps, capture information at the point of work, and improve the use of maintenance data.
* Act as the design authority for SAP PM integration, master data structures, mobile configurations, security roles, and user access.
* Translate solution designs into clear implementation plans that functional consultants can execute.
* Review deployed solutions across existing customer accounts to determine whether the design continues to reflect actual operational requirements.
* Develop structured action plans distinguishing design improvements from configuration, data, and training requirements, with clear ownership, sequencing, and effort estimates.
* Identify additional processes, sites, and capabilities that could benefit from digital transformation and build expansion cases around measurable operational value.
* Quantify and communicate business value using maintenance KPIs such as wrench time, schedule compliance, backlog health, PM/PdM completion, MTBF, and MTTR.
* Coach functional consultants on maintenance processes, solution design principles, and architectural decision\-making.
* Support sales teams with technical discovery, solution scoping, customer presentations, and strategic solution discussions.
* Build trusted relationships with senior operations and IT stakeholders and confidently communicate technical recommendations to both executive audiences and frontline maintenance teams.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience as a maintenance or reliability technician, craft supervisor, MRO lead, or similar role within a refinery, plant, mill, mine, or other industrial environment.
* 5\+ years of experience in SAP PM or EAM implementation consulting, including ownership of solution design, onsite process assessments, and gap analysis.
* Demonstrated experience transitioning industrial sites from paper\-based work orders to mobile maintenance execution.
* Proven ability to assess live customer environments, identify gaps between deployed solutions and operational reality, and develop actionable plans for implementation teams.
* Strong practical understanding of maintenance and repair operations, including notification intake, work order management, confirmations, parts management, and closeout data quality.
* Experience presenting quantified business cases to operations and IT executives while also being comfortable discussing process changes directly with frontline teams.
* Experience defining security roles and access requirements for maintenance and enterprise systems.
* Working knowledge of AI technologies relevant to industrial maintenance, including large language models, retrieval over technical documentation, agentic automation, and predictive models.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and hands\-on maintenance experience.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, primarily across North America, with travel to EMEA and APAC as customer requirements dictate.
* Ability to satisfy plant, refinery, mine, and other industrial site safety and access requirements.
* CMRP, CRL, or equivalent maintenance and reliability certification is preferred.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Asset Management and SAP integration patterns involving PO, ECC, and APIs is advantageous.
* Knowledge of maintenance KPI frameworks, including backlog health, schedule compliance, PM/PdM completion, MTBF, and MTTR, is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with AI tooling such as LLM\-based assistants, retrieval systems for equipment and procedure documentation, or predictive models is a plus.
* Experience mentoring technicians, planners, consultants, or other technical professionals is beneficial.
* Working proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is advantageous.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time, remote position with a globally distributed working environment.
* Opportunity to work with major asset\-intensive industrial organizations across multiple regions.
* Significant ownership and visibility in a senior solution architecture role.
* Exposure to advanced mobile, SAP EAM, AI, and industrial digital transformation technologies.
* Opportunities to influence maintenance strategy and measurable operational outcomes at customer sites.
* Global travel opportunities, with travel of up to 50% depending on account requirements.
* Professional development and opportunities to expand expertise across maintenance, SAP, solution architecture, and AI\-enabled operations.
* Direct interaction with senior operations and IT leadership as well as frontline industrial teams.
* Inclusive workplace with accessibility support for people with disabilities.
* A structured recruitment process progressing through registration, interviews, manager interview, final interview, offer, and hiring stages.


**How Jobgether Works**
 We use an
 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. **Job Title: Solution Architect \- SAP Supply Chain Planning \& Digital Manufacturing**
 The
 **Solution Architect \- SAP Supply Chain Planning \& Digital Manufacturing** 
 is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving SAP\-enabled digital manufacturing solutions. The role covers SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC), SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), SAP Manufacturing Execution (ME), and related SAP PP, EWM, QM, MM\-IM, and PM capabilities.
   

  

 Working closely with Manufacturing, Operations, and Plant IT, the role delivers reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions that provide real\-time operational visibility, enable intelligent production planning, and connect shop\-floor activities with enterprise processes. The position plays a key role in improving productivity, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP digital manufacturing initiatives from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement solutions across SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud, SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM\-IM/PM, and SAP ECC/S4HANA/EWM integration points.
* Collaborate with production, quality, maintenance, and logistics teams to map business processes to SAP capabilities (e.g., production planning, order execution, batch management, quality inspection, asset management, stock transfer).
* Design and configure real\-time shop\-floor dashboards, KPIs, alerts, and analytics to enable data\-driven decision making.
* Integrate SAP digital manufacturing solutions with MES, ERP, IoT platforms, and third\-party systems (e.g., PLCs, historians, SCADA, and OT data sources).
* Lead data modelling efforts for master data, bill of materials, routings, work centres, and production orders to support manufacturing operations.
* Define and execute testing strategies (functional, integration, regression) and support user acceptance testing.
* Establish governance for change management, version control, security, access controls, and data quality within SAP solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to project teams, business analysts, and end\-users.
* Prepare and manage project plans, budgets, risk registers, and status communications to stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and training materials for end users.
* Stay current with SAP product roadmaps, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, ISO) impacting manufacturing operations.


**Who You Are**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* At least 5\+ years of experience implementing or sustaining SAP\-based manufacturing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud (DMC) and/or SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII); knowledge of SAP ME and SAP PP/EWM/QM/MM\-IM/PM is highly desirable.
* Strong integration experience between SAP ECC, S/4 Hana, EWM using SAP Clound connector with SAP DM and MES/OT systems, including API design, middleware, and data mapping.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (discrete, batch, process) and shop\-floor realities.
* Experience with real\-time analytics, dashboards, and KPI design for manufacturing operations.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance in manufacturing IT environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP certifications relevant to digital manufacturing (e.g., SAP MII, SAP ME, SAP PP/PM, SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud).
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration patterns and SAP Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of OT/IT convergence, IIoT, OPC/UA, MQTT, and data historian architectures.
* Programming or scripting skills (e.g., SQL, ABAP, JavaScript) to support custom developments or data extraction.
* Experience in GMP/AML/ISO\-compliant manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading change management, user adoption, training, and enablement activities.
* Certification or formal training in IoT, manufacturing analytics, data science, or a related discipline.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with a data\-driven approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, facilitation, and communication abilities.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across business, IT, engineering, and operations teams in a global environment.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and committed to clear, accurate documentation.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple initiatives while maintaining delivery focus.
* Adaptability and willingness to continuously learn as SAP capabilities and manufacturing technologies evolve.


**Work Environment And Other Requirements**
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required; typical travel is approximately 10–20%, depending on project needs.
* Ability to work periodically on\-site at manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global, cross\-functional environment and support initiatives across multiple locations and time zones.


 Opportunity and Impact the SAP Digital Manufacturing Professional enable smarter, more connected manufacturing with improved throughput, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance. This role is pivotal in transforming operational data into actionable insights and sustaining a competitive advantage through digital manufacturing excellence.
   

  

**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

4700ffaa.title: Manager, Solution Configuration
4700ffaa.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Solution Configuration based in India.**
 This is a fully remote leadership opportunity within a distributed, international technology organization.
   

  

 The role focuses on managing a large configuration team responsible for high\-volume, technically complex work across multiple partner implementations.
   

  

 You will combine people leadership with delivery management, capacity planning, process optimization, and hands\-on operational expertise.
   

  

 A key part of the role is ensuring configuration work is accurately planned, prioritized, tracked, and delivered on time.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Implementation, Engineering, and Product teams to remove blockers and protect partner go\-live timelines.
   

  

 The position also offers significant ownership of process excellence, automation, reporting, and Jira and Confluence practices.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced technical operations leader who thrives in distributed environments and enjoys building scalable, reliable processes.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a large configuration team responsible for high\-volume and technically complex work across multiple simultaneous partner implementations.
* Build and maintain a capacity model to understand team throughput, forecast workload, identify over\-allocation risks, and proactively address potential delivery issues.
* Assign and balance work according to team members’ skill levels, task complexity, priorities, and implementation requirements.
* Develop and execute structured onboarding and training plans that enable new team members to progress toward independent work.
* Establish clear performance expectations, conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, identify development needs, and communicate team gaps to leadership.
* Own configuration timelines, milestones, and due dates across active implementations, keeping plans accurate as scope and sequencing evolve.
* Identify delays, dependencies, and delivery risks early, implement mitigation plans, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Track operational metrics including cycle time, throughput, rework, and on\-time completion, using insights to improve team performance and delivery outcomes.
* Collaborate with Implementation Managers, Engineering, and Product teams to sequence work, remove blockers, and protect partner go\-live dates.
* Define, document, and continuously improve configuration processes covering intake, prioritization, peer review, validation, and handoff.
* Ensure teams consistently follow documented processes while identifying opportunities to simplify and improve workflows.
* Standardize repeatable activities through templates, checklists, automation, and other tools designed to reduce errors and manual effort.
* Facilitate retrospectives and translate findings into documented process improvements.
* Produce clear, accurate, and actionable reports for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Build trust across Implementation, Engineering, and Product teams through reliable communication, accurate status reporting, and consistent delivery.
* Serve as the configuration team’s expert user and administrator for Jira and Confluence, including workflows, custom fields, automation rules, JQL, filters, dashboards, and spaces.
* Establish and enforce Jira ticketing standards so configuration requests remain traceable from initial intake through validation.
* Maintain Confluence as the team’s single source of truth, including process documentation, configuration runbooks, standards, decision logs, and onboarding materials.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in technical project management, delivery management, technical operations, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience managing teams of 10 or more employees.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Jira and Confluence administration, including workflows, automation, JQL, dashboards, and space configuration.
* Proven experience leading and managing distributed teams working across multiple time zones.
* Strong capacity planning, delivery management, prioritization, and operational problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to produce concise and effective status reports for senior leadership.
* Strong analytical and organizational capabilities, with the ability to use operational metrics to identify risks and improve performance.
* Ability to manage multiple implementation priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and delivery discipline.
* Willingness to work hours that overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.
* Hands\-on approach and willingness to contribute directly to team work when operational needs require it.
* Experience with online banking platforms, loan origination systems, consumer lending, or deposit products is a plus.
* Experience working with banks, credit unions, fintech companies, or financial technology partners on implementation or onboarding initiatives is desirable.


**Benefits**
* Annual fixed salary ranging from INR 15 lakh to INR 26 lakh, depending on experience, plus variable compensation.
* Equity compensation package.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO), allowing employees to take time away as needed to rest and recharge.
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of the employee premium covered.
* Disability and life insurance.
* Remote work from a home office in India.
* Reimbursement for remote\-work equipment and setup.
* Monthly phone and internet stipend.
* Opportunities for learning, professional development, and career growth.
* Team\-building events, cultural activities, and company\-wide events.
* Paid time off for volunteering and community service.
* Half\-day Fridays.
* 401(k) matching contribution.
* Opportunity to collaborate with a distributed international team across India, North America, Europe, and other locations.


**How Jobgether Works**

5d1cb7e5.title: Power solution architect
5d1cb7e5.description:
**Company Description** 
 Delta Electronics India Private Limited, part of the global Delta Group, is a leading power and energy management company operating in India since 2003\. The company serves diverse markets through three main business categories: Power Electronics, Automation, and Infrastructure. It has established market leadership in telecom power, EV charging, and display solutions, and is also a key provider of industrial automation, UPS and data center solutions, rail transportation solutions, energy storage, DC fans and blowers, and components. With sixteen regional offices, three manufacturing facilities, two R\&D centers, and more than 200 channel partners, Delta maintains a robust presence across India. The company is certified for quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management, underscoring its commitment to high operational standards.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Power Solution Architect will design, validate, and optimize power solutions for customers, ensuring technical feasibility, reliability, and alignment with business requirements. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Mumbai and involves collaborating with sales, engineering, and project teams to develop proposals, prepare technical documentation, and support solution presentations. The role includes conducting load and system analysis, selecting appropriate power and energy management products, and defining architectures for telecom, data center, industrial, and infrastructure applications. The Power Solution Architect will participate in customer meetings, provide pre\- and post\-sales technical support, and help resolve complex system integration and performance issues. The position also involves staying updated on industry standards and emerging technologies to enhance solution offerings and support continuous improvement.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong expertise in power systems design, power electronics, and energy management solutions relevant to telecom, data center, industrial, and infrastructure applications.
* Experience with solution architecture, system integration, and technical pre\-sales, including requirements analysis, solution sizing, and proposal development.
* Proficiency in electrical engineering fundamentals, including load calculations, protection coordination, system reliability, and compliance with applicable standards and regulations.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, such as single\-line diagrams, specifications, bill of materials, and technical presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams and customers, including the ability to explain complex technical topics in accessible terms.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related discipline; relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* Experience working with large infrastructure or industrial projects, preferably in power, telecom, EV charging, or automation domains.
* Demonstrated capability to work on\-site, manage multiple projects, and deliver solutions within agreed timelines and quality standards.

* Strong understanding of **MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool calling**.

* Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, guardrails, evaluation, observability, and auditability.

* OpenAI / OpenAI APIs

* LangGraph
* LangChain
* Semantic Kernel
* Other AI agent orchestration platforms
* Enterprise customer portals

You will play a key role in defining how AI agents interact with customers, enterprise systems, APIs, and business processes. You will help establish a scalable architecture that enables intelligent, secure, observable, and production\-ready AI\-powered customer experiences.

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume. Please highlight your experience with **Agentic AI, LLMs, MCP, AI Agents, RAG, SAP BTP, and enterprise solution architecture**.

**About The Role**
 As an AI Solution Architect at Leena AI, you will own the technical and functional blueprint for enterprise AI deployments \- translating customer business problems into scalable AI agent solutions built on our low\-code/no\-code platform. You'll sit at the intersection of client\-facing solutioning and hands\-on solution design: leading discovery, architecting the solution, configuring AI assistants and agentic workflows, and guiding implementation teams through delivery. This is not an infrastructure or cloud\-ops role \- it's a design, configuration, and client\-advisory role for someone who thinks in prompts, workflows, integrations, and business outcomes rather than servers and pipelines.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Solution Design \& Architecture
   

  

* Lead discovery workshops and technical design sessions with enterprise stakeholders to understand business processes across HR, IT, Finance, and Enterprise Operations
* Translate business requirements into end\-to\-end AI agent solution designs — conversation flows, workflow automations, and integration architecture
* Architect and document solution blueprints, data flows, and configuration specs that implementation teams can build against
* Own the technical narrative in client conversations — presenting solution designs, defending architectural choices, and adjusting scope with stakeholders in real time


 AI, LLM \& Agent Configuration
   

  

* Design and configure AI assistants and agentic workflows using Leena AI's low\-code/no\-code platform \- prompt design, tool/agent orchestration, and guardrails
* Customize LLM\-powered experiences for customer\-specific use cases, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost
* Configure multi\-step agent workflows (approvals, escalations, human\-in\-the\-loop) using in\-house no\-code/low\-code tooling rather than custom backend builds
* Continuously refine prompts, knowledge sources, and agent logic based on evaluation results and production feedback


 Enterprise Integrations \& Delivery Oversight
   

  

* Design integration architecture with enterprise systems (Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, UKG, SuccessFactors, Microsoft Entra ID/AD, Teams, Slack, Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk) using REST/GraphQL APIs, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SAML 2\.0, and SCIM
* Drive UAT, go\-live readiness, and hypercare, resolving design\-level issues that surface during rollout
* Identify solution risks (scope, integration, adoption) early and propose mitigations


 Technical Leadership \& Client Advisory
   

  

* Act as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts and complex, multi\-system implementations
* Support pre\-sales solutioning \- scoping feasibility, effort, and architecture for prospective deployments
* Mentor on solution design practices, agent architecture patterns, and platform best practices.
* Build reusable solution templates, agent design patterns, and implementation accelerators to speed up future rollouts
* Stay current on LLM, RAG, and agentic AI developments and bring relevant patterns into customer solutions.
* Drive team performance and development \- establish priorities, resolve technical bottlenecks, and lead regular design and code reviews for Solution Consultants and FDEs.
* Guide complex engagements hands\-on \- partner with team members throughout discovery and configuration to sharpen their solutioning capabilities, maintaining ultimate accountability for execution quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 Engineering college or Software Engineering background preferred.
* 6\+ years of experience in solution consulting, implementation, or technical architecture within enterprise SaaS, with 2\+ years designing AI/LLM\-powered or conversational AI solutions
* Hands\-on experience with LLM applications — prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, and evaluation/guardrails
* Proven experience designing and configuring solutions on workflow builders, conversation designers, automation tools.
* Strong client\-facing track record: leading discovery workshops, presenting architecture to senior stakeholders, and managing scope conversations
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns \- REST/GraphQL APIs, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, SAML 2\.0, SCIM and enterprise systems such as Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, or Oracle etc.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with AI frameworks/ecosystems such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar (as a consumer/configurer, not necessarily a framework\-level builder)
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), multi\-agent systems, and AI orchestration patterns
* Experience leading solutioning for large, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations.

**Role Description**
 Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Architect to lead the discovery, architecture, design and validation of a reusable Environment\-on\-Demand (EoD) factory leveraging the Client’s existing on\-premises and cloud foundations. The role will focus on transforming the current environment management model into a scalable, automated, observable, and cost\-attributable EoD capability. Key Technology Requirements
   

  

* Strong architecture experience across AWS, on\-premises infrastructure, and preferably GCP.
* Hands\-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform and reusable automation patterns.
* Strong experience with GitLab CI/CD, pipeline templates, automation, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of environment provisioning, application deployment, configuration management, service dependencies, and virtualisation.
* Understanding on database provisioning, test\-data management, masking and refresh strategies.
* Knowledge of cloud/on\-prem networking, compute, storage, IAM, containers and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing observability, CMDB integration, cost management and chargeback/showback capabilities.
* Strong understanding of architecture governance, security, operational models and enterprise integration.
* Ability to assess existing platforms, identify constraints, and design reusable reference architectures and implementation patterns.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management and technical leadership skills Key responsibilities
* Lead discovery of existing platform foundations, constraints, environment\-booking processes, and current operating models.
* Assess application deployability, service dependencies, configuration, databases, test data, and virtualisation requirements.
* Working closely with customer stakeholders to understand priorities, constraints, expectations, and success criteria for the EoD platform.
* Liaise with customer architecture, Environment, Testing and project teams to understand the landscape, drive alignment, resolve technical dependencies and secure decisions required to finalise the design.
* Define the EoD reference architecture, reusable IaC patterns, and architecture/governance decisions across AWS, on\-premises and GCP.
* Design and build reusable GitLab EoD pipeline templates and automation for environment provisioning and application deployment.
* Establish reusable patterns for configuration, virtualisation, test\-data provisioning, sizing, cost attribution, and observability.
* Define the EoD governance, operating model, onboarding toolkit, and implementation guidance for project teams.
* Lead pilot implementation and validate observability, CMDB integration, cost attribution, operational readiness, and architecture compliance.
* Translate pilot outcomes into recommendations, identified gaps and risks, acceptance criteria, and a prioritised next\-wave implementation backlog.

 AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Infrastructure as Code, GitLab CI, On\-Premises Infrastructure, Database Administration

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**

Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

 The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
   

  

 The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2\) focuses on second\-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains \- Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
   

  

 This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non\-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**Knowledge and Attributes:**
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) \-
+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate \- OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7\.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate \- SAP HANA 2\.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator \- WebSphere Application Server Network


**Required Experience:**
* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.

* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future.
