b213e0e1.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
b213e0e1.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

da0bc16d.title: Technical Sales Leader - Single Use Solutions
da0bc16d.description:
**The Opportunity**
**Applications / Technical Sales Manager**
**Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH) :** 
 Single\-Use Solutions \| Bioprocessing \& Sterile Injectable Manufacturing
   

  

**Business:** 
 Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH), Single\-Use Solutions
   

  

**Role level :** 
 Senior technical sales / applications leadership; 15\+ years experience
   

  

**Primary focus :** 
 Customer solution development, technical positioning, application support, and team leadership
   

  

**Industry coverage:** 
 Biopharma, biotech, vaccines, biologicals, CDMOs, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing
   

  

**Regulated\-market exposure:** 
 US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH\-regulated markets
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

**Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH)** 
 offers customized Single\-Use Solutions that cater to the unique needs of biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturers throughout the process workflow. Our solutions include single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and associated hardware designed to support critical manufacturing operations.
   

  

 The role of an Applications / Technical Sales Manager is pivotal in creating impactful solutions for our customers. With deep process knowledge, technical expertise, and commercial acumen, the individual will lead a team of Application Specialists and deliver innovative solutions that address the unique application needs of clients across biopharmaceutical, vaccine, biological, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biopharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of industry experience in Biopharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Vaccines, Biologicals, and/or Sterile Pharmaceutical Manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge across bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing workflows, including upstream processing, downstream processing, formulation, buffer/media preparation, sterile manufacturing, and fill\-finish operations.
* Experience working with external customers within the Biotech, Biologicals, Life Sciences, Vaccine, and/or Injectable Pharmaceutical industries.
* Experience supporting customers supplying products to highly regulated markets such as the United States, Europe, Japan, and other ICH\-regulated regions.
* Strong understanding of customer manufacturing processes, technical challenges, material requirements, and evolving industry expectations.


 Regulatory \& Compliance Knowledge
   

  

* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to single\-use technologies used in biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of Extractables \& Leachables (E\&L), supplier qualification programs, GMP/cGMP expectations, change control, quality risk management, sterility assurance, contamination control, validation requirements, and regulatory expectations from US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other global agencies.
* Awareness of BPOG Single\-Use guidance and USP / ISO standards relevant to single\-use systems, fluid contact materials, sterilization, biocompatibility, and particulate control.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Purpose\-driven, with passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges that advance life\-changing science.
* Customer\-focused, solution\-oriented, and able to convert technical insight into meaningful business impact.
* Strong leadership, communication, influencing, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


 Who You Are
   

  

* A Subject Matter Expert (SME) who partners closely with commercial teams, product managers, quality teams, and R\&D scientists to achieve business objectives.
* Possess deep understanding of bioprocessing workflows and/or sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
* Strong understanding of customer technical challenges, process requirements, material requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Capable of engaging effectively with stakeholders across Process Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement.
* Demonstrated project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical engagements and strategic opportunities.
* Able to develop and maintain strong technical relationships with targeted key accounts.
* Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving AFH products, solutions, and service offerings.
* Possess strong knowledge of regulatory expectations associated with single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and critical process components used in regulated manufacturing environments.


 How You Will Thrive and Create an Impact
   

  

* Play a key role in identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing project opportunities, ensuring effective support for both internal and external customers.
* Contribute to the technical positioning of AFH products within customer manufacturing processes and influence strategic decision\-making.
* Improve the quality, competitiveness, and value proposition of AFH products and service offerings.
* Gather, compile, and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to identify unmet needs and create differentiated solutions.
* Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging market trends to guide future product and service development.
* Stay current with industry, technology, and regulatory developments and communicate insights across the organization.
* Support local and global sales processes, strategic account management initiatives, and business growth objectives.
* Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers within strategic customer accounts.
* Provide technical and regulatory guidance regarding implementation, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of single\-use systems.
* Support customer discussions related to supplier qualification, extractables and leachables assessments, contamination control strategies, particulate risk management, sterilization validation, and change management processes.
* Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, Operations, and R\&D teams to ensure AFH solutions align with current and evolving regulations and standards.
* Participate in customer audits, technical reviews, product evaluations, and qualification activities as required.
* Support both biopharmaceutical and sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing customers in achieving compliance, operational excellence, and process optimization.


**Preferred Industry Experience**
 Candidates with experience supporting leading biopharmaceutical, vaccine, CDMO, biologics, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturers supplying regulated markets such as US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH\-regulated regions will be highly preferred.
   

  

 Biopharma / Biotech Applications
   

  

 Sterile Injectable / Regulated Pharma Applications
   

  

 Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs)
   

  

 VaccinesRecombinant proteins
   

  

 Cell \& gene therapies
   

  

 Plasma products
   

  

 CDMO biologics manufacturing
   

  

 Aseptic / fill\-finish operations
   

  

 Sterile injectables
   

  

 Small Volume Parenterals (SVPs)
   

  

 Large Volume Parenterals (LVPs)
   

  

 Complex generic injectables
   

  

 US \& EU regulated\-market supply
   

  

 Success Profile
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate combines deep bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing expertise, strong understanding of single\-use technologies, knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements for regulated markets, proven technical sales and key account management experience, leadership capability to build high\-performing technical teams, and the ability to translate customer needs into commercially successful solutions.

 employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of

ee01f726.title: Associate Strategic Program Manager
ee01f726.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**


MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.


### **\*\*This position will be based on\-site in our Bangalore office, working overnight IST hours to support the US Pacific Standard Time zone.\*\***


### **Impact In This Role**


As an Associate Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at Fictiv, you will work alongside some of the world’s leading enterprises and innovative startups to help accelerate their product launches while maintaining the highest quality standards. In this role, you will closely support the Strategic Program Management team in executing complex programs, helping ensure customers’ products launch on time, within budget, and at optimal quality.


You will collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Costing \& DFM, Quality, and Logistics teams to keep projects on track and aligned with customer expectations. With a focus on continuous improvement, you will also contribute ideas and drive internal process improvement and enhance the overall customer experience.


### **What You’ll Be Doing**


* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and support customer\-facing interactions as needed to deliver high\-quality service
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date program status across multiple systems to support business decision\-making processes
* Apply your knowledge of operations or manufacturing to identify process gaps, risks, and drive operational improvements
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance program efficiency and customer satisfaction
* Track and report on program milestones, supporting adjustments to timelines and deliverables to meet quality and delivery standards
* Support customer change requests and project updates on multiple platforms (external and internal)
* Ability to travel 10% annually
* Quality: All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS

### **Desired Traits**


* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering
* 3\+ years of manufacturing operations experience or 1\-2 years of related experience
* Detail\-oriented, strong organizational, program management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience working with diverse, cross\-functional teams is a plus
* Proactive self\-starter with a passion for learning, continuous improvement, and driving operational success
* Experience working with global manufacturing sites, in customer\-facing role is preferred
* Familiarity with ITAR and EAR regulations, particularly ECCN classifications such as 9A515, is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes such as CNC Machining, 3D Printing, Injection Molding, Sheet Metal Fabrication, Die Casting, or Assembly is preferred
* Technically savvy with a strong interest in leveraging AI tools and automation technologies to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and enhance operational performance
* This position will be based in Bangalore, working US PST time zone shift.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

**Overview**
* Leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.


**Scope**
* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.
* Core responsibilities include Strategy, Architecting, Design/Development (along with counterparts, customer, and Architects) and leading the technical team on projects and delivery initiatives catered around Supply Chain Planning solution and capabilities implementation.


**Desired Skills And Experience**
* Knowledge on
* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks certifications or awareness is an added advantage.
* Next Gen Skills \- Data Science, Data Analytics, Agile, Python, AI/ML, Cloud Fun, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Databases/Data Platforms(emerging) – Snowflake, MongoDB, NoSQL, etc
* Reporting Skills – MS PowerBI
* Professional Attributes:
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Stakeholder management, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Excellent organization and project documentation skills
* Meticulous planning with attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of Supply Chain Planning and how it integrates with other systems. Any industry specific experience is a big plus.


**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and mentor team of technical associates on Solution implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
* Estimate the workload of implementation activities that are within the scope of their skills; assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture.
* Able to work and own initiatives for the technical planning team (Professional Services) and demonstrate good skills in leading the strategy and contribute towards complex customer assessment and sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Global Team/Partners and Customers or internal stakeholders.

* Documentation Support \- Technical aspects of Blue Yonder Solutions, including technical specifications, configuration details, and user manuals.
* Implementation and steady state support, contribute on internal development projects and activities.
* Contribute to the growth of the technical professional services practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral, assets, and accelerators.
* Continuously upskill Blue Yonder’ s product suite and technology innovation to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer. Incumbent should be up to date on the Product Roadmap and strategy and need to have a synergy with cross functional team(s).
* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time\-to\-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree and 14\+ years of experience in Software industry; ideally a candidate who has started as a Consultant and has worked his/her way to leading the technical team on 5\+ complete implementation cycles.
* Demonstrable understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design principles
* Experience working with large customers in challenging environments and having design/implemented enterprise application solutions and integration architectures.
* Demonstrable experience leading, building, deploying and maintenance of enterprise solutions (cloud or on\-premises)
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Strong programming experience and problem\-solving skills
* Supply Chain Planning Industry Experience
* Expertise on performance tuning techniques and ability to assist other team members with benchmarking and sizing exercises.
* Possess technical expertise on emerging technologies and integration with different database and scripting languages like Python, SQL/PLSQL, Linux, etc
* Good understanding of Web Technologies and API fundamentals
* Strong understanding on Cloud and Architectural design (Azure or equivalent, Microservices Architecture, Multi\-Tenant)
* Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder SCPO Platform.
* Hands\-on development skills; should not have moved away from development activities.
* Passionate about working with new and emerging technologies, products and demonstrates the ability to learn quickly, and have good interpersonal \& communication

eb06ba4e.description:
**Why HSBC**
------------


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Platform Architect, focusing on Infrastructure area to shape, govern, and drive the infrastructure architecture for our AI Platform across multi\-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud) and on‑prem environments. This role sets the infrastructure direction for onboarding new platform capabilities, ensuring alignment to HSBC enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards, and providing clear technical leadership to infrastructure engineering teams to execute.


You’ll act as a trusted infrastructure consultant to engineering, product, and control functions—translating AI platform needs into pragmatic, supportable infrastructure designs that are secure, scalable, resilient, and compliant.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------


'1\. Define and govern infrastructure architecture for the AI Platform: reference architectures, standards, guardrails, patterns and roadmaps across cloud and also on‑prem environments.  

2\. Provide technical direction and design authority for infrastructure engineering teams, including solution reviews, design approvals, and delivery oversight.  

3\. Lead vendor/product evaluation and adoption (e.g. GPU platforms, Kubernetes distributions, storage and networking solutions, observability stacks), ensuring fit with HSBC infrastructure requirements, support models, and lifecycle management.  

4\. Partner closely with HSBC platform and infrastructure team on on‑prem platform development, integration with existing data center capabilities, and operational readiness.  

5\. Design and guide implementation of GPU infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (capacity planning, scheduling, tenancy/isolation, performance, reliability, cost controls).  

6\. Embed security, compliance, and operational controls by design, working with Cyber Security, Data, Model Risk Management (MRM), and other stakeholders (e.g., identity, encryption, logging, vulnerability management, auditability).  

7\. Ensure production\-grade non\-functionals: availability, disaster recovery, monitoring/alerting, SLOs, incident readiness, and automation (IaC, CI/CD enablement where relevant).

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


'1\. Proven infrastructure architecture leadership for large\-scale platforms, including defining reference architectures, standards, guardrails, and roadmaps across cloud and on‑prem.  

2\. Proven ability to produce clear, practical infrastructure designs that translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, reusable and maintainable platform solutions.  

3\. Hands\-on experience building and delivering platform capabilities across both cloud and on\-premises environments, with a strong understanding of production engineering and operational considerations.  

4\. Good knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud, including core services, networking, identity, and security principles.  

5\. Experience with modern platform engineering practices, including APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, and observability.  

6\. Familiarity with infrastructure as code, policy as code, and reusable platform patterns.  

7\. Experience evaluating and adopting vendor products/services (e.g., Kubernetes distributions, GPU solutions, observability tooling) and aligning them to enterprise support, lifecycle, and operational models.  

8\. Strong stakeholder management skills: able to build trusted relationships with engineering, product, and control functions; translate complex requirements into pragmatic infrastructure designs.

**What additional skills will be good to have?**

* Good understanding of Agent, skill and MCP processing patterns, including deployment architecture, runtime operations, performance, and reliability considerations
* Familiarity with FinOps / cost optimisation approaches for platform infrastructure, especially for GPU and high\-throughput data workloads
* Knowledge of service management and reliability practices (problem management, root\-cause analysis, continuous service improvement, post\-incident actions aligned to NFRs/SLOs).
* Knowledge of GPU ecosystem (e.g., scheduling strategies, partitioning, performance tuning, capacity management, and cost governance for accelerated compute).
* Experience defining platform architecture principles, standards, and target\-state roadmaps to guide consistent design and delivery

666816c8.description:
**Role: Senior Cloud Engineer**
 Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

 Department: Product Development
   

  

**About GHX:**
 GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud\-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI\-driven capabilities.
   

  

 Website: https://www.ghx.com/
   

  

 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/
   

  

**About Role:**
 The Senior Cloud Engineer leads the design, implementation, and operations of the organization’s cloud infrastructure. This role is responsible for complex projects, high\-level architectural planning, and making strategic technology decisions that support scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization. Acting as a technical leader, the Senior Cloud Engineer provides mentorship to junior and mid\-level engineers while driving innovation, resiliency, and compliance in cloud environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Design and Implementation**
* Lead the design and implementation of cloud\-native architectures and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Oversee cloud engineering projects, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, and cost\-effective.
* Contribute to high\-level architectural planning and strategic decision\-making around technology adoption.
* Review and approve design proposals, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, and automation workflows.
* Identify risks in design and implementation plans and develop mitigation strategies.


**Management and Maintenance**
* Oversee the management of cloud resources across multiple platforms and environments.
* Lead performance tuning, scaling strategies, and cost optimization efforts.
* Make strategic decisions regarding upgrades, cloud service adoption, and configuration changes.
* Ensure adherence to operational standards, SLAs, and governance policies.


**Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution**
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex, high\-impact issues across cloud platforms.
* Oversee incident response and problem resolution by guiding junior and mid\-level engineers.
* Develop and implement proactive strategies to reduce recurring issues and increase platform reliability.
* Serve as the final escalation point for cloud\-related technical problems.


**Security and Compliance**
* Lead cloud security initiatives, including IAM strategy, data encryption, logging, monitoring, and incident response.
* Oversee vulnerability management and implement security automation in cloud environments.
* Ensure compliance with industry frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, or NIST.
* Develop strategies to improve security posture and enforce governance across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments.


**Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning**
* Lead cloud disaster recovery and continuity planning efforts across critical workloads.
* Conduct advanced risk assessments, failover testing, and recovery exercises.
* Make strategic decisions about resilience design, including multi\-region, high availability, and backup solutions.
* Drive improvements to disaster recovery strategies to align with evolving business needs.


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in cloud engineering or IT infrastructure, with increasing technical leadership responsibilities.
* Deep expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and familiarity with multi\-cloud environments.
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and automation tools (e.g., GitHub/GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines).
* Advanced knowledge of networking, container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS/ECS), and operating systems.
* Hands\-on experience with VMware virtualization (vSphere/ESXi) including vSAN\-based hyperconverged storage design, deployment, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Hyper\-V failover clustering using Storage Spaces Direct (S2D) for hyperconverged infrastructure.
* Proven experience with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.
* Demonstrated leadership, mentorship, and project management skills.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking abilities.

 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

 who enjoys solving complex data problems and takes ownership from design through delivery. You can work from home (anywhere in INDIA, job location is in India).
 



**Experience Level:** 
 Senior (8\+ years overall, 2\+ years hands\-on with Microsoft Fabric)
 **DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE AT LEAST 5\+ YEARS OF EXPERIENCE. THIS IS A SENIOR POSITION** 




  





 This role is ideal for someone who can build scalable data pipelines on
 **Microsoft Azure Fabric** 
 , leverage AI to improve engineering productivity, and work closely with business and technical stakeholders.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Senior Platform Architect with strong DevOps expertise to design, implement, and operationalize our Microsoft Fabric data platform. You'll own the architecture of our unified data estate — spanning OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Synapse Data Engineering, Power BI, and Real\-Time Analytics — while building the CI/CD, governance, and automation backbone that lets our data teams ship reliably and securely. This is a hands\-on architecture role: you'll set technical direction and also build it yourself.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design and own the end\-to\-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake data lake structure, workspace and capacity strategy, domain/workspace segregation, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering.
* Define and implement DevOps practices for Fabric: Git integration, deployment pipelines, environment promotion (dev/test/prod), and infrastructure\-as\-code for Fabric items (lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, semantic models).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) for Fabric artifacts, including automated testing, validation, and rollback strategies.
* Architect and enforce governance, security, and access controls across Fabric — workspace roles, OneLake data access policies, sensitivity labels, row\-level security, and integration with Microsoft Purview.
* Design capacity planning and cost optimization strategies for Fabric capacity units (CUs), monitoring consumption and tuning workloads to control spend.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to standardize development patterns, reusable templates, and best practices across Fabric workloads (Data Factory, Data Engineering/Spark, Data Warehouse, Real\-Time Intelligence, Power BI).
* Own monitoring, alerting, and observability for the platform using Fabric monitoring hub, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* Lead migration efforts from legacy platforms (Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, on\-prem SSIS/SQL Server, or other cloud data warehouses) onto Microsoft Fabric.
* Mentor engineering teams on Fabric architecture patterns, DevOps practices, and operational excellence.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for platform reliability, performance, and incident response.



  





**What You Bring** 



* 8\+ years of experience in data platform architecture, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps engineering roles.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, or deep equivalent experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, and Azure Data Factory with a clear path to Fabric.
* Strong command of OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture, Delta Lake/Parquet formats, and medallion architecture design.
* Proven DevOps expertise: Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipeline design (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep, Terraform, or ARM templates) for Azure/Fabric resources.
* Solid understanding of Fabric security model — workspace roles, item\-level permissions, OneLake data access roles, sensitivity labels, and integration with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Purview.
* Experience with Fabric capacity management, performance tuning, and cost governance (CU monitoring, throttling, smoothing).
* Hands\-on skills in at least one of: PySpark/Spark SQL, T\-SQL, Python, or KQL for pipeline and query development.
* Experience integrating Fabric with external tools — APIs, Power Automate, Azure Functions, or third\-party data sources.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate architecture decisions for both technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Prior experience leading platform migrations to modern data platforms is a strong plus.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Microsoft certifications: DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), DP\-203 (Azure Data Engineer), or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Power BI semantic model optimization and DirectLake mode.
* Familiarity with data mesh or domain\-driven data architecture principles.
* Background in regulated industries requiring strict data governance (finance, healthcare, etc.).

**City:** Pune
  
**State/Province:** Maharashtra

**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

**Role:**  

The purpose of the role is to provide assurance on the quality of deployment for the assigned accounts and support in establishing mechanisms that enhance and sustain customer satisfaction levels. The role is expected to support in enhancing customer advocacy by predicting and preventing customer escalations \& dissatisfactions and drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts.
  
  

͏

Implement deployment quality strategy for the assigned Accounts
  
Provide inputs in the development of strategy for the assigned accounts while considering the quality standards, client expectations, quality, and monitoring mechanisms
  
Review and reallocate the priorities to align with the overall strategy of the line of business / business unit
  
Quality control and Customer satisfaction
  
Support the completion of Annual Customer Satisfaction survey by ensuring completion of survey by the account customers, representatives for various projects within the account.
  
Ensure completion of survey and address any queries in a timely manner.
  
Support in conceptualizing the action planning by communicating with clients and interacting with Delivery Managers, vertical delivery heads and service delivery heads
  
Drive the account wise tracking of action planning identified for sustained CSAT in various projects.
  
Drive the Quarterly pulse survey for selected accounts or projects for periodic check\-ins.
  
Support the Account Leadership teams for tracking and managing client escalation for closure.
  
Early Warnings and Business partnership
  
Drive the implementation of mechanisms for preventing client escalations / dis\-satisfactions by creating an early warning system in DigiQ covering aspects like delivery quality, delivery schedule, resources constraints, financial issues (overloading of effort / over\-run potential), productivity, and slippages on milestones.
  
Participate in Monthly and Quarterly Business review along with Business and Account leadership to ensure adherence of defined quality processes, define new life cycle models and ensure gating processes are followed the projects within the accounts.
  
Drive the upskilling of delivery teams on quality management tools, knowledge management and create mechanisms for sharing of best practices.
  
Support the collection of metrics on the performance / health of process and regular publishing of compliance and metrics dashboards.
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts to ensure enhance efficiency and productivity of resources
  
Create mechanisms between the projects in the account for sharing knowledge, quality issues, risk mitigation methods within the accounts to drive the continuous improvement
  
Plan and drive year on year improvement goals in various projects by way of process streamlining \& improvements and automation, leading to cost savings and / or efficiency
  
Support the collection of metrics to show the improvements\- efficiency / productivity improvement.
  
͏
  
Team Management
  
Team Management

Assign goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
  
Guide the team members in acquiring relevant knowledge and develop their professional competence

Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team

Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the tea
  
Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
  
͏

Quality Control and Customer satisfaction
  
  

CSAT Score\-BU/Account/Portfolio level
  
Process Compliance/Exceptions Scores
  
Audit Coverage percentage
  
Schedule performance Scores
  
Planned vs actual project effort
  
Resource productivity scores
  
  

2\.
  
  

Capability Building
  
  

New Employee Onboarding
  
New Employee Certifications

Continuous Improvement
  
  

Lean projects implemented per year
  
Productivity improvement of resources
  
Continuous Improvement Processes implemented per year

Team Management
  
  

Team attrition %
  
Employee satisfaction scores
  
  

5\.
  
  

Capability Building
  
  

% trained on domain and location specific skills,
  
% of team trained in necessary leadership skills
  
  

͏
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Design, configure, and implement solutions using Genesys Cloud CX , including routing, IVR flows, queues, user and role management, integrations, and analytics.
  
Develop and maintain Architect flows for calls, chat, email, bots, as well as workforce and quality management setups.
  
Integrate Genesys Cloud CX with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Dynamics365 ) and other platforms via APIs or web services.
  
Optimize call flows, routing logic, analytics dashboards, and reporting to enhance customer experience and efficiency.
  
  

Required Experience and Skills
  
  

Experience of working with Genesys Cloud CX .
  
Experience of Routing , outbound and digital channels, workforce management, quality management, and API integrations .

Strong understanding of telephony concepts, including SIP, SBCs, trunking, codecs, and call flows .
  
Scripting experience (JavaScript or Python) is a plus.
  
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  
  

Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and practices.

**Experience:** 8\-10 Years .

Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**About The Company**
 Abacus.AI is a pioneering company in the field of Generative AI, dedicated to shaping the future of work through innovative AI\-powered solutions. Our mission is to empower enterprises and professionals by automating workflows, enhancing productivity, and unlocking new capabilities that drive business growth. With a focus on cutting\-edge technology, we develop and deploy advanced AI platforms that address complex business challenges and create meaningful impact. Our commitment to innovation and excellence has positioned us as a leader in the AI industry, serving a diverse global client base with solutions that are scalable, reliable, and easy to integrate.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager to join our dynamic team remotely from India. In this role, you will be instrumental in driving the successful execution of strategic technical programs across multiple teams, including engineering, product, design, and business units. Your leadership will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with our company’s strategic objectives. You will act as a key liaison among cross\-functional teams, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and ensuring seamless communication. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background combined with excellent project management skills, enabling them to oversee complex initiatives in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 4–7 years of experience in technical program or project management roles
* Current experience as a Technical Program Manager or Technical Project Manager
* Solid understanding of software development processes and system architecture
* Proven experience managing complex, cross\-functional engineering programs
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills
* Experience working in fast\-paced product organizations with rapid release cycles (weekly or faster)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities with a bias for action
* Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, invoicing, revenue systems, or financial transactions
* Preferred: Prior experience at a payments/fintech company or ownership of billing/payment initiatives


**Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of strategic technical programs, ensuring alignment with business goals
* Develop comprehensive program plans, define key milestones, and monitor progress to ensure timely execution
* Manage project dependencies, identify and mitigate risks, and resolve blockers to maintain momentum
* Coordinate effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, and Business teams to facilitate smooth collaboration
* Lead release planning activities, ensuring high\-quality and timely product deliveries
* Track program health using relevant metrics, generate reports, and communicate updates to senior leadership
* Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency and delivery predictability
* Ensure that project execution remains aligned with strategic business priorities and customer impact


**Benefits**
 At Abacus.AI, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' well\-being and professional growth. Our offerings include competitive salary packages, flexible remote work arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. Employees have access to health insurance, paid time off, and wellness programs to promote a healthy work\-life balance. We foster an inclusive and innovative work environment where ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged. Additionally, our team members benefit from exposure to cutting\-edge AI technologies and the chance to contribute to products that are transforming industries worldwide.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Abacus.AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse team fosters innovation and drives better business outcomes, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates.

83b8ea0e.title: GDS Meetings and Events-M and E Program Manager
83b8ea0e.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description:** 
 GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
   

  

**Job title:** 
 GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
   

  

**Function:** 
 Ernst \& Young Global Services – Supply Chain Services
   

  

**Sub\-function:** 
 Travel, Meetings \& Event Services
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The
 **GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager** 
 is a highly responsible role who will oversee Meetings and Events related spend and support M\&E program activities across GDS locations globally. The role will act as a key day\-to\-day point of contact for GDS stakeholders on program management, operational requirements, reporting, supplier performance, and process improvement initiatives supporting the Global M\&E program.
   

  

 The role will work closely with Meetings \& Events colleagues, suppliers, internal business stakeholders, procurement, finance and other enabling teams to promote M\&E policies, guidelines and procedures, drive compliance, improve stakeholder experience and support cost\-saving opportunities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to operate independently, influence stakeholders across levels and geographies, and contribute to the broader purpose and objectives of EY’s Travel, Meetings \& Events program.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program management and stakeholder partnership**
* Be the primary point of contact for GDS stakeholders on M\&E program management, operational queries, reporting requirements and policy guidance.
* Support senior stakeholders across GDS locations and provide guidance on Meetings \& Events related matters, ensuring alignment with global program objectives.
* Promote the values, objectives and strategy of the Meetings \& Events program and broader procurement function in all stakeholder interactions.
* Influence change and support the implementation of the Global M\&E strategy across relevant GDS locations and business groups.


**Event operations, sourcing and supplier management**
* Oversee and support venue sourcing, event planning and supplier engagement for GDS meetings and events, ensuring solutions are aligned to stakeholder requirements and business needs.
* Be the escalation point for supplier\-related matters and help maintain strong supplier relationships through performance monitoring, policy alignment and contractual delivery.
* Support M\&E related RFPs, vendor onboarding, supplier renewals and other procurement activities as required.


**Policy, compliance and governance**
* Promote and support compliance with EY’s Meetings \& Events policies, Supply Chain Services policy, corporate meetings policy, procurement policy and related procedures.
* Ensure compliance with EY standardised meeting contracts, addendums, framework agreements and relevant internal processes.
* Review business compliance with the overall M\&E program, including BRIDGE, Independence, Finance and Procurement processes.
* Influence policy and standards relating to M\&E spend, including venue, meals, agencies and related event categories.
* Support adoption of viable process solutions aligned with global standards, including process governance and operational controls.


**Financial management, reporting and performance**
* Help prepare initial and final event or meeting budgets and support cost management throughout the event lifecycle.
* Drive cost efficiencies and supplier negotiations, ensuring value\-add opportunities are reviewed and exhausted where applicable.
* Review data reporting, identify cost\-saving opportunities and present relevant insights to stakeholders.
* Manage and report key performance indicators to monitor program effectiveness, supplier performance and operational efficiency


**Process improvement and global alignment**
* Lead and support GDS M\&E projects, including expansion of the M\&E catalogue across GDS locations and harmonisation of processes with global teams
* Identify and recommend best practices by networking with Travel Management Company colleagues, venue sourcing teams, suppliers and industry peers.
* Contribute ideas and best practices to improve M\&E processes, stakeholder experience and program efficiency.
* Support use of relevant M\&E tools and intake channels, including Cvent and other internal systems, to ensure event requests are accurately assigned and managed.


**Teaming and leadership**
* Work closely with direct reports, M\&E support personnel and extended support teams to deliver consistent program outcomes.
* Provide guidance to meeting requestors, meeting planners, third\-party providers and internal stakeholders on program requirements and event execution
* Demonstrate strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills when working with senior leaders, suppliers and cross\-functional teams.


**Supervision Responsibilities**
 This role will have responsibility for M\&E support personnel and will work closely with the extended M\&E support team to support program delivery across GDS locations.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator, self\-motivated, detail\-oriented and results\-driven, with the ability to work independently and engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
   

  

 The candidate should demonstrate strong organisational skills, the ability to prioritise effectively, commercial awareness, attention to detail, calmness under pressure and a passion for delivering high\-quality event and program outcomes
   

  

 The role requires strong stakeholder management, supplier management, analytical thinking, process improvement orientation and the ability to support change across a complex, global and cross\-cultural environment.
   

  

**Education**
* Fluent written and spoken English language skills are required
* A degree in Business, Hospitality, Travel, Procurement or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Additional Asian language skills may be beneficial for broader regional stakeholder engagement, although they are not mandatory.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant corporate experience managing Meetings \& Events programs or working in a senior role in the travel, hospitality, meeting planning, venue sourcing, destination management or travel management industry.
* Experience managing large, complex events or M\&E programs in a multinational, service\-focused or cross\-cultural environment is highly beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
* Experience with Cvent, meeting intake tools, data reporting, Power BI, Power Platform, Ariba or related procurement and event technology platforms will be an added advantage.


**Job Requirements**
 Due to the global nature of EY, the candidate will be expected to work flexibly with colleagues in person and virtually across multiple time zones.
   

  

 A stable and reliable home internet connection is required for effective remote teaming, and the role may require working from the EY GDS office in India, based on local policies.
   

  

 Some international travel may be required, and the candidate should have a valid passport or the ability to obtain one. There may also be occasions where work outside regular business hours is required due to collaboration across multiple time zones.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a confident, collaborative and commercially minded program manager who can work with senior stakeholders, suppliers and global colleagues to deliver efficient, compliant and high\-quality Meetings \& Events outcomes. The right candidate will bring a calm\-under\-pressure mindset, strong ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to influence change while continuously improving the stakeholder experience.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

11c0c5ec.title: Technical Program Manager, Amazon Freight
11c0c5ec.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are building a large tech organization for Amazon Freight from scratch. Amazon Freight is now part of Amazon Supply Chain Services and is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. To grow our Less\-Than\-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload (TL) business continues, we are looking to building state of the art and brand new (1\) network capabilities (2\) shipper/seller facing capabilities (3\) science capabilities execution optimization.
  

The new team will be building foundational core capabilities around (1\) Shipment Execution\- Quoting and Booking, Carrier/Driver Workflow , Shipper Workflow ,shipper signals, Driver/Shipper Handoffs, 3P Site Intelligence, demand side Disruption Mgmt (2\) Trailer Operations \- Trailer Pool Mgmt. , Equipment Assignment, Quality \& Prep (3\) Scheduling \& Optimization \- Shipper Scheduling workflow, Cost\-Optimal Demand shaping, Cancellations/Reschedules (4\) Cost, Demand \& Volume Planning \- Cost Planning \& Prediction , Forecasting.  

This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, is comfortable making data\-driven decisions in ambiguous environments and has experience translating complex transportation economics into scalable network execution strategies. If you are passionate about solving complex transportation problems, influencing cross\-functional partners, and building innovative supply chain capabilities that create value for customers while driving sustainable business growth, we'd love to speak with you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

2e8723ef.title: Senior Program Manager, IPV Process OPS
2e8723ef.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking a Program Manager who will be part of Global Process Owner team for our In person Verification (IPV) function focusing on IPV at Seller / Amazon locations. This role will be part of our Amazon Registration \& Compliance Operations (VRMO) organization. The VRMO organization is responsible for making Amazon the safest and most trusted place on Earth by protecting the innocent and deterring the 'ill\-intentioned'. Protecting the interests of the end users is our top priority, balancing being compliant and giving a great customer experience. Our team achieves this objective through a combination of automated and manual investigations of the seller transactions on our marketplace.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Identification, execution \& delivery of programs \& projects targeted at reducing bad actors world wide
* Support implementation of GenAI initiatives and programs, that would reduce effort and improve seller experience.
* Partner with cross functional teams, Business Stakeholders, Finance to identify ongoing opportunities to collaborate on bad actor identification and reduction.
* Support Implementation and execution of governance of the programs from partner teams including process, tools, audit, inspection, mechanisms.
* Effective design, implementation, execution of the Change Management related to new program launches
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Prior risk experience is an added advantage
* Large scale project management experience in leading multi\-organizational initiatives, and driving team accountability to achieve impactful goals
* Experience working in an Operations environment, driving improvements that have resulted in measurable business impact
* Proven analytical aptitude, including the ability to mine and analyze large, complex data sets
* Six sigma black belt level capabilities in deconstructing processes and metrics, to identify areas of opportunity and lead the development and implementation of new processes
* Good oral, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to work well in a team environment and work under tight deadlines
* Influencing skills and negotiation skills
* Ability to drive projects efficiently in a cross\-functional environment by establishing respect and confidence in the business and technical communities
* Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship
* 7\+ years experience in program or project management
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 3\+ years experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Proven analytical aptitude, including the ability to mine and analyze large, complex data sets ·
* Influencing skills and negotiation skills ·
* Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship ·
* MBA or Masters degree in related field · Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) ·
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt
* Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon

d4f0896e.title: Presales Engineer
d4f0896e.description:
**Presales Engineer \- WAF**
 Job Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Presales Engineer specializing in Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions who will support the sales team by providing technical expertise during the sales cycle. The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer application security needs, designing WAF solutions, delivering demos, and supporting POCs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 \- Work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements related to web application security.
   

 \- Provide technical presales support for Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions.
   

 \- Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, and proof of concepts (POC) to prospective clients.
   

 \- Design WAF architectures and security solutions based on customer environments.
   

 \- Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires.
   

 \- Support customers during product evaluation and deployment planning.
   

 \- Collaborate with technical, product, and delivery teams to ensure smooth implementation.
   

 \- Stay updated on latest web application threats, OWASP vulnerabilities, and security trends.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \- Minimum 5 years of experience in Cyber Security Presales / Security Engineering
   

 \- Hands\-on knowledge of Web Application Firewall (WAF) technologies
   

 \- Understanding of web application security threats (OWASP Top 10\)
   

 \- Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, web servers, APIs, and application architectures
   

 \- Experience with product demos, solution design, and POCs
   

 \- Good understanding of network security and application security concepts
   

 \- Strong presentation and customer\-facing communication skills
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 \- Experience with one or more WAF solutions
   

 \- Knowledge of DevSecOps, cloud security, or API security is an added advantage

7d94d438.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
7d94d438.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians have flexibility in where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed\-first company.
   

  

 Atlassian is seeking an exceptional Solutions Engineer who is passionate about addressing complex customer challenges and securing significant enterprise deals. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the enterprise sales team and regional channel partners to gain a deep understanding of our customers' needs. You will strategize on navigating various scenarios, deliver compelling demonstrations, and ultimately drive business closure. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring that our solutions effectively meet the demands of our clients, contributing to their success and the growth of Atlassian.
   

  

**Your future team**
 With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca\-Cola advance humanity through the power of incredible software that unleashes the potential of every team.
   

  

 With a focus on value selling, we help our customers understand how our products combine to create enterprise solutions that transform their business’s outcomes. We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. Our employees work with Atlassian, not for Atlassian.
   

  

 Our team enjoys high earnings potential with the enterprise white space opportunity ahead of us, selling impactful products that are at the forefront of cloud and artificial intelligence utilization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategic Technical Engagement: Partner with sales to engage in customer discovery, identifying business challenges and desired outcomes while mapping them to Atlassian’s value propositions and solutions.
* Opportunity Identification: Identify opportunities for cross\-product and solution expansion to maximize customer value.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and understand client pain points to craft meaningful solutions.
* Product Expertise: Act as a product expert, clearly articulating and demonstrating how Atlassian’s software drives collaboration and productivity.
* Value\-Driven Demonstrations: Deliver engaging demonstrations showcasing how Atlassian’s solutions empower teams and drive outcomes.
* Technical Sales Leadership: Guide customers on best practices and implementation strategies to achieve success with Atlassian software.
* Sales Collaboration: Build strong partnerships with sales counterparts to improve engagement and optimize the sales cycle.
* Customer Advocacy: Gather customer feedback and competitive insights, sharing them with product teams to influence improvements.


**Qualifications**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* 5\-7\+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Engineering, or working in customer facing roles for technology vendors or technology driven organizations.
* Deep knowledge of Atlassian’s product suite and ability to articulate its value in solving complex business challenges.
* Proven experience delivering impactful product/solution demonstrations and leading technical evaluations.
* Ability to identify solution expansion opportunities and align with customer goals.
* Highly organized, able to work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence technical and business stakeholders, with the ability to present to and persuade varied audiences.
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for solving problems and empowering customers, along with a “roll\-up\-your\-sleeves” approach focused on execution and continuous improvement.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

f0761eac.title: Presales and Solutions Engineer — Power Systems and Energy Software
f0761eac.description:
This is a remote position.
 


**Presales \& Solutions Engineer — Power Systems \& Energy Software**
 Location: Bangalore, India (Delhi NCR / Pune / Chennai / Trivandrum also considered)
   

 Full\-Time
   

 Experience 5\- 8 Years
   

  

**About Us:**
 Blue Ripples Technologies is a software engineering company with deep power\-systems domain expertise. We build the integration and intelligence infrastructure that grid, DER, and energy\-market software runs on — working with utilities, DER hardware makers, DERMS/VPP platforms, and energy service companies across the US and Europe. Our work spans grid protocol integration, DER fleet telemetry, demand\-response and flexibility software, and CIM/grid\-model interoperability.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We're looking for a Presales \& Solutions Engineer to be the technical\-and\-domain voice in front of our customers — utilities, DER hardware companies, and energy\-software platforms in the US and EU. You'll join discovery calls, run live product demos, help scope engagements, and translate a prospect's grid or energy\-market problem into the right solution — without needing to be the one who builds it. Our engineering team handles delivery; you own the conversation.
   

  

 This is a highly visible, customer\-facing role reporting directly to the CEO, with real autonomy in how you run discovery, shape proposals, and represent us at industry events.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 • Lead and co\-lead discovery calls with prospects — understand their grid, DER, or energy\-market operations problem and map it to what we can build
   

 • Run live technical demos of our products and platforms, tailored to the audience (utility programme manager, DERMS CTO, energy operations lead, etc.)
   

 • Write or co\-write technical sections of proposals and RFP responses
   

 • Sit in customer meetings as the domain\-and\-technical voice, working alongside our engineering team rather than instead of it
   

 • Represent the company at industry conferences and trade shows (DistribuTECH, RE\+, SEPA, and similar) — running booth demos and technical breakout conversations
   

 • Feed real customer language, objections, and competitive intel back into our product and positioning
   

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
  

**Must Have:**
 • 5–8 years in software/systems engineering or technical delivery, with genuine exposure to the power/utility/energy sector — SCADA, AMI, grid operations, renewable integration, or energy analytics. You don't need to have built a DERMS platform, but you need to understand how one fits into a utility's world.
   

 • Prior experience in a customer\-facing or cross\-functional technical role — presales, solutions engineering, technical account management, or a delivery role that regularly required explaining technical work to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

 • Comfortable reading and discussing system architecture and integration/data\-flow concepts, without needing to build them yourself.
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be writing proposals and presenting to customers regularly.
   

  

**Nice\-to\-have:**
 • Familiarity with grid/energy protocols and standards: OpenADR, IEEE 2030\.5, DNP3, IEC 61850, SunSpec, OCPP, or CIM/CGMES.
   

 • Exposure to DERMS/VPP platforms, ISO/energy\-market operations, or utility demand\-response programme delivery.
   

 • Prior experience representing a company at industry conferences or trade shows.
   

  

  

  

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

**What We Offer**
 • A high\-autonomy, high\-visibility role with direct exposure to real customer relationships from day one
   

 • The chance to shape how a growing power\-systems software company tells its story in the market
   

 • Competitive compensation in line with the seniority and scope of this role
   

 • Domestic and occasional international travel for customer meetings and conferences
