5fc038e3.title: Staff Cloud Network Architect
5fc038e3.description:
**WHO WE ARE** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 :
 **Staff Cloud Network Architect** 




 The Staff Cloud Network Architect is a strategic, customer\-facing technical role responsible for ensuring the success of enterprise customers operating Aviatrix in production environments. As the primary technical point of contact, the Staff Cloud Network Architect partners closely with customers to understand their architecture, guide best practices, and drive long\-term platform adoption and health. This is not a sales role and focuses on customer outcomes and operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the dedicated technical point of contact for assigned enterprise customers, owning architecture design, deployment oversight, and operational excellence across their Aviatrix deployments.
* Design and validate multi\-cloud network architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) including transit networks, hub\-and\-spoke topologies, segmentation, and inter\-cloud connectivity.
* Design and implement cloud network security architectures using Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall, including microsegmentation policies, security domains, and Zero Trust network access controls.
* Lead quarterly business and technical reviews with customer stakeholders ranging from network engineers to C\-level executives, identifying optimization opportunities and demonstrating platform value.
* Act as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, driving rapid resolution while coordinating with Aviatrix TAC and Engineering teams.
* Proactively identify risks, gaps, and adoption opportunities within customer environments, then drive implementation of solutions that unlock full platform value.
* Relay customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps to Aviatrix Product and Engineering teams, serving as the internal voice of the customer.



  





**Requirements/Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise networking, cloud networking, or network security roles within production environments.
* Demonstrated expertise with at least two major public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), including VPC/VNet design, transit gateways, routing, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
* Strong foundation in BGP, SD\-WAN, MPLS, and hybrid cloud connectivity technologies such as AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, or Google Cloud Interconnect.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing network security architectures using NGFWs, IDS/IPS systems, microsegmentation, and Zero Trust network access principles.
* Proficiency with infrastructure automation and scripting using Python, Terraform, or Ansible for network provisioning and configuration management.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, or Datadog applied to network and security telemetry.
* Familiarity with cloud security compliance frameworks including SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, or NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for audiences ranging from network engineers to executive stakeholders.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on experience with Aviatrix Distributed Cloud Firewall (DCF), including smart groups, security domains, stateful inspection, and policy enforcement.
* Prior experience in a customer success, solutions engineering, or technical advisory role for enterprise infrastructure or security platforms.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator) or security (CISSP, CEH) that demonstrate advanced networking and security expertise.
* Experience integrating and managing third\-party network security solutions such as Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or Check Point within multi\-cloud environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing SD\-WAN or network segmentation solutions at scale within enterprise organizations.

You will collaborate with business, product, security, platform, operations, and engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and deliver measurable business value. As a senior professional, you will be expected to work independently on complex problems, manage development processes, and provide technical guidance to other team members.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise applications built with Angular, .NET Core, APIs, relational and non\-relational databases, and cloud\-native services
* Translate business and non\-functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable solution designs
* Define application, integration, data, security, deployment, and observability architecture across frontend, backend, third\-party services, and enterprise platforms
* Select appropriate patterns, frameworks, cloud services, and reusable components while balancing cost, performance, maintainability, and delivery speed
* Produce architecture diagrams, interface specifications, deployment models, technology decisions, and implementation guardrails
* Guide developers through design reviews, technical spikes, code reviews, and resolution of complex engineering issues
* Ensure solutions follow enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity controls, data privacy requirements, and DevSecOps practices
* Design for automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, logging, disaster recovery, and production support
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, platform teams, security, operations, and vendors to align architecture with business outcomes.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and modernization opportunities, and drive pragmatic mitigation and architectural improvements


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for solution architecture or technical design leadership
* Expert knowledge of object\-oriented design, domain\-driven design, design patterns, and distributed application architecture using C\# and .NET Core.
* Strong experience architecting modern web applications using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and component\-based frontend patterns
* Proven experience designing RESTful APIs, event\-driven integrations, identity and access controls, and integrations with enterprise and third\-party services
* Hands\-on architecture experience with AWS and container platforms such as OpenShift or Kubernetes
* Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores, including data modelling, performance, availability, security, and lifecycle considerations
* Experience with Git\-based development, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs, create clear technical documentation, and communicate decisions to both engineering and business stakeholders

 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. **Description**
 The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 14\+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


**Preferred Certifications**
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

a2330ad7.title: Cloud Architect
a2330ad7.description:
**Company Description** 
 Proximal Cloud is the creator of the world’s first Sovereign Enterprise AI Platform, combining the agility of public cloud with the control and security of private environments. Using a proprietary Hub\-and\-Spoke architecture, the company brings compute to customer data so it never leaves the organization’s security perimeter, whether on\-premise, in private cloud, or at the edge. Its platform includes Proximal Unity™ for high\-performance, population\-scale AI inference and Crania™ as an intelligence engine that unlocks “dark data” for predictive insights. Proximal Cloud emphasizes sovereign control with strong compliance capabilities (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR ready) and outbound\-only connections. In partnership with UC San Diego and AMD, the company is driving AI innovation across education, healthcare, and precision agriculture markets.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Cloud Architect at Proximal Cloud will design, implement, and optimize cloud and hybrid architectures that support the Sovereign Enterprise AI Platform. This full\-time, on\-site role in Bengaluru involves translating business and technical requirements into scalable solutions, defining architecture standards, and guiding the implementation of secure, resilient infrastructure across on\-premise, private cloud, and edge environments. The individual will collaborate with software engineering, data, and security teams to integrate AI components, manage interoperability, and ensure performance and compliance. Day\-to\-day activities include creating architecture diagrams, evaluating tools and services, leading technical reviews, and supporting deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of cloud\-native and AI workloads.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong solution design abilities, including Solution Architecture and Architecture for complex, distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure design and management across cloud, on\-premise, and hybrid environments.
* Proficiency in Software Development practices, including working with APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with system Integration, ensuring secure, reliable interoperability between platforms, services, and data sources.
* Deep understanding of major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and private cloud technologies; exposure to edge computing is a plus.
* Knowledge of security, compliance, and governance best practices, including data sovereignty and regulatory frameworks.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, architecture artifacts, and reference implementations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross\-functional and executive stakeholders.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L4\) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational by managing, overseeing, monitoring, investigating, and resolving escalated technical incidents and problems. You will proactively review client requests, applying your technical process knowledge to provide nearly immediate and permanent resolutions within our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will involve working independently, with direction from clients, stakeholders, team leads, or senior managers, to perform operational tasks and resolve escalated incidents and requests in a timely manner. You'll support clients on highly technical or complex issues, documenting resolution tasks, providing inputs for improving client infrastructure and sharing knowledge to empower other engineering teams.
   

  

 You'll actively identify, investigate, and analyse issues before they occur, ensuring all incidents are logged and relevant information is captured for immediate resolution. Your role includes providing high\-level support for escalated incidents, troubleshooting, and managing tickets passed on from third\-line engineers while documenting and sharing solutions.
   

  

 Communication is crucial, as you'll interact with teams and clients to extend support and act as an emergency contact for critical issues. during shift handovers, you will highlight any key escalated open tickets and upcoming operational tasks, ensuring a seamless transition and continuous support.

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above\-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client\-centric communication.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* A client\-first attitude, always seeking to create positive client experiences.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or equivalent work experience.


**Workplace type:**
 Hybrid Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
   

  

 Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
   

  

 responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
   

  

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
   

  

 application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
   

  

 confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
   

  

 than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
   

  

 established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
   

  

 year in R\&D.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
   

  

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
 NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. ff6db418.title: Solution Owner (Program Manager))
ff6db418.description:
Do you enjoy managing strategic initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and delivering business value? Are you ready to manage complex solution portfolios, guide them from concept to delivery, and lead cross\-functional teams to success?
   

  


 Then you could be our next…
   

  





**Solution Owner (Program Manager)**




 We are looking for a Solution Owner (Program Manager) to manage the effective development and evolution of key solutions within SKF Global Machine Health Technologies. In this role, you will oversee solution portfolios from concept to end\-of\-life, align business and development priorities, manage stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered effectively to create customer and business value.
   

  





**Key responsibilities:**




* Work closely with Product Line Managers, Development Center Managers, and other key stakeholders to align business and development priorities.
* Lead assigned Solution Categories by prioritizing and coordinating projects and initiatives, balancing business needs, dependencies, and available resources in the area of HW\-, FW\- and SW development.
* Build and lead cross\-functional teams through planning, execution, and implementation.
* Define goals and delivery plans, while monitoring progress, managing risks, ensuring quality, and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Manage resource needs and budgets, identifying gaps and addressing challenges early.
* Represent Solution Categories in key decision\-making forums and communicate progress, priorities, and business impact.
* Ensure solutions are delivered in line with SKF policies, processes, and quality standards.
* Support continuous improvement by promoting best practices in solution ownership and project management.
* Support and mentor other Solution Owners, contributing to the long\-term growth of Global Machine Health Technologies.






**What we are looking for:**




* Solid experience in project, program or portfolio management, ideally in a complex and international environment.
* Solid leadership skills and the ability to engage, motivate, and support cross\-functional teams.
* Confidence in working with stakeholders at different levels of the organization and building professional relationships.
* Ability to shape decisions, align priorities, and coordinate collaboration across teams and functions.
* Good understanding of project and product development methodologies, such as Agile, Scrum, Stage\-Gate, NMO, PDP, or similar frameworks.
* Fluent English both writ t en and spoken.






**You will enjoy this role, if you have:**




* A results\-oriented, solution\-oriented mindset with the ability to manage risks, overcome challenges, and move initiatives forward in a complex environment.
* Solid business awareness and the ability to align technology, development, and business priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to shape decisions and build effective relationships across a global organization.






**You will work closely with:**




 Product Line Managers, Development Center Managers, other Solution Owners, external partners and cross\-functional stakeholders across SKF, including Sales, Quality, and Marketing.
   

  





 SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. \#weareSKF
   

  





**Some additional information:**




 This position will be located preferably in one of our main development centers ( Luleå /Sweden, Gothenburg/Sweden, Saint\-Cyr\-sur\-Loire/France, Bangalore / India or Shanghai/China). You will report to
 **Manager, Innovation \& Solutions Management** 
 .
   

  





 For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Olga Zwolińska, Talent Acquisition Partner, who is based in Poznań, Poland, olga.zwolinska@skf.com Please note that we can't accept applications via email .
   

  





 A t SKF, we are committed to promoting fairness and inclusivity throughout our recruitment process. To achieve this, we may include assessments and verify the information in your application in compliance with country\-specific laws and regulations.
   

  





 If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact the recruiter.
   

  





**Is this you?**




 If the answer is yes, submit your application no later than
 **September 2** 
**9 th** 
**.**




 Candidates will hear from us shortly after the final application date .
   

  





**About SKF**




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

542a71cf.title: Sr. Program Manager
542a71cf.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Program Manager based in India.**
 This is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on orchestrating critical programs within a rapidly growing Commerce organization. You’ll own release planning, program governance, risk visibility, and cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, and Revenue Operations. The role sits at the intersection of customer experience, product delivery, analytics, and business strategy. You’ll turn complex priorities into structured programs with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and predictable execution. A key part of the role is creating visibility into release health, customer sentiment, activation, retention, and critical blockers. You’ll work closely with senior leaders and stakeholders while building scalable processes and feedback loops that improve how teams plan and deliver. This opportunity is ideal for a data\-driven program leader who can navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and drive meaningful change across a global SaaS environment.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Partner with organizational leaders to define release objectives, success metrics, priorities, and execution plans for critical Commerce initiatives.
* Build and maintain source\-of\-truth dashboards covering Commerce priorities, release health, key blockers, risks, customer sentiment, and other critical performance indicators.
* Lead cross\-functional programs spanning Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, and Revenue Operations.
* Translate strategic Commerce priorities into structured programs with clear owners, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive initiatives designed to improve customer activation, adoption, retention, and overall customer sentiment.
* Own release planning and governance processes, improving predictability across the software development lifecycle.
* Identify, track, communicate, and mitigate committed risks and dependencies before they impact delivery or customer outcomes.
* Contribute to quarterly and annual planning by helping teams align priorities, resources, timelines, and expected business outcomes.
* Establish and run effective operational cadences, including business reviews, stand\-ups, post\-mortems, and progress reviews.
* Present program progress, risks, insights, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership and internal stakeholders.
* Build scalable frameworks, processes, and customer feedback loops that improve execution and decision\-making across teams.
* Connect customer research, surveys, interviews, support insights, and product data back into the product development and release lifecycle.
* Mentor team members and promote stronger program management practices across the organization.


**Requirements**
* 5–7 years of total professional experience, with significant experience in Release Management, Product Analytics, Risk Management, Program Management, or related disciplines within a high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.
* 3–5\+ years of experience working on cross\-functional programs, ideally involving multiple business and technical functions.
* Experience working closely with Product Management and/or Customer Success teams on customer experience, adoption, activation, retention, or similar programs.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven mindset, with practical experience working with funnels, cohorts, retention metrics, experimentation, and self\-service analysis.
* Proficiency with SQL and/or business intelligence tools for analyzing performance data and generating actionable insights.
* Strong customer empathy and experience interpreting qualitative and quantitative customer feedback, including research, surveys, interviews, and support insights.
* Demonstrated ability to move between long\-term strategic planning and detailed execution, process improvement, and issue resolution.
* Excellent program management skills, with the ability to structure ambiguity, establish priorities, align stakeholders, and consistently drive outcomes.
* Strong release management and governance capabilities, with experience improving SDLC predictability and delivery visibility.
* Highly influential communicator who can drive change without direct authority and present complex information effectively to senior leadership.
* Systems\-oriented approach with a track record of creating scalable frameworks, operational mechanisms, processes, and feedback loops.
* Strong risk identification, prioritization, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams in a fast\-paced, distributed environment.
* High level of ownership, organization, adaptability, and attention to detail.


**Benefits**
* Location: Remote, India.
* Employment type: Full\-time.
* Role type: Individual contributor with broad cross\-functional organizational impact.
* Opportunity to influence critical Commerce programs and release strategies within a high\-growth SaaS environment.
* High degree of ownership across program planning, governance, risk management, analytics, and execution.
* Opportunity to work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and senior leadership.
* Exposure to large\-scale SaaS products, customer engagement, retention analytics, and complex cross\-functional programs.
* Remote\-first working environment designed for global collaboration and flexibility.
* Opportunity to build scalable operating mechanisms and influence how teams plan, execute, and measure outcomes.
* Professional growth through exposure to strategic initiatives and senior stakeholders across multiple disciplines.


**How Jobgether Works**
 We use an
 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

796856f7.title: Associate Director(Insurance Transformation & Delivery Leader)_1917
796856f7.description:
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an insurance professional with 20\+ years of diverse experience spanning Insurance Operations, Change Management, Business Analysis, Modern Technology Stack Architecture, Process Re\-engineering, and Large\-Scale Transformation Delivery across Individual, Group Life, and Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance lines of business.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in the India Life Insurance ecosystem—including IRDAI regulations, modern Digital Public Infrastructure, and product lifecycle management—combined with hands\-on proficiency with modern technology stacks – including Cloud\-native architectures, Agentic AI, Data platforms, and Core Policy Administration Systems (PAS). Blend of domain knowledge and technical capability will enable effective stakeholder management, solution design, and successful execution of enterprise\-wide initiatives.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Lead large\-scale transformation programs spanning Individual, Group Life, and P\&C insurance lines of business, from strategy through execution.
* Drive insurance operations improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities for change and process re\-engineering across business and technical functions.
* Own end\-to\-end business analysis for enterprise\-wide initiatives, translating business requirements into actionable solution designs.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring solutions address operational, customer, and regulatory needs.
* Manage change management efforts across impacted stakeholder groups, ensuring adoption and minimizing disruption during transformation.
* Lead cross\-functional and cross\-geography delivery teams, coordinating dependencies, risks, and milestones to achieve program objectives.
* Partner with senior business and technical stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, align on roadmaps, and secure buy\-in for enterprise\-wide change.
* Establish governance frameworks to track delivery progress, quality, and risk across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Champion continuous process improvement, identifying automation and efficiency opportunities across insurance operations.
* Support the successful execution of enterprise\-wide initiatives from inception to steady\-state operations.
* Establish Agile delivery governance, vendor ecosystems, risk frameworks, and multi\-stream delivery dependencies
* Drive AI and digital transformation initiatives across insurance value chains.
* Experience with Generative AI, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) to automate underwriting, claims processing, and customer servicing
* Evaluate, architect, and deliver modern technology solutions using cloud\-native frameworks, API\-first architectures, and modern core insurance platforms


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 18\+ years of diverse experience in the insurance industry, spanning Individual Life, Group Life, and Property \& Casualty (P\&C) lines of business.
* Strong background across Insurance Operations, Change Management, Business Analysis, and Process Re\-engineering.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale transformation delivery in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Strong track record of working across both business and technical functions, with the ability to translate between the two.
* Proven stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior business and technology leaders.
* Solid solution design capability, ensuring proposed solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business goals.
* Successful track record of executing enterprise\-wide initiatives from planning through to delivery.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Experience with Insurance core systems and their transformation/migration strategies.
* Knowledge of AI Agents, Agentic workflows, prompt engineering, RAG architectures.
* Understanding of cloud services: AWS, Azure
* Familiarity with data platforms like Databricks and BI tools.
* Experience with Microservices architecture, REST APIs, and API Management tools.
* Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform), and Agile delivery methodologies (SAFe, Scrum)
* Awareness of cybersecurity frameworks, data encryption, identity management, and compliance with data privacy regulations.
* Insurance Domain Understanding:
+ Knowledge of the Indian Life Insurance landscape including IRDAI regulations, product structures (traditional, ULIP, term, annuity, group life, micro\-insurance)
+ Understanding of KYC/AML norms, CKYC, e\-insurance accounts, product filing requirements, solvency regulations, and policyholder protection norms specific to India


 Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
   

  

 At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
   

  

 We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
   

  

 Join us
 **. Let's care for tomorrow.**

* Experience in designing and presenting enterprise technology solutions.
* Strong experience in customer\-facing presentations, product demonstrations, PoCs, and RFP/RFI responses.

* Strong communication, presentation, consulting, and stakeholder\-management skills.

83a96092.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
83a96092.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled
 **Solution Engineer** 
 to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI\-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre\-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.
   

  





**Pre\-Sales Engagement \& Customer Solutions:**



* Engage with SMB, mid\-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.
* Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.



**AI Solutioning \& Positioning:**



* Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over\-selling or over\-simplifying.
* Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.
* Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent\-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.
* Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.



**Solution Design \& Documentation:**



* Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.

ae81238f.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
ae81238f.description:
**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



  





**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

1c472010.title: AI Customer Engineer, Digital Natives, Google Cloud
1c472010.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text\-to\-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI\-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development.
   

  

 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll be leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer\-tailored solutions that secure buy\-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go\-To\-Market team.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

56811615.title: Presales Engineer - Infrastructure
56811615.description:
**Job description** 




 We are seeking an agile and technically sound
 **Infrastructure Pre\-Sales Engineer** 
 with
 **3 to 5 years of experience** 
 to join our System Integration (SI) division. In this role, you will lead the technical strategy for large\-scale
 **Indian Government, PSU, and Smart City tenders/RFPs** 
 . As an SI architect, you will not be tied to a single product line; instead, you will evaluate and stitch together multi\-vendor solutions spanning
 **Backup, Servers, Storage, and Cloud** 
 to deliver cost\-effective, high\-performing, and fully compliant bids.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Multi\-Vendor Solution Architecture:** 
 Design interoperable, end\-to\-end IT infrastructure blueprints (HLD/LLD) using a diverse mix of tier\-1 and tier\-2 OEM technologies to meet customer specifications.
* **OEM Ecosystem Management:** 
 Coordinate with strategic OEM partner networks (e.g., Cisco, HPE, Dell, NetApp, Fortinet, AWS, Azure) to register deals, negotiate special pricing, and secure mandatory
 **Manufacturer's Authorization Forms (MAF)** 
 .
* **RFP Compliance Matrix:** 
 Create exhaustive, line\-by\-line technical compliance sheets for Indian public sector tenders, identifying any restrictive clauses or hidden risks.
* **Cost Optimization \& Margin Protection:** 
 Build complex commercial models and multi\-vendor cross\-mappings to create the most aggressive
 **L1 (Lowest Bidder)** 
 or highest\-scoring
 **QCBS (Quality \& Cost Based Selection)** 
 bidding strategy.
* **Pre\-Bid Advocacy:** 
 Formulate technical queries to counter biased or restrictive specifications during the pre\-bid stage and present arguments clearly to government technical committees.
* **SI Proof of Concept (PoC):** 
 Set up and demonstrate complex, multi\-brand integrations in PoC environments to validate technology interoperability for clients.



  





**Technical Qualifications \& Core Domain Skills** 



* **Compute \& Hyperconverged Platforms:** 
 Architecture design experience with multi\-vendor x86 servers (Rack/Blade) and virtualization/HCI stacks (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper\-V, Proxmox).
* **Enterprise Storage \& Data Protection:** 
 Design proficiency in SAN, NAS, and unified storage matrices, along with automated multi\-tier backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* **MeitY\- Empaneled Cloud Services:** 
 Structural understanding of hybrid cloud integrations, public hyper scalers, and local sovereign cloud offerings approved for Indian public sector deployments.
* **Public Procurement Governance:** 
 Clear understanding of Indian financial rules (GFR 144(xi)), "Make in India" (MII) local content criteria, and land\-border registration mandates.



  





**Preferred Certifications (Good to Have)** 



* Cross\-vendor technical certifications: VMware VCP, or technical design tracks from major hardware OEMs (Dell, HPE, or Lenovo Data Center portfolios).



**Soft Skills \& Behavioral Attributes** 



* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills to balance competing OEM timelines and pricing strategies.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain absolute accuracy while handling high\-volume documentation under tight submission clocks.
* Consultative mindset to translate ambiguous public sector requirements into structured technical designs.

1050356a.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
1050356a.description:
Senior Cloud Engineer — Linux, Networking \& AWS

2\+ Years of Experience \| Bengaluru, India \| Full\-Time

If you've spent your time at a large, well\-run service organisation keeping Linux systems, networks, and AWS environments genuinely reliable — not just ticket\-closed — this role was written for you.

axcess.io is a Top\-Tier AWS Partner headquartered in Bengaluru, with active presence in the United States. We work on some of the most architecturally interesting cloud problems in the region, and we do it as a lean, senior\-heavy team. You will not be sitting in queues waiting for tickets — you will be working directly alongside the Department Head from day one.

A note from the hiring manager: We are not looking for someone who has memorised command syntax. We want someone who has kept real systems up — patched a Linux box under pressure, traced a network issue back to the actual cause, and cares enough about the outcome to fix it properly, not just close the ticket. If you're currently at a large service company and quietly better than the tickets you're handed, we would very much like to meet you.

What you'll be doing:

\- Linux Systems Administration — Manage, patch, and troubleshoot production Linux environments (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu). You will be fixing root causes, not restarting services.

\- Cloud Infrastructure Support — Day\-to\-day operations on AWS — EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS — provisioning, monitoring, and keeping environments healthy.

MedInsight products, education, and services make an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing wasteful services. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.
   

  

 MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee\-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics, and business transformation, as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The MedInsight Strategic Analytics Services team is looking for a Technical Solutions Architect (Cloud Engineer) to support a variety of healthcare analytics, predictive analytics, and digital transformation projects, leveraging a variety of data types. As a member of the technical staff and a trusted advisor to clients, this professional will join our team to assist in all phases of technical consulting work, including requirements gathering, scalable solution design, data architectures, research, and development. The successful candidate will have strong analytic, technical, and communication skills, and the ability to partner in the delivery of business value to diverse organizations, manage multiple simultaneous projects and innovate solutions that leverage a cloud\-first environment.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work both independently and in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Listen to, understand, and break client questions down into manageable tasks.
* Be comfortable in presenting and discussing ideas with senior leaders of client organizations and Milliman MedInsight.
* Understand client business goals and strategic context and harvest requirements from client organizations.
* Work independently on assigned tasks, i.e., plan, organize, delegate, problem solve, and meet established deadlines.
* Develop senior technical staff through involvement with effectively aligned cross\-functional teams.
* Prioritize work under time pressure. Follow\-through and exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks are essential.
* Use a variety of proprietary products and technologies to answer simple and complex client questions.
* Turn data results into client\-facing deliverables that are informative and easy\-to\-use.
* Standardize ad hoc processes and drive continuous improvement for automating and optimizing performance of ongoing processes.
* Assist senior technical staff with the support of, upgrades of, and modifications to, existing advanced data products.
* Ensure clear and comprehensive documentation of analytic methodologies and new technical approaches.
* Represent MedInsight at client meetings and trainings.


**Basic Qualifications**
 Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant work experience. Preference will be given to candidates with healthcare data experience and cloud solutions experience. Previous experience working with large healthcare claims and/or EHR databases preferred.
   

  

**General**
* Working knowledge of healthcare concepts and data structures.
* Familiarity with healthcare claims data and data analytic platforms.
* Ability to prioritize and manage concurrent projects.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Execute work with exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse team environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks with little supervision and work under time pressure.
* Client consulting experience.


**Technical**
* Programming/development experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Spark, SQL, Python, R, C\#) preferred.
* Experience in managing or guiding organizations’ transitions from on\-premise to cloud resources.
* Data warehousing and/or large IT project experience.
* Understanding of OLAP technologies.
* Experience working with large data sets.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite of products.
* Healthcare informatics, analytics, and reporting knowledge.


**Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, finance, economics, engineering, or related fields.


**Desired Experience And Traits**
* Experience working with relational and big data database technologies (Databricks, Microsoft Azure). Experience collapsing, joining, merging data sets.
* Hands\-on experience in creating microservices architecture and cloud\-native applications.
* Hands\-on experience in Agile design and implementation approaches.
* Experience in reducing costs and improving efficiencies in data analytics.
* Healthcare claims analysis experience a plus.
* Ability to translate complex healthcare data questions from clients or account managers into manageable tasks.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and adaptable – adept at planning and execution, capable of prioritizing and accomplishing goals across a spectrum of concurrent tasks for varying stakeholders.
* Consultative and confident approach: Critical thinker, able to effectively comprehend complex business issues and develop solutions and communications that work for varying stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented: Recognizes that the small things make all the difference and pays attention to everything.
* Collaborative: Demonstrated ability to work with engineering and analytics teams to discuss technical concepts, make tradeoffs and evaluate new ideas.
* Intellectually curious: Desire and ability to learn new skills, systems, and processes, and interest in exploring data credibility and advanced analytic approaches.
* Energetic, optimistic, and hard\-working: Maintains a can\-do attitude and is unrelenting in the pursuit of excellence.


 Above all else, we are looking for someone who is excited about working in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with individuals across multiple teams to solve problems, and developing data\-driven solutions that make important information easy to access, understand and act upon.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an innovative self\-starter with solid technical foundations, who is interested in working with our team of experienced professionals to make a measurable impact on the business challenges faced by healthcare organizations today. The Milliman MedInsight group has been rapidly growing within different segments of the healthcare field, with presence amongst payers, employers, providers, accountable care organizations, pharmacy benefit managers, digital health companies, and other types of organizations. Successful candidates will support a variety of custom analytic client engagements and will also have opportunities to develop within their position and grow within the larger team.
   

  

**What makes this a great opportunity?**
* Join an award\-winning firm with a track record of growth backed by a marketplace powerhouse.
* Be part of the expansion and evolution of an analytics, technology, and research team in a data\-driven company.
* Enjoy significant visibility and be recognized for your wins.
* Work with a tenured collaborative team that values diversification of thought and new ideas.
* Grow and develop your skills and experience in an organization that invests energy in your career trajectory every day.
* Accelerate data interoperability, advanced analytics, and optimal use of cloud technologies.
* Help client and partner organizations improve healthcare for populations and communities.

8e290f3e.title: Oracle Cloud Reporting Consultant
8e290f3e.description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


Be part of Version 1’s Managed Services team as an Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant specialising in Oracle Cloud reporting. This role suits professionals who excel in BI Publisher, OTBI, FRS, OAC, and FDI, with strong PL/SQL and Oracle APEX skills, ensuring our enterprise clients receive actionable data and seamless reporting operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher, OTBI, and Oracle Analytics Cloud tools.
* Build custom and ad hoc reports for Oracle Fusion Cloud (ERP/HCM/SCM) modules, based on customer requirements.
* Support and troubleshoot issues in reporting solutions for live business environments and provide end\-user support for report\-related queries.
* Partner with business analysts and stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Optimize report performance, manage data extract processes, and ensure data integrity through testing and validation.
* Create and maintain documentation for developed reports, data models, and workflows.
* Participate in Oracle Cloud quarterly release impact assessments relating to reports and analytics.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of hands\-on experience in Oracle Cloud reporting technologies, including BI Publisher (BIP), OTBI, FRS, and OAC
* Experience developing data extracts using BICC, FBDI, HDL, and other Oracle Cloud data interfaces.
* Strong skills in SQL, PL/SQL, and building analytical reports or dashboards for Oracle Fusion Cloud modules.
* Proficient in PL/SQL for custom queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning, with hands\-on experience building applications in Oracle APEX.
* Familiarity with the Oracle Cloud data model, subject areas, and reporting security configurations.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion modules, interface tables, and data mapping logic.
* Proven troubleshooting ability and a methodical approach to report optimization and validation.
* Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub), CI/CD processes, and technical design documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience supporting managed services environments and handling user support tickets for reporting.
* Exposure to Oracle SaaS/ERP data integrations and migration strategies.
* Exposure to Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for app\-driven, scheduled, or file\-based integrations is a plus.
* Knowledge of security best practices for reporting and sensitive data outputs.
* ITIL process knowledge is a plus.

**Communication \& Teamwork**

* Excellent verbal and written communication to interact with clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to prioritize multiple reporting requests and manage deliverables under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and willingness to document and share knowledge with colleagues.

 **Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.


Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.


We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.


We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1\. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.


Video links: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=F\_d3ELTH5zo

834602b6.title: Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Senior Consultant
834602b6.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Supply Chain – Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise technologies across supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and IT operations. As part of this team, you will work with clients to support large\-scale digital transformation by bringing together strategy, process design, and technology enablement. Deloitte’s practitioners combine industry knowledge with functional and technical experience to help organizations improve operations, enhance business performance, and navigate complex transformation journeys. Joining this team means collaborating with strategic advisors, solution architects, and delivery specialists focused on solving critical business challenges through Oracle Cloud\-enabled transformation.
   

  

**Level** 
 : Senior Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Supporting and optimizing Oracle Supply Chain Management modules, including Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, and Costing
* Participating in Oracle Supply Chain Management full\-cycle implementations, including requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, functional design, configuration, and testing
* Collaborating with client stakeholders to identify business process improvement opportunities and translate requirements into solution designs
* Supporting end\-to\-end business processes, including Order to Cash and Procure to Pay, to help drive operational efficiency
* Working across delivery teams to support execution, issue resolution, and quality delivery in onsite\-offshore environments


**The team**
 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. 0f6c9846.description:
