b1513f69.description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Databricks Solution \& AI Architect  

Job location: Bangalore / Chennai  

Job requirement: Fulltime / Permanent  

Position ID: J0926\-0953  

Experience: 14\+ years of experience  

Work Mode: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

A Senior Databricks Architect with deep expertise in Lakehouse platform design, data engineering at scale and AWS cloud integration. This role leads solution design and delivery of enterprise data products with hands\-on capability to implement AI/GenAI features where they add clear business value. The right candidate owns the full data platform: from medallion architecture and Unity Catalog governance to performance\-tuned pipelines and stakeholder\-facing analytics. AI capability is a meaningful differentiator, not the primary mandate applied where data readiness and ROI are established.  

  

Primary Responsibilities  

  

* Core Platform \& Architecture (Primary Focus)
* Lead end\-to\-end design of Databricks Lakehouse solutions — medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) optimised for performance, cost, and downstream consumption.
* Design and build production\-grade data pipelines using PySpark, Databricks SQL, Auto Loader, and Delta Live Tables.
* Architect event\-driven and batch ingestion frameworks with strong SLA management, data quality rules, and lineage tracking.
* Define Data Product blueprints: domain boundaries, ownership, contracts, metadata standards, and discoverability.
* Lead Unity Catalog implementation — fine\-grained permissions, data lineage, row/column security, and cross\-workspace governance.
* Own AWS integration: S3 bucket design, IAM roles, VPC networking, and secure credential management for Databricks workspaces.
* Drive DevOps practices using Git, Databricks CLI/SDK, Repos, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and pipeline deployments.
* Optimise Spark workloads using Photon, Serverless compute, and cluster tuning for cost efficiency.
* Build and publish Power BI dashboards — DAX measures, data models, DirectQuery/Import mode — for business stakeholders.
* Lead architecture reviews, performance tuning, and code quality standards across engineering teams.
* Evaluate new Databricks platform features and integrate them into the technical roadmap.

  

* AI / GenAI Enablement (Supporting Focus)
* Implement Databricks AI/BI Genie spaces to enable natural language querying for non\-technical business users.
* Design and deploy RAG pipelines using Databricks Vector Search integrated with Delta Lake for real\-time data freshness.
* Productionise ML models and AI agents using MLflow, Feature Store, and Mosaic AI Model Serving.
* Support AI use case discovery workshops — identifying where data is AI\-ready and scoping feasibility of RAG or Agentic workflows.
* Implement LLMOps basics: monitoring, evaluation loops, and CI/CD for AI model assets.
* Apply Unity Catalog governance to AI assets — model permissions, vector index access controls, and audit trails.

  

Technical Skills Required  

  

1\. Databricks \& Data Engineering  

* PySpark, SQL, Python — production pipeline mastery
* Delta Lake, Auto Loader, Delta Live Tables
* Unity Catalog — governance, lineage, security
* Databricks Workflows \& SQL Warehouses
* Medallion architecture \& Data Mesh principles
* Performance tuning: Photon, Serverless, caching
* Databricks CLI/SDK, Repos, CI/CD integration
* Data Product design: contracts, versioning, SLAs
* Power BI: DAX, DirectQuery/Import, data models AWS Cloud \& DevOps
* S3, IAM, VPC, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions
* CloudWatch — monitoring, alerts, observability
* Terraform — workspace, clusters, UC policies, jobs
* Git\-based CI/CD for infra and pipelines

  

2\. AI / GenAI (Working Knowledge)  

* Mosaic AI, MLflow, Feature Store, Model Serving
* Databricks Vector Search \& RAG pipeline design
* AI/BI Genie — space setup and query tuning
* LLM integration basics (Bedrock / Model Serving)
* AI code assistants: Copilot, Gemini, Claude Code

  

Qualifications  

* 8–12 years of professional experience in Data Engineering and cloud architecture.
* Minimum 4\+ years hands\-on with Databricks at production scale.
* Demonstrated delivery of Data Products on cloud Lakehouse platforms (AWS preferred).
* Proven experience leading RFP technical tracks, scoping complex projects, and producing effort estimations.
* 1–2 years exposure to productionising AI/ML solutions on Databricks is a strong advantage.

  

Soft Skills  

* Strong ownership mindset — takes end\-to\-end accountability for platform reliability and data quality.
* Excellent communication: able to translate complex architecture into clear business value for C\-suite and product stakeholders.
* Engineering leadership: mentors teams, drives code standards, and influences architectural decisions at an enterprise level.
* Pragmatic approach to AI — champions use cases where data readiness exists; avoids over\-engineering.
* Continuous innovation mindset with focus on automation, performance optimization, and platform reusability.

  

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.  

  

\#LI\-GB9**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

74a034ca.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, or technical consulting, with 2 years of experience deploying production generative AI applications.
* Experience building and orchestrating agents using Agent Development Kits (ADKs) or frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
* Experience in Python and cloud computing principles (serverless, virtualization, secure networking).
* Experience designing modern application architectures (APIs, microservices) and integrating AI models into enterprise software.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Google Cloud Certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Machine Learning Engineer.
* Advanced experience implementing scalable RAG architectures connected to external productivity tools and enterprise databases.
* Experience leveraging LLMs to deploy enterprise\-scale multimodal solutions across text, image, video, and audio.
* Experience deploying enterprise GenAI platforms (Gemini Enterprise), with deep understanding of AI security, governance, and compliance standards.
* Proven track record leading technical project deployments and engineering teams on large cloud transformations.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web\-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

  


As a Cloud AI Consultant, you will work directly with Google’s most strategic customers on critical projects to help them transform their businesses using AI/ML technologies. You will help our customers to develop, deploy, and manage custom AI solutions in production using Google Cloud technologies. You will provide technical project management, consulting and technical aptitude to customer engagements while working with client executives and key technical leaders to deploy solutions on Google Cloud Platform. You will also work closely with key Google partners currently servicing top accounts to scope engagements, manage programs, deliver consulting services, and provide technical guidance and best practice expertise. You will possess a background in developing AI solutions, applying key industry tools, techniques, and methodologies. In addition, to be successful, you will know how to navigate ambiguity, be a technical expert in your field, and deliver customer success. You will have excellent client\-facing communication and project management skills.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise\-scale technical challenges.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C\-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's Engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high\-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive\-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

a2fd18d8.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud Migration
a2fd18d8.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will act as a consultant for Cloud Migration Solution delivery, utilizing software architecture fundamentals and assets, tools, and the garage method for cloud. You will leverage your expertise in migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms to drive successful migrations.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Deliver Migration Solutions: Design and implement migration strategies for hybrid cloud platforms, utilizing rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques to ensure seamless transitions.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Identify and map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, considering the advantages and disadvantages of each service to inform migration decisions.
* Execute Migration Strategy: Carry out migration plans, ensuring successful architecture implementation and meeting client needs.
* Collaborate on Migration Tools: Work with stakeholders to identify and utilize effective migration tools, considering network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Migration Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering cloud migration solutions, leveraging software architecture fundamentals, assets, and tools, such as the garage method for cloud.
* Hybrid Cloud Platform Expertise: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, and executing architecture implementation.
* AWS Service Mapping: Exposure to mapping existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a deep understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Migration Tool Proficiency: Experience working with migration tools, including understanding migration network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.
* Containerization and Migration Techniques: Exposure to rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions.

The Application Managed Services (AMS) Lead is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery and strategic management of key Managed Services and Build Operate Transfer (BOT) engagements. This role acts as the responsible person for high\-quality execution across AMS and BOT engagements. Working closely with account managers, delivery teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role drives operational excellence, client satisfaction, and account growth. The position demands deep technical and domain expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to align delivery capabilities with evolving client needs and business goals. * Partner with clients to develop strategic delivery plans aligned with digital transformation and modernization goals.
* Ensure a high level of client satisfaction, project transparency, and proactive communication.

* Ensure effective prioritization, governance, delivery health checks, and management of escalations.
* Oversee application lifecycle services – from design, build, and deploy to operate and support phases.

* Collaborate with resource management and project leads to ensure optimal allocation and utilization of squads including developers, testers, scrum masters, DevOps engineers, and integration experts.
* Build capabilities within the team by mentoring and upskilling based on technology and market needs.

* Define governance mechanisms including review cadence, KPI tracking, performance dashboards, and issue/risk logs.

**7\. Collaboration with Other Functions**

* Work closely with the Transition Managers, Change Management, and Transformation teams to ensure seamless onboarding, service stability, and continuous improvement.
* Integrate input from DevOps, Integration Engineers, Business Analysts, and Functional Consultants into delivery practices.

**Experience**

* **10\+ Years of experience** in IT application delivery with at least 5\+ years in a senior leadership role managing application portfolios.
* Hands\-on experience in delivering large\-scale application services across multiple technology stacks (custom, packaged, SaaS).
* Proven ability to manage and scale teams across geographies in an onshore\-offshore/hybrid model.

**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or IT (required).
* Postgraduate degree in Management or Technology (MBA/M.Tech) is preferred.
* Certifications such as PMP, ITIL, Agile/SAFe, or cloud\-related credentials are a plus.

**Skills Required**

* Deep understanding of application development and support processes across SDLC and DevOps pipelines.
* Familiarity with packaged applications (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft), custom development frameworks (.NET, Java, Python), and modern cloud\-native stacks (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Strategic Delivery Leadership:**

* Strong experience in managing delivery for transformation, integration, modernization, and AMS engagements.

 **Client Relationship \& Account Management:**

* Ability to influence and communicate with C\-level stakeholders across business and technology.
* Experience in navigating large, complex clients with evolving priorities and managing relationships over the long term.

* Excellent leadership skills – team motivation, performance management, career development.

* Proficient in delivery governance, SLA/KPI monitoring, and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Exposure to Agile, DevOps, ITIL, and application operations frameworks.

* Experience working with platforms and tools such as JIRA, Git, Jenkins, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and monitoring/logging tools.
* Familiarity with automation, testing frameworks, and performance tools.

**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Team Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, SWE, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Experience: 12y\+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance \& core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y\+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design \& Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Regex, database concepts.
* 5y\+ experience using GIT based continuous integration \& delivery

1b803344.title: GSI Services Program Manager
1b803344.description:
### **GSI Service Delivery Program Manager**

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India


### **Job summary:**


We are seeking a highly skilled and customer\-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post\-sales enablement and service\-delivery quality framework for Rubrik’s Global System Integrator (GSI) partners. Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik’s largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide. Pro\-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners’ organizations. The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner’s organization in collaboration with Rubrik’s Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin\-rich services to their largest and most complex customers.


The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik’s Global Customer Success organization. Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post\-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik. The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers.

  

### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Program Leadership \& Management:** Lead and coordinate a scalable high\-growth engine of post\-sales support and professional services GSI engineers. Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality.
* **Partner Collaboration:** Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post\-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand\-off from sales to services. Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world\-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction.
* **Training \& Enablement:** Facilitate and track role\-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well\-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik’s company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success.
* **Process \& Quality Improvement:** Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies.
* **Metrics \& Reporting:** Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership. Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non\-performers to improve or exit the program.
* **Partner Advocacy:** Comprehensively understand the partners’ go\-to\-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner’s approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful.
* **Support Oversight**: Provide oversight on partner’s open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik. Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner\-delivered services.
  

### **ABOUT YOU:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer\-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider.
* Strong technical background and aptitude in Networking, Storage, Backup and Recovery, Cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP etc.), and Hypervisors (VMware, Hyper\-V, etc.). Cyber Security experience is desired.
* Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi\-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries.
* Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands\-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data\-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred.
* Motivated, proactive self\-starter with a customer\-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross\-functional teams, including those outside direct influence.
* Able to work independently in a fast\-paced growth environment.
* Able to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion as required.
* Able to adjust work hours to overlap with USA and EMEA business hours as required.


**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  


**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.


Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.


### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**


* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------


Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.


Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

d238061b.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**ROLE OVERVIEW** 

As a Salesforce Project Manager (Individual contributor) , you will lead \& own the end\-to\-end delivery of global, outcomes Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies and modern, AI\-enabled delivery practices. You will be accountable for delivery excellence, financial performance, governance, and stakeholder alignment, operating with a strong business\-owner \& customer first mindset.


This role requires strategic thinking, executive presence, and hands\-on delivery leadership to manage complex Salesforce programs, protect project margins, and scale delivery impact across the organisation.
 

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* End\-to\-End Salesforce Delivery \& Financial Ownership: Own the complete Salesforce delivery lifecycle, managing scope, timelines, risks, resourcing, and dependencies while ensuring high\-quality outcomes and protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Agile Delivery Leadership: Lead Agile delivery using frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe, driving sprint execution, backlog prioritisation, delivery predictability, and high\-performing cross\-functional Salesforce teams.
* Program Planning \& Roadmap Management: Develop and manage integrated project plans and delivery roadmaps, ensuring transparent progress reporting, risk visibility, and dependency management across the engagement lifecycle.
* Stakeholder \& Executive Management: Drive stakeholder alignment through effective communication, executive reporting, governance forums, and proactive escalation management in complex, global environments.
* Quality Governance \& Delivery Excellence: Establish and enforce delivery governance, standards, and best practices, ensuring compliance, quality benchmarks, and continuous improvement across projects.
* Resource \& Budget Management: Plan and optimise project resourcing, manage budgets and forecasts, track financials, and mitigate delivery and financial risks throughout the engagement.
* AI\-Driven Productivity Enhancement: Encourage the strategic adoption of authorised AI technologies to boost team efficiency and optimise overall project delivery cycles
* Core Industry \& Domain Specialization: Direct experience leading complex, end\-to\-end digital transformation programs across key global industries, including CPQ,Revenue Cloud,Marketing,Tableau,ITSM.
* Timezone flexibility : Timezone flexibility to ensure comprehensive support and alignment with global customer needs

**SKILLS — MUST HAVE**

* 10\+ years of total experience in the IT industry, with 5\+ years delivering Salesforce projects
* Proven experience managing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and/or Industry clouds
* Experience **managing Salesforce related migration projects** where Salesforce platform/clouds are either the source or the target for migration.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce delivery lifecycle, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Architects and Technical Leads (hands\-on configuration is not required)
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with senior stakeholders and executives
* Salesforce Certifications (any one):
 


	+ Sales Cloud Consultant , Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant
* Project / Agile Management Certification (any one):



	+ PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2, CSM, or PSM
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smartsheets, Google Workspace
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI\-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM) and an Agentic Delivery mindset
* Willingness to travel on a need basis

  

**PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience delivering Salesforce projects in CPQ domain (Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud Advanced, Industry CPQ) or Life Sciences domain(s)
* Exposure to MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, or related integration and data platforms
* Salesforce Agentforce Specialist or Legend certifications, with experience managing Agentforce\-enabled projects

Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.


Accommodations


If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .


Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.


Posting Statement


Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

caa000d5.title: Technical Program Manager - WebOps - Core Maintenance
caa000d5.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

****Role Overview****
 As a Technical Program Manager at Google Operations Center, you will serve as a strategic operational lead, responsible for orchestrating complex, cross\-functional programs to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You will function as the primary bridge between technical teams and executive leadership, translating intricate technical challenges into high\-level business insights. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to navigate organizational ambiguity, facilitate strategic alignment across diverse stakeholders, and provide decisive leadership during high\-stakes product launches to ensure operational excellence.
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Program Orchestration \& Delivery: Define dependencies, clear operational bottlenecks, and track program velocity to ensure predictable delivery. Synthesize complex project tracks into a cohesive program roadmap.
* Support for Critical Launches: Serve as the operational lead for high\-stakes, time\-sensitive product or feature launches. Establish launch readiness criteria, run "go/no\-go" checkpoints, and create hypercare support plans for post\-launch stability. Manage real\-time risk mitigation and lead fire\-drills when unforeseen blockers threaten launch dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between working execution teams and executive leadership. Manage competing priorities across departments, aligning diverse agendas around shared program objectives. Proactively identify alignment gaps and facilitate strategic trade\-off decisions with senior stakeholders.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Translate technical complexities into clear, business\-focused updates for non\-technical teams and executives. Establish standard operating procedures for status reporting, ensuring a single, accurate source of truth for the program's health. Foster an environment of transparency, ensuring risks are flagged early and constructively.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Bridge organizational silos by facilitating cross\-functional syncs, workshops, and retro meetings. Ensure resource allocations match program priorities across engineering, product, design, and operations.


**Requirements**
****Minimum Requirements****
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a physical or operational setting.
* Methodology Expertise: Strong proficiency with project management tools and methodologies. PMP, Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.
* Technical Experience: Basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, or equivalent Technical Program Management experience.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, communicating technical work to non\-technical executive teams, with a proven ability to influence without authority and present to senior executives.
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and pivoting quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Preferred Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications are strong indicators of qualified candidates for this role.


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

 Manage/develop automotive advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) projects implement ADAS product technologies.
   

  

 Monitoring the project milestones by creating and maintain JIRA dashboards to track progress, feature readiness and timely closure of issue tickets along with other key engineering milestones.
   

  

 Establish and execute meeting structures on various development topics including cadence, agenda and tracking/closure of open action items .
   

  

 Internal

 Proactively identifying cross\-team dependencies and thereby incorporate them into the program planning process.
   

  

 Monitor Sprint metrics (e.g., Sprint velocity, defect rate etc.) to ensure high quality engineering output delivered to end customer.

 Representing as key POC; in publishing/presenting data both internally and externally for feature/function performance relative to key performance indicators.
   

  

 Collaborate with multiple teams, including software architects, software engineers, system engineers, developers, and product teams for timely completion of assigned deliverables.

d6ebca6d.title: Lead Technology Program Manager
d6ebca6d.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Lead Technology Program Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Program Planning and Execution
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer\-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results\-oriented environment.


 Governance and Communication
   

  

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.


 Risk and Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.


 Customer and Business Alignment
   

  

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business\-critical programs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
* Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
* Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading large, cross\-functional technology initiatives in a matrixed organization.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a data\-driven approach to decision making.
* Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and executive communications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting strategic customer programs, airline technology, travel technology, distribution platforms, or digital commerce solutions.
* Experience working across globally distributed teams.
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks, Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery management tools.
* PMP, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent project/program management certification.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced technology environment undergoing transformation and growth.


 Success Measures
   

  

**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**
* Delivery of committed program milestones and objectives.
* Effective management of risks, dependencies, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Improved visibility and predictability of program execution.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in program governance.
* Achievement of customer and business outcomes.
* Contribution to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will play a key role in delivering strategic technology and customer initiatives that drive business value and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to work with global teams, influence high\-impact programs, and contribute to the successful execution of transformative technology initiatives.
   

  

**Join us and help shape the future of travel through technology.**

We design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non\-Profit Organizations across the world.  Our team supports Cisco's leading Hardware Development Engineering teams, and partners closely with our various internal collaborators, such as Product Management, Software Engineering, Supply Chain, Compliance, and Customer Support to strategically plan, complete, and deliver hardware development programs.

* Prepare program plans, schedules, and budgets, working closely with Teams from Engineering, Supply chain and support functions.

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelors \+ 7 years of related experience in managing hardware product development (NPI) program management. or Masters \+ 6 years of related experience in program management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP (Program Management Professional) Certified.
* Expertise in intricate scheduling and budget management, including forecasting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills at a high\-level.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* begin with screening or an interview

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


 Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

8d830789.title: Salesforce Architect
8d830789.description:
Job ID
70362
Category
Enterprise Technology
Location
Chennai, India
Work Type
Hybrid  

Ford is looking for a Salesforce Architect to be the design authority for our Salesforce ecosystem, spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, MuleSoft, and Tableau. You'll chair our Design Authority, own our architectural pattern library, and champion a configuration\-first approach that keeps our platform scalable, connected, and built to last. This is a rare opportunity to shape enterprise\-grade Salesforce architecture at one of the world's most iconic brands, working at the cutting edge of AI\-driven CRM and enterprise integration.

* Design and govern how Salesforce connects into Ford's wider enterprise technology estate through MuleSoft and Data Cloud, ensuring APIs and data flows are secure, scalable, and reusable.
* Chair the Salesforce Design Authority, reviewing solution designs across Sales and Service, confirming alignment to approved architectural patterns, and providing formal sign\-off before development begins.
* Build and maintain a library of approved solution patterns (data model, integration, automation, security, and UX) that reduces rework and technical debt across future builds.
* Act as the gatekeeper for custom code, ensuring configuration options are fully investigated and the underlying business process is challenged before any custom build is approved.
* Maintain architectural oversight across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and Tableau, and own the integrity of the core data model, sharing model, and security architecture.
* Proactively review each Salesforce release, identifying and recommending new capabilities to keep the platform at the leading edge.
* Own the relationship with Salesforce's Signature Success program, ensuring full utilisation of entitled services and actively shifting eligible admin and maintenance work onto Salesforce to reduce internal platform management effort.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior product leadership, translating architectural trade\-offs into clear, business\-relevant recommendations.
* Coach and upskill the wider development team on architectural best practice, helping build a stronger Salesforce capability across the organization.

**Required:**

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Proven experience architecting enterprise\-scale Salesforce solutions across multiple clouds, including integration design and enterprise data architecture.
* Strong track record of driving configuration\-first, governance\-led delivery within a Salesforce environment.

**Preferred:**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* MuleSoft Certified Platform Integration Architect and/or Platform Architect
* Tableau Certified Data Analyst / Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Platform Data Architect / Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Certified Administrator / Platform App Builder
* Experience working with Salesforce Signature Success or similar premium support engagements.

42e101d4.title: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
42e101d4.description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. A strong grasp of both AI\-based solutioning and traditional SCM technical architecture is needed, along with depth in at least one functional area of Supply Chain.
   

  

**What You'll Do \-**
 Presales
   

  

* Own first\-level technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs \- AI/agentic solutions and traditional custom builds (integrations, data architecture)
* Map requests to existing solution patterns; escalate novel or complex asks to senior architecture review
* Provide effort sizing and feasibility calls under bid deadlines
* Draft technical solution sections of proposals \- architecture, differentiators, risks, dependencies
* Apply Cognizant pricing model with reuse in mind


 Customer Pilots
   

  

* Run customer pilots for SC AI solutions \- scoping, execution, and measurement against KPIs
* Act as technical point of contact through the pilot lifecycle, coordinating with client and internal teams
* Convert pilot outcomes into case studies and reusable proof points


 Solutions Architecture
   

  

* Design solution architecture for new SC/AI offerings \- data models, integration patterns, platform\-to\-play mapping
* Liaise with platform teams (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, SAP) on new capabilities
* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients


**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude \-**
* 8\-12 years in SCM technology consulting, with presales/solution architecture exposure
* Hands\-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred
* Familiarity with AI maturity frameworks a plus
* Strong communication skills \- clear technical writing under deadline pressure, confident client engagement during pilots
* Self\-driven, proactive and attention to detail necessary
* Based in India (Bangalore/Chennai preferred); limited travel for pilot engagements

27a8a8be.title: Data Architect — Snowflake & AWS (Presales + Delivery)
27a8a8be.description:
**Data Architect — Snowflake \& AWS (Presales \+ Delivery)** 




 Level: Senior / Principal · Client\-facing · Anchor architect for the Snowflake–AWS stack
 



**About the Role** 




 We build data platforms, accelerators, and AI agents for enterprise clients — and every one of them stands on an architecture someone had to get right the first time. As Data Architect for our Snowflake \+ AWS stack, you will own that architecture across the engagement lifecycle: shaping the solution in presales, defending it in client workshops, and staying accountable for it through delivery.
 



 This is a dual\-hat role by design, roughly balanced between presales and delivery. In pursuit mode, you are the technical voice in RFP responses, discovery workshops, and proofs of concept — the person who turns a client’s problem statement into a credible, estimable, winnable solution. In delivery mode, you set the architecture, review what gets built against it, and make the judgment calls that keep platforms performant, governed, and within their Snowflake credit budget. Architects who design decks they never have to live with will not enjoy this role; architects who want their proposals held to account will.
 



**What You Will Do — Presales \& Solutioning** 



* Lead technical discovery with prospective clients: current\-state assessment, workload analysis, and translating business requirements into target\-state Snowflake \+ AWS architectures.
* Own the solution architecture in RFP/RFI responses and proposals: architecture diagrams, phased roadmaps, migration approaches, effort and team\-shape estimation, and the assumptions register that protects delivery later.
* Size and defend the commercial\-technical envelope: Snowflake credit and warehouse sizing, AWS consumption estimates, and TCO comparisons against incumbent or competing platforms — with rationale that survives procurement scrutiny.
* Design and lead proofs of concept and pilots that are scoped to prove the contested claim, not to demo the easy path.
* Present to audiences from data engineers to CIOs: whiteboard the architecture, take hostile questions, and communicate trade\-offs in business terms.
* Work the partner ecosystem: align with Snowflake and AWS field teams (SEs, partner managers) on joint pursuits, funding programs, and competency requirements.
* Feed the practice: convert pursuit patterns into reusable solution blueprints, estimation models, and accelerator requirements.



**What You Will Do — Architecture \& Delivery** 



* Define end\-to\-end data architectures on Snowflake and AWS: ingestion (Snowpipe, streams and tasks, Kafka/Kinesis, DMS, Glue), storage and modeling layers, transformation (dbt, Snowpark), and consumption (BI, data sharing, APIs, AI/agent workloads).
* Set the data modeling standards for engagements: dimensional and lakehouse patterns, medallion layering, and when each is overkill.
* Design the governance and security model: RBAC hierarchies, masking and row\-access policies, tagging, data classification, and audit posture — aligned to client regulatory contexts.
* Own performance and cost discipline: warehouse right\-sizing, query optimization, clustering and materialization decisions, resource monitors, and credit\-burn reviews as a standing practice, not a rescue mission.
* Architect migrations to Snowflake from legacy warehouses (Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop) and between clouds, including cutover and reconciliation strategy.
* Design for interoperability: external tables and Iceberg, cross\-cloud data sharing, and integration with the AWS\-native estate (S3, Glue Catalog, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, IAM).
* Prepare data foundations for AI consumption: semantic layers, documentation and metadata that agents can reason over, and patterns for exposing governed Snowflake data to LLM and agent workloads.
* Review delivery against the architecture: design authority for engineering teams, unblocking the hardest technical decisions, and keeping as\-built honest to as\-sold.



**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years in data engineering and architecture, with 4\+ years architecting production Snowflake platforms at enterprise scale — including at least one greenfield build and one migration.
* Deep, hands\-on Snowflake expertise: performance tuning, cost governance, security and RBAC design, data sharing, Snowpark, and the trade\-offs behind each — depth we will test technically, not by certification.
* Strong AWS proficiency across the data estate: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis/MSK, DMS, Step Functions, IAM, and network/security patterns (PrivateLink, VPC design) for enterprise Snowflake deployments.
* Demonstrated presales experience: solutions you architected in winning bids, PoCs you led, and estimates you produced that delivery teams subsequently lived with. We will ask for specifics — deal shapes, your role, and what you got wrong.
* Expert SQL and working Python; fluency with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
* Mastery of data modeling: dimensional, data vault or lakehouse patterns, and the judgment to choose between them per workload.
* Executive\-grade communication: you can hold the room in a CIO briefing and a deep\-dive with the client’s DBAs on the same day.



**Good to Have** 



* SnowPro Advanced Architect and/or AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification.
* Experience with Snowflake’s AI capabilities (Cortex, document AI) or exposing warehouse data to LLM/agent workloads (text\-to\-SQL, semantic models).
* Apache Iceberg and open table format strategy experience.
* Data catalog, lineage, and observability tooling (e.g., Atlan, Collibra, Alation, Monte Carlo).
* Streaming architecture depth (Kafka/Kinesis at scale, CDC patterns).
* Consulting background with multi\-client delivery; supply chain, manufacturing, or ERP (SAP/Oracle) data domain exposure.
* Contributions to reusable IP: solution blueprints, estimation frameworks, migration toolkits, or published technical content.

9d31fcba.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.
   

  

 Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.
   

  

 You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.
   

  

 Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and experience working with vendors and third parties.
* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and ensuring a positive experience.
* Bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.

 On\-site Working

 unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

 than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture.  At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 An OpenText Content Server Cloud Applications Consultant is responsible for the technical delivery of the CS (Content Server) Platform based solutions. This role has administration emphasis, combined with the consultative skills required to promote the impression of quality and excellence actively fostered within the Customer Success Services.
   

  

**You Are Good At**

Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements.

* Collaborating on cross\-team and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, and Professional Services.


**What It Takes**

e9193103.title: Enterprise Change & Insights Manager (Senior Program Manager)-1
e9193103.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager (Senior Program Manager)\-1
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

This is an exciting opportunity to support Mastercard Multi Centre Strategy, in support of a Mastercard business, which provides Critical National Infrastructure to the UK.
  

  

The Mastercard UK company that enables the payments of 90% of salaries, 70% of utility bills, most ATM transactions and every cheque cleared in the UK.
  

  

We provide services to over 60 million citizens, and the UK private, public and third sectors.
  

  

In 2024, we processed 14 billion transactions, with a value of more than £10 trillion.
  

  

The Mastercard UK companies products include Bacs Direct Credits, Bacs Direct Debits, Faster Payments, the LINK ATM network for cash withdrawals, and the Image Clearing Service (ICS) that supports cheque clearing.
  

Overview  

This is an exciting opportunity to join Mastercard as an Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager. Working in a SAFe Agile environment, this role plays a key part in enabling and delivering value efficiently and sustainably, with a strong focus on agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and actionable insights.  

  

The ideal candidate is curious, motivated, and eager to learn—someone who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about enabling seamless change delivery and insights for colleagues and customers.  

  

Role Summary  

The Enterprise Change \& Insights Manager will support the planning, coordination and delivery of enterprise\-wide change initiatives, helping to modernise reporting, and drive a culture of AI enabled automation, continuous improvement and innovation in line with organisational priorities.
  

This is a hands\-on delivery role requiring strong organisational, analytical and communication skills will contribute to initiative planning, requirements development, stakeholder engagement, documentation, reporting and user readiness activities, while applying agile ways of working and continuous improvement practices to support effective business change. A key part of the role is interpreting information from multiple sources, identifying trends, risks and opportunities, and turning analysis into practical, actionable insights that support informed decision\-making.  

Accountabilities Summary  

* Support the planning, coordination and delivery of change initiatives or workstreams of moderate complexity using agile methodologies.
* A curiosity around AI technology, tools and operating model opportunities
* Analyse delivery data, stakeholder feedback, risks and performance indicators to define early indicator triggers, identify trends, root causes, emerging issues and opportunities to apply AI and automation to streamline workflows and deliver efficiency.
* Translate analysis into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that help stakeholders prioritise activity, make informed decisions and improve delivery outcomes.
* Prepare and maintain change documentation, dashboards, reports, plans and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate reviews, revisions, enhancements, testing, documentation and implementation activities, including user acceptance testing where required.
* Contribute to agile ceremonies, workshops and feedback sessions, promoting continuous improvement and collaborative problem\-solving.
* Support agile methodology compliance, identify barriers to successful delivery, and coordinate resolution or escalation of issues as appropriate.
* Provide input into business processes, standards, plans and service improvements to support effective delivery and sustainable change outcomes.

  

Experience and Skills Required  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in change management frameworks or large scale/complex transformation programs.
* in agile change management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify risks, issues, dependencies, trends and practical resolution options.
* Strong background in data visualisation (e.g., Power BI), analytical insight generation, and data driven reporting
* Ability to convert data, delivery information and stakeholder feedback into concise, evidence\-based insights, recommendations and actions for different audiences.
* Experience developing business and functional requirements, supporting design and testing activities, and working with technology or delivery teams through the delivery lifecycle.
* Strong planning, organisational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.
* Effective interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships across business, technology and delivery teams.
* Foundational understanding of agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban, with enthusiasm for applying agile principles to change delivery.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and collaboration tools; exposure to Jira, MS365 or similar platforms would be beneficial.
* Self\-starter who is curious, proactive, adaptable and comfortable working with minimal supervision in a dynamic environment.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

By joining our team, you'll have the chance to make a meaningful impact in a remote\-friendly, fast\-paced, and fun environment.

* Own and lead customer escalations end\-to\-end, working directly with customers, sales, SEs, TAC and consultants to drive resolution

* Always strive to improve the project delivery process and reporting structure

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service, project management and quality control skills
* Proven experience managing escalations and enterprise customer situations
* Strong resource planning and operational management skills
* Excellent leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Strong teamwork skills and attention to detail
* Experience with Check Point technologies is preferred
