e7020c6c.title: Metricstream Delivery Lead
e7020c6c.description:
**ERM Industrial Assets Department**
 We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven MetricStream Delivery Lead to oversee the successful delivery of MetricStream solutions at Glencore. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project management, excellent leadership skills, and a deep understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. You will be responsible for delivering to project timelines and manage technical and functional resources both internally as well as with Glencore’s third\-party vendors. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams across multiple locations globally.
   

  

**The main tasks and responsibilities include:**
* Lead the delivery of MetricStream implementation at Glencore, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT, business stakeholders, and external vendors, to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including resource allocation and timelines.
* Monitor project progress to plan, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery.
* Facilitate regular project meetings to communicate status, address challenges and escalations as necessary.
* Ensure adherence to best practices and standards in project management and GRC implementations.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance environment.


**Technical Experience:**
* Degree (e.g., BA, BSc) or professional certifications in computer science, Information technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years’ experience delivering and managing MetricStream implementations in global organizations.
* Proven experience as a delivery lead, preferably with MetricStream or similar GRC platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on delivering results.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written \& ability to collaborate across departments and cultures
* Knowledge of MetricStream features and technology (BAPI journeys, PL\-SQL, JAVA and MetricStream reporting tools, Power BI etc.)
* Knowledge of data governance and the integration of Risk, Audit, and HSEC processes.


**Key strengths include:**
* A solutions\-focused individual who can work with teams through complex challenges while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is a plus.
* Familiarity with compliance, risk management, and audit processes.
* Awareness of natural resources sector compliance challenges and emerging GRC \& ERM trends, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

23010fd6.title: Staff Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Leasing & Capitalization
23010fd6.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


As a Staff Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Leasing \& Capitalization, you will execute within the established strategy and operating model for Asset Lease Management, overseeing the lease lifecycle from contract and negotiation through renewal, buyout, and asset retirement. This role partners closely with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology stakeholders to structure and manage lease agreements that optimize financial, operational, and business outcomes while ensuring compliance with accounting and governance requirements.  

You will support the financial and operational management of the infrastructure lease portfolio, including forecasting, budgeting, payment administration, asset capitalization (as needed), and lease performance reporting. As the Staff Technical Program Manager of lease and asset data integrity, you will ensure accurate contract, financial, and asset records within enterprise systems of record. This role provides expertise in finance and operating lease evaluations, supports vendor negotiations and buyout strategies, and delivers insights that maximize asset value, control costs, and support long\-term technology investment decisions across GE HealthCare.**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Executes projects within the established Asset and Lease Management strategy and operating model, managing the roadmap, and governance framework to support long\-term technology lifecycle and financial management objectives.
* Accountable to deliver the long\-term Asset and Lease framework, including new leases, lease buyout, optimization opportunities, TSA strategy, and billing and data integrity
* Partner with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology teams to support the negotiation of lease agreements, financial terms, and buyout strategies that align with business and accounting requirements.
* Collaborate with business partners and technology leadership to support the execution infrastructure needs including tracking the progress, key milestones, asset health, and interdependencies.
* Support the vendor strategy and contract agreements in partnership with sourcing and VMO teams to complete project activities
* Track the budget, including forecasting, actuals updates, and variance reviews on a monthly basis
* Participates in Operating Mechanisms with partners to receive consolidated updates and discuss risks and strategies to ensure outcomes are delivered
* Prepare stakeholder communication and progress reporting at various levels of the organization including leadership and executives
* Ensure quality of deliverables is verified and matching stakeholder expectations
* Track outcomes realization and customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against service level. Ensure lessons learned are collected
* Perform financial reviews and approval processes for new leases, amendments, buyouts, capitalization events, and asset transitions.
* Maintain the enterprise system of record for leased assets, ensuring accuracy of contract details, asset records, serializations, financial attributes, ownership information, and lifecycle events.
* Ensure data integrity, audit readiness, compliance, and accurate financial reporting across all leased assets and agreements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or Engineering or 4 years of IT technical experience
* Minimum 8 years of IT professional experience
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Asset and Lease Management including project and financial management leading cross functional initiatives and/or large global projects

**Desired Characteristics**

* Proven expertise in enterprise Asset and Lease Management, including lease structuring, contract administration, buyouts, asset lifecycle management, and financial governance specific to Infrastructure Hosting and Network portfolio.
* Strong understanding of finance lease and operating lease models, capitalization policies, depreciation methodologies, and accounting implications.
* Experience partnering with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, and vendors to support complex lease agreements and financial commitments.

732201cd.title: [Upcoming Roles] Senior Technical Program Manager
732201cd.description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**This job posting is part of our proactive talent pipelining efforts for future openings. While there may not be an immediate vacancy, candidates may be invited to complete assessments or interviews at this stage. By applying, you consent to being considered for relevant opportunities that may arise within the next 6 months.**
****Role Overview****
 As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Google Operations Center, you will serve as a strategic operational lead, responsible for orchestrating complex, cross\-functional programs to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You will function as the primary bridge between technical teams and executive leadership, translating intricate technical challenges into high\-level business insights. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to navigate organizational ambiguity, facilitate strategic alignment across diverse stakeholders, and provide decisive leadership during high\-stakes product launches to ensure operational excellence.
   

  

****Position Responsibilities****
* Program Orchestration \& Delivery: Define dependencies, clear operational bottlenecks, and track program velocity to ensure predictable delivery. Synthesize complex project tracks into a cohesive program roadmap.
* Support for Critical Launches: Serve as the operational lead for high\-stakes, time\-sensitive product or feature launches. Establish launch readiness criteria, run "go/no\-go" checkpoints, and create hypercare support plans for post\-launch stability. Manage real\-time risk mitigation and lead fire\-drills when unforeseen blockers threaten launch dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary interface between working execution teams and executive leadership. Manage competing priorities across departments, aligning diverse agendas around shared program objectives. Proactively identify alignment gaps and facilitate strategic trade\-off decisions with senior stakeholders.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Translate technical complexities into clear, business\-focused updates for non\-technical teams and executives. Establish standard operating procedures for status reporting, ensuring a single, accurate source of truth for the program's health. Foster an environment of transparency, ensuring risks are flagged early and constructively.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Bridge organizational silos by facilitating cross\-functional syncs, workshops, and retro meetings. Ensure resource allocations match program priorities across engineering, product, design, and operations.


**Requirements**
****Minimum Requirements****
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in program or project management, ideally leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a physical or operational setting.
* Methodology Expertise: Strong proficiency with project management tools and methodologies. PMP, Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent certification is a strong plus.
* Technical Experience: Basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, or equivalent Technical Program Management experience.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, communicating technical work to non\-technical executive teams, with a proven ability to influence without authority and present to senior executives.
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and pivoting quickly in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
*Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:*
* Preferred Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certifications are strong indicators of qualified candidates for this role.

c0e47565.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Enterprise Delivery
c0e47565.description:
**About Bureau**
 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
   

  

 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
   

  

**Why Bureau?**
 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
   

  

 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
   

  

**About the Role \- Sr. Technical Program Manager \- Enterprise Delivery**
 As a
 **Sr. Technical Program Manager (Senior IC)** 
 reporting directly to the
 **CTO Organization** 
 , you will be the single point of technical accountability for Bureau’s largest enterprise deployments ($25k\+ ACV) across the
 **Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI)** 
 sectors.
   

  

 This is an execution\-heavy, client\-facing role for a hands\-on leader who thrives on end\-to\-end ownership. You will sit directly between client CTOs, engineering leads, and security reviewers, and internal software engineers, data scientists, and product managers to drive rapid Customer Time\-to\-Live (TTL) and high post\-go\-live NPS.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Enterprise Program Execution \& Delivery
* End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership: Lead post\-deal enterprise implementations from kickoff, technical scoping, and integration testing through go\-live and hypercare.
* Platform \& API Integration: Oversee complex integrations across REST APIs, webhooks, mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), device intelligence, and cloud infrastructure.
* TTL Optimization: Relentlessly reduce Customer Time\-to\-Live (TTL) without compromising reliability, security, or compliance.
* Client\-Facing Technical Bridge
* Executive \& Technical Partner: Serve as the primary client\-facing technical lead for customer CTOs, Chief Risk Officers (CROs), and security leads.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Translate complex client technical constraints and banking architectures into crisp, actionable requirements for internal Engineering and Product teams.
* Blocker Resolution: Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to identify and resolve integration bottlenecks rapidly.
* Risk, Security \& Dependency Management
* Dependency Mapping: Map and track complex multi\-party dependencies across core banking systems, loan origination systems (LOS), and payment gateways.
* Proactive Mitigation: Anticipate technical risks (API latency, SDK compatibility, data residency) early in the delivery cycle and execute concrete mitigation plans.
* BFSI Security Compliance: Ensure deployments strictly comply with banking security standards, data privacy, and SOC2/ISO regulations.
* Governance \& Delivery Scaling
* Delivery Cadences: Establish project tracking frameworks (Jira, Linear, Confluence) and communication channels tailored for large\-scale external customer rollouts.
* Executive Metrics: Track and report delivery velocity, milestone adherence, and CSAT directly to client steering committees and Bureau leadership.
* Playbook Standardization: Build scalable onboarding runbooks and integration templates to streamline future enterprise deliveries.


**What You'll Bring**
* 8–12 Years Experience: Proven track record in Technical Program Management or Technical Delivery in B2B SaaS, Fintech, RegTech, or API\-first platform companies.
* Senior IC Capability: Proven track record as a high\-impact individual contributor capable of driving multi\-million\-dollar deployments independently without needing a team of direct reports.
* BFSI Domain Expertise: Hands\-on experience delivering complex integrations for Tier\-1/2 Banks, NBFCs, Insurance, or large payment processors.
* System Architecture Depth: Strong understanding of REST APIs, Webhooks, microservices, mobile SDKs, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), and distributed systems.
* Client Stakeholder Mastery: Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated success managing client C\-suite executives, enterprise architects, and engineering teams.
* Agile Execution: Deep proficiency in sprint planning, risk tracking, and structured delivery in fast\-paced environments.


**Good to Have**
* Risk \& Fraud Domain: Prior exposure to identity verification (KYC/AML), fraud prevention, device intelligence, or payment processing ecosystems.
* BFSI Security \& Compliance: Familiarity with regional banking regulations, data residency rules, and security compliance standards (RBI guidelines, SOC2, ISO 27001\).
* Technical Background: Background in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting prior to moving into technical program management.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Customer Time\-to\-Live (TTL): Speed from deal closure to production go\-live.
* Post\-Go\-Live NPS \& CSAT: Technical customer satisfaction and delivery quality score.
* Milestone Delivery Velocity: On\-time execution of integration milestones and engineering deliverables.


**Our Culture**
* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most


**Compensation**
* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

e63e7c24.title: Technical Program Manager
e63e7c24.description:
****Technical Program Manager (TPM)****
****Role Overview****
 The Technical Program Manager (TPM) drives complex technical programs from planning through execution and delivery.
   

  

 At redBus, TPMs are expected to be technical leaders, execution drivers, and force multipliers who bring clarity to ambiguity, improve delivery predictability, and use AI and automation to make teams more effective.
   

  

 Whether you're helping launch new features, scaling core backend APIs, setting up regional compliance, or introducing new AI capabilities, you will be the key collaborative partner who connects the dots, resolves cross\-team dependencies, and keeps everyone moving forward smoothly.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
****Program Delivery****
* Cross\-Domain Leadership: Lead complex technical programs, geo\-expansions, and cross\-functional initiatives across the organization.
* Goal Translation : Translate business goals into clear plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Proactive Risk Management : Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive mitigation plans to closure.
* Strategic Partnering : Partner with Product and Engineering on prioritization, capacity alignment, and execution trade\-offs.
* Release Readiness : Drive release readiness and confidence across Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Product, and Operations.
* Stakeholder Governance : Communicate program health, risks, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.


****Engineering Execution****
* Architectural Review: Participate actively in architecture, API, integration, and solution reviews to identify technical risks and dependencies early.
* Sprint Readiness (DoR): Drive and enforce a strong Definition of Readiness (DoR) before sprint commitment.
* Quality \& Shift\-Left Maturity: Promote Shift\-Left practices by aligning Development and QA early, ensuring test case definition before coding begins.
* Operational Metrics: Track and optimize delivery metrics such as delivery predictability, defect density, build delays, and release quality.
* Continuous Improvement: Improve planning, execution, governance, and cross\-team collaboration through data\-driven interventions and post\-sprint RCAs.


****AI Program Leadership****
* AI Feature Delivery: Drive AI/GenAI initiatives (e.g., smart recommendation models, chat assistants, predictive routing) from proof\-of\-concept through to production and adoption.
* Collaborative Formulation: Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and ML teams to define scope, execution plans, and success metrics.
* AI Success Metrics: Track AI\-specific performance metrics, including model accuracy, latency, reliability, token costs, and adoption.
* Safety \& Quality Guardrails: Ensure AI solutions consider privacy, data security, model quality, continuous monitoring, and graceful fallback mechanisms.


****AI, Automation \& Tooling (Internal Productivity)****
* Agile Tooling Innovation: Build or prototype lightweight tools, dashboards, automations, and AI\-powered workflows to optimize program tracking.
* Process Automation: Use AI to improve requirement analysis, risk detection, dependency tracking, reporting, and release readiness.
* Eliminating Friction: Automate repetitive program and engineering workflows using APIs, scripting, AI tools, or low\-code platforms.
* Scalable Mechanisms: Identify manual operational processes that can be replaced with scalable automation.


****Qualifications****
****Required Qualifications****
* Educational Background: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.
* Agile Foundation: Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, APIs, system integrations, testing, and release management.
* Strategic Oversight: Strong program management skills across planning, execution, risk, dependency, and stakeholder management.
* Technical Depth: Ability to understand technical architectures, microservices, and databases, working effectively alongside engineers and architects.
* Professional Attributes: Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills; ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ownership Mindset: A clear bias toward execution, problem\-solving, and measurable outcomes.
* Tech Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and adopt emerging technologies, including modern AI tools and frameworks.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Engineering Roots: Prior hands\-on experience as an SDE, SDET, DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer, or a similar technical role.
* Delivery History: 2\+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience before or alongside transitioning into Program Management.
* Program Diversity: Experience driving AI/ML, GenAI, Data, Platform, or Developer Productivity programs.
* System Integration: Experience building internal tools, dashboards, JIRA automations, or productivity solutions.
* Certifications: CSM, CSP, PMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification is a plus.


****What Success Looks Like****
 A successful TPM at redBus acts as an operational anchor:
   

  

* Predictable Velocity: Improves delivery predictability and release confidence (aiming for the target 90%–100% performance band).
* Proactive Mitigation: Identifies and resolves risks before they turn into blockers.
* Backlog Maturity: Drives strong sprint and release readiness, ensuring zero features slip into development with open dependencies.
* Quality Improvement: Drives down post\-production defect leakage through early Dev–QA alignment.
* Simplified Delivery: Simplifies complex, multi\-team global cross\-team execution.
* AI Delivery: Successfully drives experimental AI initiatives into production.
* Operational Leverage: Uses automation to reduce manual coordination and builds scalable mechanisms that dramatically improve engineering productivity.


 At redBus, the TPM is expected to operate as a technical program leader, AI enabler, collaborative problem solver, and execution owner.

**Job Title:** F5 Load Balancer \- Level 3 Engineer


**Job Summary** **:**

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.


**Responsibilities** **:**

* **F5 Load Balancer Administration:**
* + Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
	+ Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
	+ Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
	+ Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
	+ Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.
* **Firewall Administration:**
* + Network Security
	+ Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
	+ Provide support for firewalls
* **Troubleshooting:**
* + Serve as the Level 3 (L3\) escalation point for resolving complex network and application\-related issues.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.
* **Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
	+ Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.
* **Security:**
* + Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
	+ Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.
* **Documentation:**
* + Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
	+ Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.
* **Automation \& Optimization:**
* + Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
	+ Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

**Requirements:**

* **Education:**
* + Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience:**
* + 6\+ years of hands\-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG\-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
	+ Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
	+ Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.
* **Skills:**
* + Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
	+ Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
	+ Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
	+ Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
	+ Familiarity with cloud\-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
	+ Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
* **Soft Skills:**
* + Flexible to work according to requirements
	+ Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
	+ Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
	+ Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.

**Senior Systems \& Solutions Engineer**

**About GlobalFoundries**
 GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets.  The Senior Systems \& Solutions Engineer will be a hands\-on customer\-facing technical leader for the Custom Digital MCU/MPU business. The role will work with customer engineering teams to understand product architectures, identify system requirements, position GF/MIPS processor and mixed\-signal capabilities, and translate customer needs into clear product and technology roadmap inputs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines embedded processor systems depth with customer credibility. They should be comfortable discussing real\-time control, embedded software, system partitioning, connectivity, safety/security, mixed\-signal integration, and application\-specific tradeoffs with both customer engineers and internal product/architecture teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Engage customer engineering teams to understand product systems, architecture choices, workloads, software stacks, constraints, and roadmap needs.

* Develop system\-level collateral including block diagrams, requirements matrices, reference architectures, customer use\-case notes, and competitive positioning material.
* Work with product management, silicon architecture, software, and design teams to validate feasibility and prioritize customer\-driven roadmap inputs.
* Own selected vertical coverage such as automotive zonal/SDV, motor drive/robotics, industrial automation, Edge AI, networking/infrastructure, or e\-mobility.
* Provide customer feedback loops to internal teams and help convert market insights into product decisions.
* Participate in customer workshops, technical reviews, architecture deep\-dives, and executive design\-win discussions as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of embedded systems, applications engineering, product systems, processor architecture support, customer solutions, or related semiconductor experience.
* Strong understanding of MCU/MPU product architectures, embedded software, hardware/software partitioning, and customer product requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more of: automotive electronics, industrial automation, robotics/motor control, networking/infrastructure, e\-mobility, or Edge AI systems.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customer engineering teams and internal silicon/software/product teams.
* Experience creating technical collateral, competitive analysis, architecture recommendations, and requirements documentation.
* Comfortable working across hardware, software, safety/security, connectivity, and mixed\-signal technology domains.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain tradeoffs clearly and crisply.


**Preferred Background / Target Talent Pools**
* Systems, applications, field applications, solutions engineering, or product architecture experience at embedded processor, MCU/MPU, industrial, automotive, or networking semiconductor companies.
* Experience with real\-time operating systems, embedded Linux, AUTOSAR, motor\-control software, industrial protocols, TSN, CAN/CAN\-FD/CAN\-XL, Ethernet, HSM/security, or functional safety.
* Customer\-facing experience with OEMs, Tier\-1s, industrial automation companies, robotics/motion\-control companies, or networking/infrastructure customers.
* Ability to travel for customer workshops and internal engineering reviews as required.


 GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

1e941876.description:
**Description**
**ROLE OVERVIEW**
 The Solution Architect — Marketing Cloud Next is the primary client\-facing technical authority for migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms — Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud Classic — to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and technical platform design: owning the end\-to\-end solution blueprint, leading functional discovery workshops, translating complex marketing business requirements into a Salesforce MCN solution architecture, and governing the functional quality of deliverables across the migration wave.
   

  

 Solution Architect owns the solution strategy, functional design and client relationship — ensuring the migrated platform delivers the business outcomes the client's marketing operations, CRM and digital teams need, while the Technical Architect delivers the technical implementation. Together with the Data Cloud Architect, the SA ensures migrated subscriber data, consent records and journey logic land in a well\-governed, AI\-ready, unified customer platform that sets the client up for Agentforce personalisation and Data Cloud activation post go\-live.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end functional discovery — running structured workshops with client marketing operations, CRM, data, compliance and digital teams to capture current\-state platform capabilities, subscriber data architecture, journey complexity, consent model and integration dependencies across all legacy marketing platforms.
* Own the solution blueprint — designing the Marketing Cloud Next target architecture, including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio and Data Cloud integration design, translating legacy platform features into MCN\-native equivalents and identifying where custom development is required.
* Author the migration approach document — defining the phased migration strategy, wave sequencing, subscriber migration methodology, journey migration priority framework, legacy platform deprecation schedule and business cutover approach with go/no\-go criteria.
* Design the subscriber data migration strategy — at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.
* Own the consent and compliance architecture — mapping legacy consent records, preference data and suppression lists to Marketing Cloud Next consent model and Data Cloud consent API, ensuring GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI obligations are met in the migrated platform from day one.
* Design the journey migration blueprint — inventorying and assessing all legacy journeys, drip campaigns and triggered sends; prioritising for migration, rebuild or retirement; mapping legacy automation logic to Journey Builder native capabilities; and defining the functional acceptance criteria for each migrated journey.
* Lead Data Cloud integration design — defining the unified customer profile architecture, data stream sources, identity resolution business rules, audience segmentation strategy and activation targets for Marketing Cloud Next — in collaboration with the Data Cloud Architect.
* Manage scope and functional sign\-off — maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign\-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.
* Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client — building long\-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade\-offs and post\-migration marketing strategy.
* Govern functional quality of deliverables — reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.
* Validate business process equivalence post\-migration — leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.
* Lead email deliverability strategy — advising on IP warm\-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post\-migration.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory — building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning — contributing to proposal development, migration scope estimation, resource planning and solution presentations for prospective Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform — Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder. Able to architect solutions end\-to\-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to MCN — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect's technical approach.
* Subscriber Data Model \& Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
* Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy SFMC Classic) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to MCN equivalents.
* Journey \& Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and prioritise complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Journey Builder native design patterns.
* Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post\-migration deliverability strategy.
* Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA's implementation approach.
* Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign\-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
* Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end\-to\-end MCN solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
* Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive\-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
* Workshop Facilitation \& Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
* Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory's MDLC wave delivery model.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Hands\-on AMPscript or SSJS experience — sufficient to validate dynamic content personalisation designs proposed by the Technical Architect
* Experience with Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross\-channel performance analytics post\-migration
* Knowledge of WhatsApp, Push, SMS and LINE channel migration alongside email
* Understanding of Salesforce Interaction Studio / Marketing Cloud Personalization for 1\-to\-1 journey personalisation post\-migration
* Experience with marketing data warehouse platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) as upstream Data Cloud data sources
* Familiarity with Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or Commerce Cloud as upstream journey trigger sources
* Experience migrating from Responsys, Acoustic Campaign (IBM Watson Campaign Automation) or Braze
* Knowledge of the Salesforce Well\-Architected Framework as applied to marketing cloud solution design


**Experience Requirements**
* 8–14 years of experience in marketing technology, CRM and Salesforce platform consulting
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience — at least 2 end\-to\-end MCN or SFMC implementations or migrations in a solution design or architecture role
* 3\+ years of client\-facing advisory experience — owning solution design and trusted advisor relationships on enterprise marketing transformation programmes
* Demonstrated experience running discovery workshops with senior marketing and digital stakeholders and translating outputs into solution blueprints and migration approach documents
* Experience working alongside a Technical Architect — owning functional design while the TA owns technical execution


**SALESFORCE \& PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS**
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist (Required)
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Administrator (Required)
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Application Architect (Preferred)
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer (Preferred)
* Salesforce AI Associate (Preferred)

 The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, leadership team, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery team(s). In the AI\-first GCID organization, Architects are expected to embed AI\-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Public Cloud\_** 
**Supervising Associate Functional Consultant**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This opportunity is for a strong SAP Functional consultant based out of Bangalore/Trivandrum, India in our CT SAP Domain team. CT SAP Domain has the responsibility for building and owning our SAP technology products end\-to\-end. You will guide the key SAP Domain products for the chosen functional areas.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* You are responsible to provide leadership, functional knowledge and configuration skills to build EY Proprietary applications on top of SAP products.
* Responsible to deliver in a hybrid systems environment – primarily SAP On\-Prem products, SAP Cloud Platform and SAP Cloud products.
* Responsible to deliver in the Agile process as part of a stable team.
* You are also expected to engage with partners and service providers to clarify any open operational or technical questions, reporting to the EY CT SAP Domain product management function.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Ideally, a Person with 8\+ years of experience in SAP FI/CO and 4\+ years in S/4HANA Finance having expertise in E2E Implementations, Rollout, Upgrade and Support Projects in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA. A minimum of three E2E Implementation experience is required. You will also be:

60b84b5e.title: Technical Architect/Senior Technical Architect/Solution architect-Revenue Cloud
60b84b5e.description:
**Description**
 The Technical Architect — Agentforce \& Revenue Cloud is a technically deep, execution\-focused architect responsible for designing and delivering migrations from legacy CPQ, billing and configure\-price\-quote platforms (Apttus/Conga, Zuora, Oracle CPQ, custom\-built CPQ) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ \+ Billing \+ Revenue Lifecycle Management). This role also covers the design and deployment of Agentforce — Salesforce's agentic AI platform — to automate and augment revenue processes post\-migration. As a member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will own the solution design, product catalogue migration, pricing rule architecture, contract and subscription migration strategy, billing migration design and Agentforce agent configuration for revenue use cases. You will act as the primary technical authority bridging legacy quote\-to\-cash logic and Salesforce Revenue Cloud's native capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the Technical Lead for Revenue Cloud migration workstreams, architecting the end\-to\-end transition from legacy CPQ/billing platforms to Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Billing and Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM).
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Design the product catalogue and pricing migration strategy — mapping legacy product hierarchies, bundle structures, SKUs, price books, discount schedules and pricing waterfall logic to Salesforce CPQ native features.
* Own the contract and subscription migration architecture — migrating active contracts, amendments, renewals, subscriptions and asset records from legacy platforms with full relationship integrity and history preservation.
* Architect the billing migration strategy — migrating invoice history, payment records, billing schedules, usage data, credit notes and tax records to Salesforce Billing while maintaining ERP reconciliation accuracy.
* Design Agentforce agent configurations for revenue use cases — including quote\-assist agents, renewal agents, deal desk agents and revenue operations agents that augment migrated Revenue Cloud processes post go\-live.
* Define end\-to\-end data lineage for all Revenue Cloud objects — including quote, order, contract, asset, billing and revenue recognition — covering profiling, cleansing, transformation and reconciliation.
* Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client revenue operations, finance and sales teams to uncover complex CPQ logic, pricing exceptions, approval hierarchies and legacy billing rules.
* Manage the functional depth of Source vs. Target systems — maintaining deep understanding of how legacy CPQ pricing logic, approval matrices and billing rules translate into Salesforce CPQ and Billing native features vs custom build.
* Design ERP integration architecture for revenue recognition, AR and GL posting — ensuring migrated billing data flows correctly to SAP, Oracle or NetSuite post go\-live.
* Serve as a Trusted Advisor to the client, driving conversations with CFOs, Revenue Operations leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Revenue Cloud migration roadmap, revenue recognition strategy and Agentforce adoption vision.
* Establish best\-in\-class standards for the Revenue Cloud migration practice — building reusable CPQ config templates, pricing rule patterns, billing migration scripts and Agentforce prompt templates as factory accelerators.
* Lead cutover planning and execution — including product catalogue freeze, final contract migration sequencing, billing system cutover, ERP sync validation and post\-migration reconciliation against legacy billing system.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks proactively — pricing rule conflicts, contract relationship data skew, ERP posting mismatches, CPQ governor limits during bulk quote generation and Agentforce agent hallucination risks in revenue contexts.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory by building reusable Revenue Cloud and Agentforce migration playbooks, config accelerators and cutover runbooks, reducing wave delivery time with each iteration.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Salesforce CPQ Deep Expertise: Advanced configuration of product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, guided selling, approval workflows, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic.
* Salesforce Billing: Hands\-on experience with billing schedules, invoice generation, usage\-based billing, payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Zuora), tax engine integration and dunning workflows.
* Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM): Understanding of Salesforce RLM — dynamic revenue contracts, asset lifecycle management and flexible pricing models.
* Agentforce Platform: Knowledge of Agentforce agent design — agent topics, instructions, actions and guardrails — for revenue operations use cases (quote assist, renewal, deal desk).
* Product Catalogue \& Pricing Migration: Proven expertise in migrating complex product hierarchies, bundle configurations and multi\-tiered pricing logic from legacy CPQ platforms.
* Contract \& Subscription Data Migration: Deep experience migrating active contracts, subscriptions, amendments and asset records with full relationship integrity at enterprise scale.
* Revenue Recognition: Understanding of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition rules and how they map to Salesforce Billing revenue schedules and ERP posting.
* Integration Architecture: REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, ERP integration patterns (SAP/Oracle/NetSuite), payment gateway integrations and middleware (MuleSoft/Boomi).
* Data Architecture \& LDV: Master\-level understanding of CPQ data model, quote line relationships, contract hierarchies and Large Data Volume strategies for billing objects.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Experience migrating from Apttus/Conga CPQ, Zuora, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Classic CPQ (Big Machines) or custom\-built CPQ to Salesforce Revenue Cloud
* Hands\-on experience with ETL tools — Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft — for high\-volume contract and billing data migration
* Knowledge of Salesforce Industries (Vlocity/OmniStudio) — DataRaptors and Integration Procedures for CPQ process automation


**Experience Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience developing enterprise Salesforce technology and revenue operations solutions
* 5\+ years hands\-on Salesforce CPQ experience, with at least 2 end\-to\-end CPQ/Billing migration projects
* 3\+ years of client\-facing advisory or architecture roles on enterprise Revenue Cloud transformations
* Demonstrated experience migrating complex product catalogues (1000\+ SKUs) and active contract portfolios (100K\+ contracts) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud
* Experience with Agentforce Einstein models — prediction fields, next best action and recommendation strategy for revenue use cases
* Familiarity with Salesforce Subscription Management for direct\-to\-consumer subscription billing models
* Understanding of multi\-currency and multi\-entity billing migration for global enterprise clients


**SALESFORCE \& PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS**
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist (Required)
* Salesforce Revenue Cloud Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Billing Specialist (Required)
* Salesforce Application Architect (Preferred)
* Agentforce Specialist (Preferred)
* Salesforce Certified Data Architect (Preferred)

bd2db381.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS Brand Experience (BX)
bd2db381.description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!
   

  

 Retail Business Services (RBS) Brand Experience (BX) leverages technology to improve customer experience and selling partner experience while lowering Amazon’s cost structure. Vision of RBS is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by 1\) improving the customer experience by fixing detail page catalog defects at scale, 2\) improving selling partner listing quality to drive GMS and reducing fulfillment defects to drive profitability and 3\) improving store operations efficiency by driving down cost of operations. We strive to eliminate the root cause of the defect and wherever not possible, we leverage machine learning to find and fix at scale or surface to selling partners. RBS has multiple programs/services aimed at reducing the listing friction, improving listing quality, reducing customer returns and improving star ratings of products that are dependent on selling partner support for effective execution.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will own the development and innovation of products and features to improve brand experience for WW brands. You will be expected to identify the brand requirements using primary \& secondary research, gather business and systems requirements from internal and external stakeholders, propose and validate solutions, build proof\-of\-concepts, write specifications, drive roadmap from design to release, and manage the production launch. You will work with our internal/external product, business and technology teams to align on roadmap, prioritization, execution, navigating ambiguity and removing roadblocks while sustaining launch/expansion velocity. You will leverage your team to provide solutions that address peripheral needs (functional, legal, compliance). In addition, you will work closely on driving adoption of the product in your target segments, improving actionability of the insights you share through the initiative, and maintaining the quality of product features. You will own the reporting of metrics, and launches through business reviews at leadership level.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to customer experience improvement. Key skills for the role include an extraordinary ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the tech product.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build deep knowledge of RBS BX offerings, and business requirements.
* Develop trust\-based relationships with program’s key stakeholders.
* Help define the program strategies, develop program roadmap, and organize work steams and milestones; gain buy\-in and interlock across functional and regional leaders.
* Manage timely and successful delivery of the program, working with program’s product owners and cross\-functional teams to manage risks, and measure and report on progress. Gather and analyze data on launch performance results
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, manage escalations, balance trade\-offs, and resolve complex execution and operational issues.
* Build and deliver program’s operational and management reports. Use data and analytics to make day\-to\-day business decisions and achieve results
* Work with global and regional teams to lead program’s adoption efforts. Hold regular business reviews with both internal and external partners
* Define and manage to program KPIs. Use Voice of the Customer, experimentation, data analysis, to set global quality standards and specifications for all product media for Amazon
* Present strategic program and user insights and recommendations to stakeholders and cross\-functional team.
* Provide ad\-hoc support and analysis to senior leaders on strategy documents and research requests.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

8d784c0b.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
8d784c0b.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Public Sector Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to U.S. government customers, helping them understand how GitLab's Enterprise Edition and DevSecOps platform can address real business and mission outcomes. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and connect GitLab's modern software development, operations, and cloud capabilities to measurable value. In this role, you'll work closely with sales and cross\-functional GitLab teams, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and act as a customer advocate back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Engage with public sector customers, both onsite and remotely, to provide technical expertise and guidance throughout the pre\-sales process, including tailored demos, technical presentations, and hands\-on workshops.
* Collaborate with the sales team to shape and execute account strategies that drive GitLab adoption within government environments.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including proof of concept (POC) and proof of value (POV) design and delivery, tender and audit support, and technical input into proposals.
* Lead the creation of Customer Success Plans that capture technical success criteria and handoff details from the pre\-sales process, ensuring a smooth path to deployment and adoption.
* Build and deepen relationships with technical and business stakeholders so they become advocates for GitLab within their organizations.
* Serve as the customer advocate internally by channeling feedback and insights to Product, Sales, Marketing, and other GitLab teams to influence roadmap and messaging.
* Maintain and expand your expertise in GitLab and related technologies, including modern software development, operations, and cloud practices, and create reusable examples and assets for customers and partners.
* Run Value Stream Assessments to identify opportunities for customers to improve their software delivery with GitLab.


**What You'll Bring**
* Background in technical pre\-sales, consulting, or information technology roles, ideally with U.S. public sector or federal customers, where you guided customers through evaluations and solution design
* Hands\-on experience using GitLab and familiarity with modern software development and operations practices, such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation
* Experience with cloud computing platforms and related technologies in regulated or security\-conscious environments.
* Ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business or mission outcomes and to advise senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and options.
* Strong, confident communication and relationship\-building skills, including leading customer meetings, demos, and value\-focused conversations in close partnership with sales and cross\-functional teams
* Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.


**About The Team**
 The Public Sector Solutions Architect role is part of GitLab's Solutions Architect team, a group of trusted technical advisors who help government customers understand, evaluate, and adopt the GitLab DevSecOps platform. The team is distributed and collaborates asynchronously across time zones using GitLab and our handbook\-first practices to share knowledge, reusable examples, and best practices. You'll help the team address unique public sector challenges such as security, compliance, and mission\-critical software delivery, and contribute customer insights that shape our product direction.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

62f4552c.title: Senior Programmatic Solutions Consultant - Technical, PSC-T
62f4552c.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Advertising is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions \- including sponsored, display, video, and custom ads \- leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self\-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. Within Amazon Advertising, the Ad Services team is focused on services that emphasize campaign excellence \& efficiency, creative design \& performance and product \& policy guidance.  

  

Our Amazon DSP team is looking for a Senior Programmatic Solutions Consultant \- Technical to join Amazon Advertising's growing team based in Bangalore, India.  

  

In this role, you will independently resolve customer campaign execution issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support to our enterprise customers: programmatic trading desks. You will have ownership for issue investigation: identifying campaign configuration and software defects, reproducing in\-depth and complex cases across our DSP product and processes, and researching solutions to unblock customers. This is a complex environment, as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and deliver on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over incident response, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our service quality and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an incident in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Independently handle complex customer issues by reproducing cases, root cause analysis, and providing prioritization input
* Demonstrate deep technical expertise and advanced problem\-solving for critical programmatic advertising issues
* Serve as an escalation point, owning end to end resolution of the most complex, cross\-organizational issues
* Communicate directly with internal teams to investigate, define workarounds, and resolve defects
* Provide advanced, proactive support across Amazon's advertising tech suite, including Amazon DSP (ADSP), Amazon Ad Tag (AAT), Conversion API (CAPI), Ads Data Manager (ADM), and Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC)
* Prioritize issues using case management tools based on customer impact
* Own and drive training programs, documentation strategy, and knowledge management for internal and external users
* Automate standard procedures through scripting and data APIs to analyse high\-volume transaction data
* Proactively identify systemic solutions, analyse trends across the customer base, and drive cross\-functional initiatives to improve customer experience at scale
* Lead, develop and mentor a team of consultants to enhance technical skills in programmatic advertising and troubleshooting
* Drive continuous improvement, define org\-wide mechanisms, and shape support strategy and technology approach at a strategic level
* Identify emerging issues, influence product roadmap prioritization, and partner with engineering leadership through technical investigation and data\-driven proposals
* Provide live troubleshooting sessions for customers
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 8\+ years of experience in technical support or solutions consulting
* 8\+ years of programmatic advertising experience
* Experience as a technical specialist in customer\-facing roles
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in SQL Server/MySQL and experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* Experience writing and publishing technical documents or equivalent
* Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical troubleshooting or similar experience
* Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience coding, scripting, automating in at least one language (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, Ruby, or PowerShell)
* Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings, or experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
* Knowledge of data analytics with tools such as Tableau, SQL, Quick\-sight

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
   

  

 You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
