3173ebba.title: Services Delivery Manager (Professional services Team)
3173ebba.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Services Delivery Manager (Professional Services Team) based in India.**
 As a Services Delivery Manager, you’ll lead operational delivery across a professional services organisation supporting enterprise cybersecurity projects throughout India. You’ll oversee consultants delivering complex security implementations, migrations, upgrades, and customer engagements. The role combines people leadership, resource planning, delivery governance, customer management, and operational strategy in a fast\-paced environment. You’ll work closely with customers, sales, solution engineering, technical support, and delivery teams to ensure successful project outcomes. You’ll also drive consultant development, utilisation, certification, and career progression while identifying opportunities to strengthen service offerings. A key part of the role involves managing critical escalations and ensuring effective communication and resolution across stakeholders. This is an opportunity to shape delivery excellence while helping enterprise customers achieve their security objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Operational Leadership: Lead day\-to\-day operational delivery activities across the India Professional Services project delivery organisation, ensuring projects and customer engagements are executed effectively.
* Resource Planning: Develop and execute personnel and resource management plans, balancing consultant capacity, project requirements, utilisation, and business objectives.
* Consultant Development: Identify skills gaps and development opportunities, support career progression, conduct regular 1:1 meetings, and mentor consultants to strengthen team capabilities.
* Certification \& Technical Growth: Drive initiatives that maintain and increase consultant technical certifications and ensure the team has the skills required for current and future delivery needs.
* Customer Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, sales teams, solution engineers, and other internal stakeholders.
* Escalation Management: Own customer escalations end\-to\-end, coordinating with customers, sales, solution engineering, technical support, and consultants to drive timely resolution.
* Delivery Governance: Establish and improve operational cadence, reporting structures, project delivery processes, and governance practices to improve consistency and quality.
* Service Development: Identify opportunities to enhance existing professional services offerings and contribute to the development of new services that increase customer value.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Act as a key delivery partner to sales leadership, maintaining regular communication, alignment, forecasting, and execution across customer engagements.
* Critical Delivery Support: Support major customer cutovers, weekend activities, enterprise deployments, and other high\-priority delivery requirements when necessary.
* Operational Forecasting: Lead resource forecasting, capacity planning, utilisation management, and escalation planning across the India delivery organisation.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify operational challenges and implement improvements to delivery processes, reporting, service quality, and team effectiveness.
* Recruitment: Support the recruitment and hiring of professional services consultants and contribute to building a strong technical delivery organisation.
* Decision\-Making: Demonstrate strong leadership presence by driving discussions, making informed operational decisions, resolving conflicts, and ensuring agreed actions are completed.


**Requirements**
* Leadership Experience: Proven experience managing teams of technical consultants, engineers, or other technical professionals.
* Professional Services: Experience in professional services, technical delivery, consulting, or enterprise technology environments.
* Customer Management: Strong customer service skills with demonstrated experience managing enterprise customer relationships and complex situations.
* Escalation Management: Proven ability to manage customer escalations, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Project \& Delivery Management: Strong project management and quality\-control skills, with an understanding of delivery governance, operational processes, and reporting.
* Resource Management: Strong experience in resource planning, capacity management, utilisation, forecasting, and operational planning.
* Leadership \& Mentoring: Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members while identifying skills, promotion, and career\-development opportunities.
* Stakeholder Management: Excellent ability to collaborate with sales, solution engineering, technical support, customers, partners, and delivery teams.
* Decision\-Making: Comfortable managing conflicts and making clear operational decisions in high\-pressure and time\-sensitive situations.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Organisation: Strong teamwork, attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Cybersecurity Knowledge: Experience with enterprise cybersecurity environments is desirable.
* Technical Expertise: Experience with relevant security technologies is advantageous, particularly Maestro, VSX, VPN, CloudGuard, and related enterprise security solutions.
* Delivery Experience: Experience managing firewall migrations, enterprise security implementations, upgrades, or large\-scale technology delivery engagements is highly desirable.
* Technology Experience: Familiarity with the partner company's security technologies is preferred.
* Operational Mindset: Proactive, innovative, commercially aware, and focused on continuous improvement and high\-quality delivery.

f93f34be.title: Agentic Solutions Manager
f93f34be.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**  

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work. **Why Skan AI**  

We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.  

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.  

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.  

We are seeking an Agentic Solutions Manager to own the delivery, deployment, and expansion of Skan’s agentic AI platform at our most strategic enterprise accounts. In this role, you will be the single point of accountability for customer outcomes — leading complex implementations, building trusted relationships with VP and C\-suite stakeholders, and driving measurable business value from day one.  

This is far more than a delivery role — it is an opportunity to shape how the world’s largest regulated enterprises adopt agentic AI, act as the voice of the customer back into our product, and build a high\-performing team as the function scales.**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Customer Delivery \& Deployment*** **Own End\-to\-End Delivery:** Take full ownership of 2–3 concurrent agentic AI deployment programs at Tier\-1 enterprise clients, from scoping and stakeholder alignment through execution and value realization.
* **Be the Client’s Trusted Advisor:** Serve as the primary point of accountability for VP and executive\-level client sponsors, ensuring transparent communication, proactive risk management, and consistent delivery against committed milestones.
* **Navigate Complexity \& Ambiguity:** Operate effectively within large, regulated organizations where requirements evolve, stakeholders multiply, and clarity must be created — not inherited.
* **Drive Cross\-Functional Execution:** Coordinate internal teams — Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Sales — to deliver a seamless and integrated client experience.

**Account Growth \& Expansion*** **Identify and Drive Expansion:** Spot and develop opportunities to broaden platform adoption within existing accounts, partnering with Sales to build the business case and convert opportunities into new revenue.
* **Deliver Executive\-Level Business Reviews:** Lead QBRs and executive briefings that quantify value delivered, surface insights, and frame the path to deeper engagement.
* **Think Like an Owner:** Approach every account with a growth mindset — you are not just delivering what was sold, you are shaping what gets sold next.

**Product Feedback \& Strategic Influence*** **Close the Customer\-to\-Product Loop:** Synthesize patterns across engagements — friction points, feature gaps, workflow opportunities — into structured, actionable input for Product and Engineering leadership.
* **Champion the Customer Internally:** Ensure the voice of the customer is heard in product roadmap discussions, sprint planning, and strategic prioritization.

**Team Building \& Leadership*** **Player\-Coach from Day One:** Lead by doing — personally delivering strategic projects while setting the quality bar, playbook, and culture for how Skan shows up with clients.
* **Build the Function:** As the business scales, hire, mentor, and manage a delivery team, establishing repeatable processes and a standard of excellence for customer engagement.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* **Experience:** 10\+ years in a client\-facing, delivery\-oriented role with at least 3 years in a high\-growth startup environment (Series B–D or equivalent stage).
* **Consulting Foundation:** Background at a top\-tier management consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent) is strongly preferred — we value the structured problem\-solving, executive communication, and workstream leadership this develops.
* **Executive Presence:** Demonstrated success engaging with VP and C\-level stakeholders at large, complex enterprises. You are comfortable being the most senior person in the room from your side of the table.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Experience in financial services, insurance, or healthcare is a strong plus. Familiarity with process mining, intelligent automation, or AI/ML platforms is valuable but not required.
* **Semi\-Technical Fluency:** You don’t need to write code, but you need to understand agentic AI architectures, SaaS/PaaS delivery models, and enterprise integration patterns well enough to lead technical conversations with credibility.
* **Growth Orientation:** A track record of identifying expansion opportunities within accounts and partnering with Sales to drive revenue growth.
* **Location:** Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco or New York. This is a hybrid role with regular in\-person client engagement expected.
* **Skills:** Exceptional communication, structured thinking, and the ability to build trust quickly across cultures and organizational levels. A natural problem\-solver who thrives in ambiguity.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **First 90 Days:** You’ve taken ownership of your initial accounts, built trusted relationships with client executive sponsors, and delivered a clear plan for each engagement with defined milestones and success metrics.
* **First 6 Months:** Your accounts are on track or ahead of plan. You’ve led at least one executive business review that quantified delivered value and surfaced an expansion opportunity. Product and Engineering leadership view you as a reliable, high\-signal source of customer insight.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore**

* Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment.  
* 

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!


Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start\-up\-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.  



* **Industry leader:** Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence

* **Growth and success:** As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. **Join Us**

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a **global stage** or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value **integrity, innovation, and inclusion** , and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to **be part of Chubb India’s journey** .

cc6d3c7c.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
cc6d3c7c.description:
Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – Design Authority \| MuleSoft

**Location:** India / Bengaluru preferred  
**Experience:** 12\+ years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Role:** Senior Salesforce Technical Architect / Enterprise Architect  
**Domain:** Salesforce \+ MuleSoft \+ Enterprise Integration

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced **Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)** to serve as the **Design Authority** for enterprise Salesforce implementations and transformation programs.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining and governing the overall technical architecture across the Salesforce ecosystem, ensuring that solutions are **scalable, secure, maintainable, integration\-ready, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards**.

The role requires deep expertise in **Salesforce architecture, enterprise integration, MuleSoft, data architecture, security, DevOps, and cloud technologies**, along with the ability to work directly with CXOs, enterprise architects, product owners, and senior engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities1\. Architecture \& Design Authority

* Act as the **Design Authority and final technical authority** for Salesforce solution architecture.
* Define end\-to\-end architecture for complex Salesforce transformation programs.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, patterns, and technology guardrails.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications, and architecture decisions.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards.
* Identify architectural risks, technical debt, scalability constraints, and remediation strategies.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple Salesforce workstreams and implementation teams.

2\. Salesforce Architecture

* Design complex Salesforce solutions across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Platform
* Data Cloud
* Marketing Cloud
* Revenue Cloud / CPQ where applicable
* Define appropriate use of **configuration, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components and platform services**.
* Design scalable data models and security architecture.
* Define Salesforce governor\-limit and performance strategies.
* Establish patterns for reusable Salesforce components and services.
* Guide teams on Salesforce best practices and architectural trade\-offs.

3\. MuleSoft \& Enterprise Integration

* Design and govern enterprise integration architecture using **MuleSoft / Anypoint Platform**.
* Define API\-led connectivity strategies across Salesforce and enterprise applications.
* Design **System APIs, Process APIs and Experience APIs**.
* Define integration patterns for:
* Salesforce ↔ ERP
* Salesforce ↔ CRM
* Salesforce ↔ HRMS
* Salesforce ↔ legacy systems
* Salesforce ↔ external SaaS platforms
* Establish API governance, security, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Evaluate synchronous vs. asynchronous integration approaches.
* Define event\-driven architectures where appropriate using platforms such as **MuleSoft, Platform Events, CDC and messaging systems**.

4\. Enterprise Architecture

* Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.
* Develop **High\-Level Designs (HLD)** and **Low\-Level Designs (LLD)**.
* Create architecture diagrams, data flows, integration flows, and system interaction models.
* Define technology selection and evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Cloud Architects, Security Architects and Data Architects.
* Ensure Salesforce architecture integrates effectively with the broader enterprise technology landscape.

5\. Security \& Compliance

* Define Salesforce security architecture covering:
* Identity and Access Management
* SSO
* OAuth
* Profiles and Permission Sets
* Sharing architecture
* Encryption
* Data protection
* Work closely with security teams to ensure compliance with enterprise security standards.
* Ensure integration architectures follow appropriate authentication, authorization and data\-protection practices.

6\. Data Architecture

* Define enterprise Salesforce data architecture and data governance.
* Design data migration and synchronization strategies.
* Address data volume, performance and data\-quality challenges.
* Define master\-data and system\-of\-record strategies.
* Design integrations involving large data volumes and complex data synchronization.

7\. DevOps \& Delivery Governance

* Establish Salesforce DevOps and release\-management standards.
* Define CI/CD strategies and deployment architectures.
* Work with development teams on source control, branching and release strategies.
* Review deployment risks and technical dependencies.
* Establish development, testing, staging and production architecture standards.

8\. Technical Leadership

* Mentor Salesforce Architects, Senior Developers and Technical Leads.
* Provide architectural guidance to distributed engineering teams.
* Challenge technical assumptions and evaluate alternative solutions.
* Participate in technical workshops, design reviews and client presentations.
* Communicate complex architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Required QualificationsMandatory

* **Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)** certification.
* **12\+ years of overall technology experience**.
* Extensive Salesforce architecture experience.
* Proven experience acting as a **Design Authority / Architecture Lead** on large enterprise programs.
* Strong experience designing complex Salesforce ecosystems.
* Significant experience with **MuleSoft / Anypoint Platform**.
* Strong understanding of **API\-led connectivity and enterprise integration architecture**.
* Excellent understanding of Salesforce data, security and integration architecture.
* Strong experience with enterprise architecture principles and design patterns.
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders.

Salesforce Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

* Salesforce Platform Architecture
* Apex
* Lightning Web Components
* Salesforce APIs
* REST / SOAP
* Platform Events
* Change Data Capture
* Salesforce security model
* Data architecture
* Large Data Volume Architecture
* Salesforce integration patterns
* Governor limits and performance architecture
* DevOps and CI/CD
* Salesforce DX

MuleSoft Expertise

Strong experience with:

* MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
* Anypoint Studio
* API Manager
* API Designer
* Runtime Manager
* Anypoint Exchange
* API\-led connectivity
* System / Process / Experience APIs
* RAML
* OAuth / API security
* API lifecycle management
* Integration patterns
* Error handling and monitoring
* Enterprise integration governance

Preferred Certifications

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – **Mandatory**
* MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect
* MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Architect
* Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect
* AWS / Azure / GCP certifications are an advantage

Key Competencies

* Enterprise Architecture

* Integration Architecture

cef2944d.title: Solution Architect - Mulesoft
cef2944d.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect MuleSoft to lead the design and implementation of enterprise integration solutions. This role requires strong expertise in MuleSoft and Salesforce ecosystems, along with the ability to engage with business stakeholders, define integration strategies, and provide technical leadership to delivery teams.
 



  





 Job Role:\- Solution Architect \- Mulesoft
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :\-** 



* Design, architect, and implement scalable integration solutions using MuleSoft, Salesforce Multi\-Cloud, APIs, and related technologies.
* Work closely with clients and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical integration solutions.
* Define integration architecture standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and deployment strategies.
* Lead integration projects from solution design through implementation and support.
* Ensure integrations meet functional, security, performance, and operational requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration and system issues.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, QA teams, and system owners throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to development and QA teams.
* Stay up to date with emerging integration technologies, MuleSoft innovations, and Salesforce ecosystem advancements.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience :\-** 



* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Integration Architect with strong expertise in MuleSoft and Salesforce.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise integration solutions and API\-led architectures.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, security, and middleware technologies.
* Experience creating architecture documents, technical specifications, and implementation guidelines.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing communication skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications :\-** 



* MuleSoft Certified Developer, Platform Architect, or Integration Architect certifications.
* Salesforce certifications are an added advantage.
* Experience with complex enterprise integration programs and multi\-cloud environments.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on complex digital transformation initiatives, architect enterprise\-scale integrations, and collaborate with global clients while leveraging the latest MuleSoft and Salesforce technologies.
 



  





**About OSF Digital** 




 OSF Digital is a Platinum Certified, award\-winning digital transformation and Salesforce partner with over 22 years of experience delivering innovative solutions on the Salesforce platform. With a global presence and deep expertise across Salesforce Clouds, OSF helps organizations accelerate growth through technology, consulting, and customer\-centric digital experiences.
 



 Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn or share their profiles with our recruitment team.

5ef706aa.description:
**Company Description** 
 These job descriptions are intended for sourcing experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations professionals for a large enterprise ERP transformation involving transition from Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, data migration, integrations, reporting/BI, security, testing, training and cutover.
 



  




* **Role Description**



  




 D365 Finance \& Operations Solution Architect / Technical LeadRole Summary
 
 Lead the end\-to\-end D365 F\&O solution architecture and technical delivery across application architecture, extensions, integrations, data, security, environments and deployment.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 ·      Own solution architecture, technical design and architecture decision records.
 



 ·      Translate business requirements into scalable D365 F\&O solutions and identify fit\-to\-standard versus extension requirements.
 



 ·      Lead technical design for integrations, APIs, data migration, security, environments and release management.
 



 ·      Provide technical oversight across development, testing, performance, security and cutover.
 



 ·      Work with functional leads, data/BI specialists and integration resources as one integrated delivery team.
 



 ·      Support implementation governance, design reviews and technical quality gates.
 


 Mandatory / Preferred Experience
 
 ·      8\+ years in Microsoft Dynamics/ERP implementations with strong D365 F\&O experience.
 



 ·      Hands\-on experience with D365 F\&O architecture, extensions, integrations and implementation lifecycle.
 



 ·      Experience with Azure integration services and enterprise integration patterns is strongly preferred.
 



 ·      Experience in Business Central/NAV\-to\-D365 F\&O transition or comparable ERP transformation is strongly preferred.
 


 Certification
 
 ·      Current Microsoft certification relevant to Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations / solution architecture.
 



 ·      Relevant Azure certification is an advantage.
 


 Candidate Submission
 
 ·      Latest CV with project\-by\-project implementation experience.
 



 ·      Certification name, certification ID/reference and current validity status.
 



 ·      At least 2–3 relevant ERP/D365 implementation examples with role, scope and duration.
 



 ·      Availability / notice period and current location.
 



  





  




 D365 Finance \& Operations Functional Consultant / Module LeadRole Summary
 
 Provide functional ownership for one or more core D365 F\&O modules and lead requirements, fit\-gap, configuration, testing and business readiness.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 ·      Lead discovery, process analysis and fit\-to\-standard/fit\-gap workshops.
 



 ·      Configure D365 F\&O and document functional design and business process decisions.
 



 ·      Prepare functional specifications for required extensions and integrations.
 



 ·      Support data mapping, migration validation, SIT, UAT and defect resolution.
 



 ·      Develop test scenarios, user guidance and training material.
 



 ·      Support cutover, go\-live and hypercare.
 


 Mandatory / Preferred Experience
 
 ·      6\+ years of D365 F\&O functional consulting experience.
 



 ·      Strong experience in at least one core area: Finance, Procurement/SCM, Projects or related F\&O functionality.
 



 ·      Experience in enterprise ERP implementation, migration or transformation.
 



 ·      Strong stakeholder, workshop and documentation skills.
 


 Certification
 
 ·      Current Microsoft D365 F\&O certification directly relevant to the proposed module/role is required.
 



 ·      Additional Microsoft certifications are an advantage.
 


 Candidate Submission
 
 ·      Latest CV with project\-by\-project implementation experience.
 



 ·      Certification name, certification ID/reference and current validity status.
 



 ·      At least 2–3 relevant ERP/D365 implementation examples with role, scope and duration.
 



 ·      Availability / notice period and current location.
 



  





  




 D365 Finance \& Operations Functional/Technical ConsultantRole Summary
 
 Support configuration, functional design, technical\-functional analysis, integrations, data and testing across the D365 F\&O solution.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 ·      Analyse requirements and translate them into D365 F\&O functional/technical solutions.
 



 ·      Support configuration, functional specifications and extension requirements.
 



 ·      Assist with data entities, migration mapping, validation and reconciliation.
 



 ·      Support integrations, interfaces, testing, defect resolution and release activities.
 



 ·      Participate in SIT/UAT, cutover rehearsals and hypercare.
 



 ·      Prepare technical/functional documentation and knowledge\-transfer materials.
 


 Mandatory / Preferred Experience
 
 ·      5\+ years of relevant D365 F\&O implementation experience.
 



 ·      Hands\-on experience across functional and technical aspects of D365 F\&O.
 



 ·      Experience with data migration and/or integration is strongly preferred.
 



 ·      Experience working with enterprise ERP stakeholders and structured implementation methodology.
 


 Certification
 
 ·      Current Microsoft D365 F\&O certification is required.
 



 ·      Azure, Power Platform or development certification is an advantage.
 


 Candidate Submission
 
 ·      Latest CV with project\-by\-project implementation experience.
 



 ·      Certification name, certification ID/reference and current validity status.
 



 ·      At least 2–3 relevant ERP/D365 implementation examples with role, scope and duration.
 



 ·      Availability / notice period and current location.
 



  





  




 Power BI / Business Intelligence ConsultantRole Summary
 
 Own reporting and analytics delivery across D365 F\&O, including data models, dashboards, management reporting and BI enablement.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 ·      Design and develop Power BI dashboards and management reports.
 



 ·      Build semantic/data models and reporting structures appropriate to D365 F\&O data.
 



 ·      Translate business KPIs and reporting requirements into usable analytical products.
 



 ·      Support integration of D365 F\&O data into the reporting architecture.
 



 ·      Validate report accuracy against source data and support UAT.
 



 ·      Document dashboards, data definitions and reporting processes and support user training.
 


 Mandatory / Preferred Experience
 
 ·      5\+ years of Power BI / BI implementation experience.
 



 ·      Strong DAX, Power Query, data modelling and dashboard development skills.
 



 ·      Experience with ERP reporting; D365 F\&O experience strongly preferred.
 



 ·      Experience with enterprise reporting, KPI design and role\-based reporting.
 


 Certification

 ·      Additional Azure Data / Fabric / Microsoft analytics certification is an advantage.

 ·      Certification name, certification ID/reference and current validity status.
 



 ·      At least 2–3 relevant ERP/D365 implementation examples with role, scope and duration.
 



 ·      Availability / notice period and current location.

 ·      Support interfaces to banking, property, CRM, HR, payroll or other enterprise systems where required.
 



 ·      Assist with deployment, testing, monitoring and production support.
 


 Mandatory / Preferred Experience
 
 ·      5\+ years of Azure integration experience.
 



 ·      Strong experience with APIs, integration patterns and enterprise application integration.
 



 ·      D365 F\&O integration experience strongly preferred.
 


 Certification
 
 ·      Relevant current Azure certification is preferred.
 



 ·      D365 F\&O technical certification is an advantage.
 


 Candidate Submission
 
 ·      Latest CV with project\-by\-project implementation experience.
 



 ·      Certification name, certification ID/reference and current validity status.

66910edb.title: Senior Security Consultant – Cisco ISE with AWS Cloud Architecture
66910edb.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 AWS Cloud Architect responsible for designing, building, and owning the complete AWS foundation for Gruve's Cisco ISE\-as\-a\-Service (ISEaaS) multi\-tenant managed service, with 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and network security environments. Owns the AWS Organization and multi\-account landing zone, tenant network architecture, security guardrails, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cloud cost management. This is a hands\-on build role: the successful candidate will personally author Terraform modules and design the account structure that every customer tenant is provisioned from, while applying reliability engineering practices to reduce operational toil. Working knowledge of Cisco ISE, RADIUS, and enterprise network security concepts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement multi\-account AWS Organization structure, including Organizational Units (OUs), management account separation, and consolidated billing.
* Design and enforce Service Control Policies (SCPs) and organization\-level guardrails for tenant isolation and compliance.
* Design tenant network architecture: VPC, multi\-AZ subnet design, route tables, VPC endpoints, NAT, DNS (Route 53 private zones including PTR records), and IP address management (IPAM).
* Implement AWS Transit Gateway hub\-and\-spoke connectivity with per\-tenant route tables, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and Direct Connect.
* Implement AWS security services: IAM and IAM Identity Center (SSO), KMS customer\-managed keys, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Own cloud cost management and FinOps: per\-tenant cost attribution, tagging strategy, budget alerts, Cost Explorer and CUR\-based chargeback reporting, and cost modeling to support service pricing and margin analysis.
* Design for high availability and disaster recovery across Availability Zones and regions, including backup, restore, and recovery runbooks.
* Apply reliability engineering practices: automation\-first operations, toil reduction, failure\-mode analysis, and infrastructure observability.
* Implement policy\-as\-code and security scanning in CI/CD pipelines (Checkov, tfsec, or equivalent).
* Partner with automation and ISE engineering teams to ensure infrastructure outputs integrate cleanly with configuration management.
* Subscribe to and manage the Cisco ISE AMI listing on AWS Marketplace per Region, including EULA acceptance and AMI version/release validation before each tenant build.
* Verify and manage AWS service quotas (EC2 instance types, EIPs, VPC limits) per Region/tenant.
* Configure Network ACLs and manage Elastic IP allocation policy (use only where explicitly required; avoid public exposure of ISE by default).
* Enable VPC Flow Logs for tenant VPCs/subnets where required by security or compliance standards.
* Configure EC2 instance metadata options (IMDSv2\) and other instance\-level hardening attributes.
* Own EC2 user\-data / bootstrap configuration for the ISE AMI (hostname, management IP, NTP, DNS) so it hands off cleanly into the Platform Automation Engineer's post\-bootstrap automation.
* Define NTP source design for ISE nodes alongside the existing DNS/Route 53 designs.
* Own the end\-to\-end AWS infrastructure validation checklist (EC2, EBS, security groups, routing, DNS, NTP, IAM, encryption, monitoring) at each tenant go\-live.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cloud architecture roles.
* Demonstrable experience designing and building a multi\-account AWS Organization or landing zone from the ground up.
* Strong hands\-on Terraform experience — candidates should be able to describe modules they have personally authored.
* Solid understanding of AWS networking, including Transit Gateway, VPN, and hybrid connectivity to on\-premises environments.
* Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategy, and cost attribution in multi\-tenant or managed service environments.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional preferred; AWS Advanced Networking or Security specialty certifications an advantage.
* Experience in a managed services provider (MSP), multi\-tenant SaaS, or hosted service environment is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with Cisco ISE, NAC, or enterprise network security concepts is an advantage.
* Strong documentation, design communication, and cross\-team collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS Core: AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Account Factory, Service Control Policies (SCPs), IAM, IAM Identity Center (SSO), EC2, EBS, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager (SSM), CloudWatch.
* AWS Networking: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Transit Gateway, Site\-to\-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, VPC Endpoints, NAT Gateway, IPAM.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (module authoring, remote state, workspaces), Git, CI/CD pipelines, policy\-as\-code (Checkov / tfsec / Sentinel).
* Security \& Governance: CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS key policies, least\-privilege IAM design, multi\-tenant isolation patterns.
* Cloud Financial Management: Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Report (CUR), tagging strategy, budgets and alerts, per\-tenant chargeback and cost modeling.
* Scripting \& Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell (any one or more), REST API integration.
* Familiar with Technologies: Cisco ISE, RADIUS / RADSec, 802\.1X, Ansible, Azure, Kubernetes.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 This role offers the opportunity to influence the successful delivery of clinical trials by ensuring key milestones, timelines, quality standards, and operational objectives are achieved. You will drive collaboration across teams, manage project level budgets and resourcing, support risk mitigation activities, and provide leadership that enables efficient, high\-quality clinical data delivery.
   

  

 You will join a collaborative, fast paced environment where your contributions directly support the development of innovative therapies and strengthen Parexel's commitment to clinical research excellence.

* Collaborate with study teams and Data Standards Associates to support the use of applicable data standards.
* Establish effective working relationships with functional experts and provide leadership, guidance, and project direction to team members as appropriate.
* Monitor scope, timelines, deliverables, and project metrics to ensure contractual commitments and business objectives are achieved.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to operational excellence across project delivery activities.


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Strengths in project leadership, stakeholder engagement, and cross functional collaboration.
* Experience working within clinical research and clinical trial environments.
* The ability to influence, negotiate, and build productive relationships across global and virtual teams.
* A quality focused mindset with strong organizational and problem solving capabilities.
* Comfort working across multiple studies and managing competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a science or industry related discipline, or equivalent qualification.
* Demonstrated application of project management concepts.
* Proven experience leading project teams in a technical, programming, data management, or statistical environment with minimal supervision.
* Understanding of cross functional clinical development activities.
* Knowledge of SOPs, ICH\-GCP guidelines, and applicable local and international regulations.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within global and culturally diverse teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

71e00b3b.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
71e00b3b.description:
**Company Introduction**



We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.



We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.



Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.


**Role Overview**



The Coupang Intelligent Cloud (CIC) organization is building the next\-generation cloud platform that powers Coupang's rapidly expanding business. CIC provides the foundational infrastructure, cloud services, platform capabilities, and operational excellence that enable engineering teams across the company to innovate at scale.



As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will drive large\-scale, cross\-functional initiatives spanning cloud infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, AI infrastructure, platform services, operational excellence, reliability, capacity management, and cloud business growth. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, principal engineers, product leaders, finance, security, and operations teams to define strategy, build execution plans, and deliver business\-critical outcomes.



This role requires a unique combination of technical depth, organizational leadership, operational rigor, and strategic thinking. You will lead complex programs that influence the direction of CIC, establish scalable operating mechanisms, and ensure alignment across multiple organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while driving execution with urgency and accountability.



The ideal candidate can speak the language of engineers, understand large\-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, influence without authority, and navigate ambiguity while delivering measurable results.


**What You Will Do**


* Lead strategic, organization\-wide programs across cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI infrastructure, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Define program strategies, success metrics, execution frameworks, and operating mechanisms that scale across the CIC organization.
* Partner with engineering leaders and principal engineers to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of critical initiatives.
* Drive large\-scale platform transformations involving architecture modernization, reliability improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish governance mechanisms, executive reviews, risk management processes, and business reporting frameworks.
* Identify organizational bottlenecks, process inefficiencies, and system gaps, and implement scalable solutions to improve execution.
* Lead initiatives involving infrastructure scalability, cloud adoption, capacity planning, service availability, and operational readiness.
* Analyze complex technical and business data to drive prioritization, decision\-making, and resource allocation.
* Define and track organizational KPIs, operational health metrics, reliability goals, and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, security, finance, procurement, and business teams to achieve company objectives.
* Drive executive\-level communications, presenting program status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor TPMs and contribute to the growth of program management excellence within CIC.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technical programs in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or related technology domains.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, storage, compute platforms, and modern software development practices.
* Experience driving programs across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through deployment and operational support.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage metrics and data to influence decisions and measure outcomes.
* Experience identifying root causes, managing risks, and solving complex organizational and technical challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working in hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, or large\-scale distributed systems environments.
* Strong technical understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure automation.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure programs involving compute, networking, storage, observability, security, or AI/ML platforms.
* Experience partnering with Principal Engineers and senior technical leaders to drive architecture and platform transformation initiatives.


**Type of work model**



Hybrid /Onsite / Remote working


* Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.


**Details to consider**



Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.



Privacy Notice


* Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

b1e8d426.title: Intermediate Technical Program Manager
b1e8d426.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R\&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all\-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook\-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. In your first year, you’ll be expected to independently run a portfolio of programs from scoping through delivery and retrospectives, and to improve how R\&D programs operate by contributing to and evolving Technical Program Management best practices.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.
* Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.
* Own end\-to\-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.
* Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.
* Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.
* Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision\-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.
* Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.
* Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R\&D programs run across GitLab.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.
* Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.
* Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation\-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.
* Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.
* Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.


**About The Team**
 You’ll join the R\&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross\-functional team that leads high\-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. The team focuses on driving clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery for complex initiatives that touch many parts of GitLab, using a handbook\-first, asynchronous way of working with stakeholders across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and partners in other functions to improve how programs are planned, executed, and communicated, helping evolve shared practices, templates, and tooling for program governance across R\&D.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

43660312.title: Engineering Program Manager
43660312.description:
**Role:** 
 Engineering Program Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (
 **On\-site)** 




**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Space Technology
 



  





**About Catalyx Space:** 




 Catalyx Space is building the world's best reentry systems. Our reusable ReX vehicles return payloads from orbit at unprecedented scale, up to 12 tons and 60m³ of cargo, while operating the full mission lifecycle from launch to recovery. Our core innovation is a Origami\-inspired deployable heat shield that combines the scalability of an inflatable system with the robustness of a rigid structure. Built from commercial off\-the\-shelf components, it enables the world's widest heat shields, the largest payload return volumes, and a scalable pathway for returning everything from commercial cargo to future space nuclear assets.
 



  





**Role:** 




 As an
 **Engineering Program Manager** 
 , you will own the integrated engineering schedule across avionics, structures, mechanisms, aerothermal, systems, and test.
 



 You will establish and run the program cadence that keeps approximately 40 engineers aligned toward common vehicle milestones and serve as the source of truth for engineering program status, schedule, risks, dependencies, and forecast dates.
 



 This is a hands\-on program leadership role requiring a strong understanding of complex hardware development and the ability to drive cross\-functional execution from design through build, integration, testing, and flight readiness.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Build and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule across engineering subsystems, with clearly defined dependencies and critical paths to major milestones
* Map and track cross\-functional dependencies across design freeze, procurement, manufacturing, build, integration, and test
* Track long\-lead components, vendor deliveries, fabrication schedules, and test\-facility bookings
* Identify schedule risks and potential slips early and drive mitigation actions with relevant owners
* Run the weekly engineering program review covering commitments, progress, blockers, actions, risks, and escalations
* Maintain the program risk register with clear owners, mitigation plans, and closure criteria

d26284bb.title: Engineering Program Manager
d26284bb.description:
**Engineering Program Manager** 




**\[IC role]** 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an experienced Engineering Program Manager to drive planning, execution, and continuous improvement across our Engineering organization. You'll act as the execution orchestrator across Engineering — turning roadmap priorities into executable plans, keeping cross\-team delivery on track, and making sure customer\-impacting issues, releases, and demos move smoothly from commitment to completion.
 




  






 You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and Sales Engineers (SEs), and you'll need to influence outcomes without direct authority — bringing structure to ambiguous problems and surfacing risks early.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Roadmap \& Sprint Execution** 





 Translate roadmap objectives into milestones, deliverables, and timelines across Engineering teams.
 





 Own planning and tracking for sprints and projects: define dependencies, track scope changes and blockers, and flag delivery risk before it becomes slippage.
 





 Sequence work across teams based on business priority, capacity, and dependencies; facilitate trade\-off discussions when priorities conflict.
 





 Maintain program dashboards as the single source of truth for delivery status.
 




  





**2\. Cross\-Functional \& Customer Issue Coordination** 





 Serve as the coordination point between Engineering, Product, Customer Supoort, CSMs, and SEs on customer\-reported issues.
 





 Track issues from investigation through release and customer validation; drive aging or high\-impact issues to resolution.
 





 Ensure decisions, owners, and timelines are documented and communicated; escalate critical issues with clear context and recommended action.
 




  





**3\. Release \& Demo Coordination** 





 Coordinate releases across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps; own release timelines and readiness reviews.
 





 Organize feature/sprint demos for CSMs, SEs, and Product; ensure feedback and action items get routed to the right owners.
 





 Support post\-release validation and retrospectives for major releases.
 




  





**4\. Quality, RCA \& Continuous Improvement** 





 Drive completion of Root Cause Analyses for significant customer\-impacting bugs and recurring defects, with clear owners and target dates.
 





 Analyze issue data to spot systemic patterns; partner with Customer Support, Engineering and Product on permanent fixes, not workarounds.
 





 Facilitate retrospectives and ensure findings feed back into planning.
 




  





**5\. Process Improvement** 





 Identify bottlenecks, gaps, and manual effort in existing workflows; design and standardize processes that improve predictability.
 





 Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tracking and reporting.
 





 Establish metrics to confirm process changes are actually working.
 





 Tracking \& Improving Customer Support SLAs.
 




  





**6\. Stakeholder Communication** 





 Run a predictable communication cadence covering progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.
 





 Tailor updates for Engineering, Product, customer\-facing teams, and leadership.
 





 Proactively surface deviations from plan — don't wait for escalation.
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 





 5\+ years in Program Management, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Project Management in a software/technology company.
 





 Proven experience driving execution across multiple Engineering teams with interdependent deliverables, in an Agile/Scrum environment.
 





 Track record coordinating cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, Customer Support, Sales/SE).
 





 Strong stakeholder management — able to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
 





 Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and delivery/reporting tools.
 





 Experience with release management, RCA/defect trend analysis, or engineering dashboards.
 




  





**Good to Have** 





 Technical background or experience working closely with engineers.
 





 B2B SaaS / enterprise software experience.
 





 Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or application architecture.
 





 Experience with distributed/geographically diverse teams.
 





 PMP, SAFe, or Scrum Master certification.
 





 Strong analytical skills and comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities.
 




  





**Success in This Role** 





 Roadmap and sprint delivery become measurably more predictable.
 





 Customer\-impacting issues resolve faster, with clear ownership and tracking.
 





 Recurring defects decline through consistent RCA follow\-through.
 





 Engineering, Customer Support, Product, CSM, and SE teams report better visibility and alignment.

662e9440.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre-Sales)
662e9440.description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Who You'll Work With** 




  





 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role; you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
 


* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus

20db99c7.title: Solution Sales Engineer(AI)
20db99c7.description:
This is a remote position.
 



 Role: Solution Sales Engineer, AI
   





 Location: Remote
   





 Duration: Full time
   





 About Us
   





 Dhan AI is a boutique consulting and product company focused on AI first delivery and modern enterprise platforms. We work closely with customers to identify business problems, demonstrate solutions, and build technology that creates real business impact.
   





 The Role
   





 We are looking for a Solutions Engineer who can work closely with our sales and product teams to understand customer problems, shape solutions, and deliver compelling product demonstrations.
   





 This is a highly customer facing role. You will be expected to understand both the business problem and the technology behind the solution...and communicate both clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
   





 The ideal candidate is someone who can walk into a customer conversation, understand the problem, build the right story, demonstrate the product effectively, and help the customer see why the solution matters.
   





 What You’ll Do
   





 • Work closely with sales teams to understand customer requirements and opportunities
   





 • Participate in customer discovery sessions and understand business processes, pain points, and desired outcomes
   





 • Design and present compelling product demonstrations tailored to the customer's specific problem
   





 • Build demos, prototypes, proof of concepts, and solution mockups quickly
   





 • Translate customer requirements into practical solution approaches
   





 • Explain technical concepts, architecture, integrations, AI capabilities, and tradeoffs to customers
   





 • Work closely with product and engineering teams to validate solution feasibility
   





 • Support proposals, solution presentations, RFPs, and technical responses
   





 • Help identify opportunities to expand existing customer engagements
   





 • Stay current with AI capabilities and use AI extensively to improve demo preparation, research, prototyping, and solution development
   




  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  


 What We’re Looking For
   





 • Strong communication and presentation skills
   





 • Confident and engaging customer presence
   





 • Ability to understand a business problem and tell a compelling solution story
   





 • Strong problem solving and analytical ability
   





 • Technical fluency and comfort discussing software, APIs, integrations, data, cloud, and AI
   





 • Ability to learn products and technologies quickly
   





 • Ability to build practical prototypes and demos rather than relying only on slides
   





 • Strong ownership and bias toward action
   





 • Comfortable working in ambiguous and fast moving environments
   





 AI Fluency
   





 AI is a core part of this role.
   





 We want someone who actively experiments with AI and understands how modern AI tools can be used to build solutions and improve productivity.
   





 Candidates who can demonstrate personal projects, prototypes, AI enabled workflows, or other practical experimentation will stand out.
   





 What Makes This Role Different
   





 This is not a traditional sales role and not a traditional engineering role.
   





 You will sit at the intersection of Customer \+ Sales \+ Product \+ Engineering.
   





 You will be expected to understand the customer's problem, create the right solution narrative, demonstrate what is possible, and work with the engineering team to turn the opportunity into reality.
   





 The best person for this role can make a customer say:
   





 "Yes...this is exactly what we need."

Position SummaryAre you passionate about transforming how Finance teams leverage AI to work smarter? Join Walmart’s AI Center of Excellence, where you'll provide technical leadership for cutting‑edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) initiatives that empower our Finance organization.
   

  

 This hybrid role combines strategic technical oversight with hands‑on problem‑solving. You'll guide teams in building intelligent AI solutions while ensuring they meet Walmart’s standards for quality, scalability, and responsible AI. Your expertise in modern AI patterns\-including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)\-will help shape the future of AI‑driven financial workflows at one of the world’s largest retailers.
   

  

 About TeamThe AI Center of Excellence partners with business functions across Walmart to design and implement next‑generation AI solutions that make a real difference. Our team focuses on applying modern AI and LLM capabilities to:
   

  

* Enhance productivity across the enterprise
* Improve decision‑making with intelligent insights
* Simplify complex workflows through automation
* Democratize AI capabilities for all associates


 As part of the Finance AI COE team, you’ll work at the intersection of technology and business, helping Finance teams leverage AI to drive better outcomes for Walmart and our customers.
   

  

 What You’ll DoTechnical Leadership \& Solution Oversight
   

  

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance for AI/LLM initiatives supporting Finance workflows and analytics
* Review solution designs and implementation approaches to ensure alignment with best practices, governance, and responsible AI principles
* Translate complex Finance business needs into AI‑enabled solution strategies and actionable technical requirements
* Oversee the development of intelligent assistants that interpret natural language prompts and deliver insights
* Exposure to conversational AI architectures will be helpful
* Research, evaluate, and recommend AI platforms and services to enhance Finance processes


 Modern AI Patterns \& Innovation
   

  

* Guide teams in adopting and implementing modern AI patterns, including: – Model Context Protocol (MCP) for structured model interaction – Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) for enhanced grounding and context
* Support development of natural language‑driven capabilities, conversational interfaces, and AI‑powered automation
* Champion innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement in AI solution design
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability to Finance use cases


 Hands\-On Technical Support
   

  

* Step in hands‑on to debug AI‑generated logic and validate system behaviour
* Optimize prompting strategies and model interactions
* Improve quality, grounding, and accuracy of AI‑generated outputs
* Validate end‑to‑end solution performance
* Work with large datasets to ensure data structures are optimized for AI solutions
* Provide guidance on integrating AI capabilities with Business Intelligence (BI) environments and analytical workflows


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
   

  

* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to non‑technical stakeholders
* Influence alignment across Finance, Engineering, and Data Science teams
* Foster a culture of AI literacy and responsible AI practices
* Partner with Finance leaders to identify high‑impact AI opportunities


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Overall 7–8\+ years of experience in AI/ML, analytics, software engineering, or related technical fields
* Strong understanding of contemporary AI/LLM systems:


 – Prompting techniques and optimization strategies
   

  

 – Grounding strategies for factual accuracy
   

  

 – Enterprise AI solution design patterns
   

  

* Experience working with large datasets and data‑informed systems
* Strong SQL skills for validation, analysis, and optimization
* Exposure to Business Intelligence (BI) and analytical ecosystems
* Excellent communication skills for diverse audiences
* Strong stakeholder partnership and cross‑functional collaboration skills
* Self‑starter mindset with curiosity, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguity


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience applying AI solutions in Finance or large enterprise environments
* Familiarity with enterprise AI governance and responsible AI practices
* Ability to evaluate and improve end‑to‑end quality of AI solutions
* Experience debugging or enhancing AI‑generated or rapidly‑prototyped applications (including “vibe‑coded” solutions)
* Knowledge of Finance workflows, analytics, and reporting requirements
* Experience with conversational AI, chatbots, or natural language interfaces
* Contributions to open‑source AI projects or broader technical communities


**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.

 Our department is on a bold journey — transforming and modernizing our IT landscape to enable Volvo’s vision of becoming a

 We’re reimagining end\-to\-end processes, driving transformation, and unlocking the full potential of data to shape smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable operations.
