1fc4f7bb.title: Technical Delivery Manager - Data Engineering - RDT Pharma Medicines
1fc4f7bb.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The Technical Data Delivery Manager will own the delivery of data solutions across the Pharma Commercial ecosystem — including Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Managed Markets, Patient Services, and Commercial Analytics. This role acts as the critical link between commercial business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely data across the full commercial data lifecycle — from data acquisition and integration through to reporting and insights.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Data Delivery\& Program Management
  
  

* Own delivery of data pipelines, integrations, and platforms supporting Commercial functions: Sales (call activity, targeting, alignments), Marketing (campaign/digital engagement), Market Access (payer/formulary data), and Patient Services (hub/specialty pharmacy data).
* Manage data ingestion from third\-party sources: IQVIA, Symphony Health/Komodo, Veeva, Definitive Healthcare, claims data (medical/pharmacy), specialty pharmacy, and distributor data.
* Lead sprint planning, release cycles, UAT, and production go\-lives in partnership with data engineering, IT, and business teams.
* Manage timelines for recurring commercial data cycles (e.g., monthly/weekly sales data refreshes, incentive compensation cycles, alignment updates)
* Manage key projects and programs


Business\& Technical Liaison
  
  

* Translate requirements from Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Marketing, and Market Access teams into technical specifications.
* Serve as SME on commercial data domains: sales force effectiveness (SFE), CRM (Veeva/Salesforce), MDM (customer/HCP/HCO data), incentive compensation, segmentation\& targeting, and syndicated data.
* Partner with Compliance/Legal/Privacy on data usage governance (HIPAA, state privacy laws, data licensing terms with vendors like IQVIA/Veeva).


Data Quality\& Governance
  
  

* Define and monitor KPIs for data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness across commercial data feeds.
* Establish reconciliation and exception\-handling processes (e.g., HCP/HCO matching, territory alignment discrepancies, sales data anomalies).
* Drive root\-cause analysis for data issues impacting compensation, targeting, or reporting accuracy.


Team\& Vendor Leadership
  
  

* Manage data analysts/engineers and/or third\-party vendors and system integrators.
* Own vendor relationships with commercial data providers (IQVIA, Veeva, Symphony/Komodo, Definitive Healthcare, etc.).


Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to automate manual data processes and improve delivery speed/scalability.
* Support data governance initiatives across the commercial data landscape.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (Master's a plus).
* 7\+ years in data management/delivery, with 3\+ years specifically inpharma/biotech/life sciences commercial data.
* Experience with commercial data platforms: Veeva CRM, Salesforce, MDM tools (Reltio, IQVIA OneKey), incentive compensation systems.
* Strong knowledge of pharma commercial data sources: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD), Symphony Health/Komodo, claims data, specialty pharmacy/hub data, HCP/HCO reference data.
* Proficiency in SQL, ETL/data pipeline tools, and cloud data warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift).
* Program/project management experience delivering technical solutions in a regulated, matrixed environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technical functions.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data stack tools (dbt, Airflow, Informatica).
* Familiarity with BI/visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Spotfire).
* Understanding of pharma compliance (Sunshine Act, HIPAA, OIG guidelines) as applied to commercial data use.
* Agile/Scrum or PMP certification.


Key Competencies
  
  

* Broad domain fluency across pharma commercial functions (not siloed to one area)
* Technical depth in data architecture/integration
* Vendor and cross\-functional stakeholder management
* Strong analytical/problem\-solving orientation
* Comfort operating in a highly regulated, compliance\-sensitive environment


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

65736b72.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Architect
65736b72.description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent 15 years learning that emulation is not just about running tests faster, it is about finding the bugs that matter before they cost millions in silicon respins. The difference between a verification plan that looks complete and one that actually catches corner cases is something you can spot in the first ten minutes of a review. You know PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet at the protocol level, not just the spec level, because you have debugged enough real failures to understand where theory and implementation diverge.


Working with Zebu is second nature to you. You have built emulation environments that bridge the gap between what the platform can do and what your design team actually needs. When someone says "the emulation IP does not support that feature," you do not stop there. You figure out the workaround, propose the enhancement, or find another path entirely.


You operate comfortably across geographies and functions. Design teams, verification teams, IP teams, they all speak slightly different languages, and you translate between them without losing the technical thread. Matrixed organizations do not slow you down because you know how to build consensus without waiting for perfect alignment. At Synopsys, you will define how we validate the next generation of high\-speed interfaces, and the IP you help verify will ship in products that power everything from data centers to autonomous systems.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Close the gap between Zebu emulation IP capabilities and what Design IP teams need to verify PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet controllers and PHYs across functional and performance domains
* Define technical requirements for emulation IP, working directly with IP development teams to ensure correct implementation, deployment, and integration into verification flows
* Track and report emulation IP quality metrics, identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities that directly impact product schedules and silicon success
* Stay ahead of evolving PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet standards, translating specification updates, ECNs, and errata into actionable requirements for both emulation and design teams
* Review and validate test plans for emulation IP and design IP, ensuring coverage is complete, traceable, and aligned with real\-world use cases and customer requirements
* Drive cross\-functional alignment on verification methodology, standardizing workflows and best practices across global teams to improve efficiency and reduce rework
* Mentor engineers on emulation strategy, IP verification techniques, and how to think critically about coverage and quality in pre\-silicon environments

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate time to market for high\-speed interface IP by catching critical bugs in emulation before they reach silicon
* Influence the roadmap and feature set of Synopsys emulation IP, shaping tools that thousands of engineers across the company depend on
* Elevate verification quality across multiple product lines by defining and evangelizing best practices that become the standard
* Reduce costly silicon respins by ensuring emulation environments accurately model real\-world system behavior and corner cases
* Build bridges between geographically distributed teams, turning fragmented verification efforts into cohesive, repeatable strategies
* Position Synopsys as the industry leader in pre\-silicon validation by driving adoption of cutting\-edge emulation techniques
* Enable the next generation of AI, automotive, and data center products by ensuring the IP that powers them is verified to the highest standard

### **What You'll Need**

* 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in emulation, IP verification, or ASIC digital design
* Deep expertise in PCIe and DDR protocols, including verification strategies, corner cases, and standards compliance
* Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP\-level verification and system\-level integration
* Proven track record leading or contributing to IP product development with a focus on emulation\-based verification
* Strong ability to work across global, matrixed teams and drive alignment between emulation IP and design IP organizations
* Excellent communication skills, you can explain a complex tradeoff to a design lead in two sentences without losing the nuance
* Experience interpreting and applying industry standards updates, ECNs, and errata in real verification contexts is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a test plan review, spot the missing corner case that everyone else missed, and explain why it matters in two sentences
* When something does not work in emulation, you do not wait for someone else to fix it. You dig in, reproduce it, and come back with a proposal
* You are comfortable saying "this verification strategy will not catch that class of bugs" in a room full of senior engineers, and you can back it up with data
* Ambiguity does not slow you down. You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and keep moving
* You have mentored engineers before and you know the difference between giving someone the answer and helping them learn how to find it
* You treat verification like a product. You think about the user experience, the failure modes, and what happens six months from now when someone else has to maintain what you built

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join a dynamic, high\-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross\-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry\-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture \- As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience working for ITES clients.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**

Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Agora is trusted by over 1,700 leading organizations across the globe to power best\-in\-class real\-time experiences from social media and live shopping to education and telehealth.
   

  

****Job Title:****
 Solutions Architect
   

  

****Location:****

**Job Summary**
 As a
 ****Solution Architect****
 at Agora, you’ll act as the technical expert bridging customer vision with Agora’s platform. You will design scalable architectures, lead complex integrations, and serve as a trusted advisor to strategic partners and enterprise customers building real\-time engagement applications. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on architecting robust technical solutions, enjoys teamwork, and loves collaborating with customers to bring ambitious ideas to life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with Sales teams to support revenue growth by aligning Agora’s real\-time engagement, conversational AI, and Agent Studio solutions with customer business drivers, operational challenges, and strategic use cases.
* Collaborate with mid\-market to enterprise customers and partners to understand technical requirements, architecture constraints, scalability goals, security considerations, and user experience expectations.

* Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams to drive revenue goals, improve customer experience, and influence product direction based on market feedback.

974e85ad.title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Solution Architect)
974e85ad.description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Worley is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to define and deliver integrated digital, OT, IT, data, application, infrastructure, integration, and security architectures for major industrial programs. The role will translate business and operational objectives into practical solution designs, architecture artefacts, integration models, and implementation\-ready guidance supporting procurement, vendor assessment, FEED delivery, and project execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong architecture capability, practical IT/OT integration experience, cybersecurity\-by\-design awareness, and the ability to align client, engineering, vendor, and delivery stakeholders around secure, scalable, and operationally maintainable outcomes.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Develop solution architectures across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, OT, IT, and security domains, ensuring alignment with client reference models and delivery\-phase requirements.
* Translate enterprise architecture, business objectives, and operational requirements into actionable solution designs that guide procurement, vendor assessment, implementation planning, and project execution.
* Produce implementation\-focused architecture artefacts, including system context diagrams, logical and physical architecture views, integration models, infrastructure deployment views, network segmentation concepts, platform deployment views, application interface definitions, and architecture decision records.
* Define integration and interoperability models across industrial levels 1\-4, including OT/IT convergence, edge/cloud hybrid deployments, data exchange patterns, secure connectivity, and segmented network architectures.
* Apply architecture governance to ensure solutions meet client standards, engineering requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable industrial frameworks such as IEC 62443, ISA\-95, OPC UA, MQTT, and other relevant integration patterns.
* Collaborate with internal and client\-side stakeholders, including OT, IT, cybersecurity, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, project delivery, vendors, and system integrators, to gather requirements, validate assumptions, and coordinate architecture inputs.
* Support traceability of business, operational, functional, non\-functional, and technical requirements through architecture artefacts and requirements management tools.
* Assess vendor and system integrator solutions for functional alignment, technical feasibility, interoperability, cybersecurity, maintainability, scalability, and lifecycle suitability.
* Contribute to risk assessments, cost\-benefit analysis, project option selection, transition planning, and FEED\-to\-delivery handover.
* Support design reviews, workshops, procurement packages, tender responses, implementation planning, and executive\-level technical briefings.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to multidisciplinary teams while maintaining alignment with project governance, quality, safety, and delivery assurance processes.
* Identify architecture risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions, and support their resolution through structured engagement with stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of emerging industrial digital, OT networking, cybersecurity, cloud, edge, data, and automation technologies and apply them pragmatically where they provide measurable client value.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Deep experience in solution architecture across technology, application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains.
* Strong understanding of OT and IT networking technologies, including segmented networks, SDN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, hosting services, cloud networks, secure remote access, and IT/OT convergence strategies.
* Knowledge of industrial automation and control systems architectures, including fixed and wireless networks, telemetry, SCADA, PLCs, DCS, historians, edge systems, and the transport of critical production data.
* Experience developing high\-fidelity architecture artefacts that support system procurement, design validation, implementation planning, and stakeholder decision\-making.
* Practical understanding of IT/OT system interoperability in mining, resources, utilities, oil and gas, or other large\-scale industrial programs.
* Knowledge of integration patterns and protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, API gateways, message brokers, industrial data platforms, and secure data exchange across OT and enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity\-by\-design principles, including network segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, defence\-in\-depth, access control, secure interfaces, and industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Ability to align diverse technical stakeholders through structured architecture methods, workshops, design reviews, decision records, and clear visual communication.
* Experience in hybrid cloud\-edge deployments, remote operations concepts, platform orchestration, digital integration, and secure connectivity for operational environments.
* Ability to support cost, risk, schedule, procurement, vendor, and delivery decisions with architecture\-led evidence and traceability.


**Other Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Control Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\-15 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, systems architecture, digital architecture, OT/IT architecture, or industrial technology architecture within mining, resources, energy, utilities, oil and gas, or large\-scale industrial environments.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business, operational, and engineering requirements into practical, implementable architecture solutions.
* Experience producing architecture artefacts, architecture decisions, technical assessments, solution options, system interface definitions, and implementation\-supporting documentation.
* Experience collaborating with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, OT, IT, telecommunications, control systems, digital, operations, vendor, and project delivery teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architecture concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of project delivery lifecycles from concept and FEED through detailed design, implementation support, commissioning, and handover.
* Architecture certifications such as TOGAF, SABSA, ArchiMate, Azure/AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical credentials.
* Network, cybersecurity, or OT credentials such as CCNP, IEC 62443 Foundation/Practitioner, CISSP, GICSP, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with architecture modelling, requirements traceability, and portfolio tools such as Orbus Infinity, ArchiMate\-based tooling, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial digital platforms, data platforms, edge computing, cloud integration, remote operations, autonomous systems, and critical communications environments.
* Experience supporting procurement, vendor assessment, RFP/RFQ development, technical bid evaluation, and implementation transition planning.
* Structured, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused, with the ability to navigate technical ambiguity and convert complex requirements into clear architecture direction.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in complex, multidisciplinary delivery environments.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, executives, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, security\-related, and commercially confidential information.
* Proactive, service\-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve client and project outcomes.
* Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, sustainability, and Worley values.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

c2fc8e78.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
c2fc8e78.description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2\-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.
   

  






**About SailPoint**





 SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less. Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud\-oriented, modern enterprise.
   

  






**About the role**





 As a Salesforce Architect at SailPoint, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our enterprise architecture, ensuring our CRM architecture aligns perfectly with global standards and business objectives. In this role, your typical day will involve leading the design, implementation, and optimization of our Salesforce ecosystem, which includes Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ. You will act as the technical anchor, translating complex business needs into scalable, secure, and high\-quality technical architectures. You will write and review Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC), design integrations and APIs, and work collaboratively with global stakeholders to unlock the maximum potential of our Salesforce platform.
   

  






**About the team**





 You will join our high\-performing Enterprise Applications and Business IT team. This global team of dedicated developers, administrators, and business analysts is committed to driving operational excellence across SailPoint's core systems. We collaborate closely with cross\-functional business stakeholders to design and build automated, efficient enterprise workflows. We operate in an agile environment that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, providing you with a supportive network to deliver high\-impact results.
   

  






**Requirements**



* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 13 years of experience on the Salesforce platform, with a proven track record in solution design and architecture
* Strong, hands\-on knowledge of Salesforce configurations, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Proven experience with Salesforce integrations, APIs, and enterprise\-grade third\-party integration tools
* Deep familiarity with multiple Salesforce clouds, specifically Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ
* Active Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect credentials



**Preferred Skills**



* Active Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts
* Knowledge of SailPoint's identity security products and how they integrate with Salesforce
* Strong experience working within Agile development methodologies and modern DevOps pipelines
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global stakeholders



**​
 
 Roadmap for success :**




**First 30 days:**



* Master the technical stack by completing a deep\-dive review of our Salesforce ecosystem (Sales, Service, CPQ) and existing integrations to understand operational workflows.
* Align with Product Owners and business stakeholders to map out strategic project roadmaps and backlog priorities for the upcoming quarters.
* Learn and adopt internal DevOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, release management protocols, and environment strategies.
* Establish collaborative working patterns by conducting introductory meetings and technical syncs with developers, administrators, and business analysts.



**By 60 days:**



* Partner with business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce architectural designs.
* 6 months:
* Lead and deliver at least one high\-impact, strategic Salesforce architectural initiative from conception to successful production deployment.
* Optimize system performance by identifying, diagnosing, and resolving platform bottlenecks, reducing technical debt by 15% across core modules.
* Design and implement at least two reusable integration frameworks or API patterns to streamline data flow between Salesforce and downstream business applications.
* Establish long\-term system health monitoring configurations and DevOps enhancements to support automated testing and environment alignment.



**By 1 year:**



* Own the overall Salesforce architecture roadmap, aligning platform capabilities with SailPoint's long\-term business and enterprise systems goals.
* Foster a proactive engineering culture by implementing intelligent automation patterns to reduce manual development or operational tasks.
* Audit and modernize data management strategies, including the optimization of data modeling, data sharing rules, and archiving processes.
* Conduct architectural reviews for all major platform enhancements, ensuring 100% compliance with security, scalability, and enterprise standards.
* Drive solution quality by performing regular code reviews of Apex and LWC, advocating for development best practices, and mentoring junior developers on architectural guardrails.
* Facilitate sprint delivery by collaborating with the Scrum team to resolve technical impediments, refine technical user stories, and ensure predictable releases.



**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**





 Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting\-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever\-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.  
   



  
   



 Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2\-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:  
 



* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health\-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* Restricted stock units at certain levels
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays
* Flexible Work hours



 SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  
   

  





 Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

 Regular Shift

 **Salesforce ARM / Revenue Cloud** 
 , ensuring alignment with enterprise roadmaps and domain blueprints.

 Guide development teams in platform customization and technical execution, including AMPScript, SSJS, SQL, Data Extensions, advanced triggers, automations, and complex business logic.

 Lead delivery teams, manage resource requirements, establish delivery plans, perform effort estimations, and mentor technical team members in a problem\-solving environment.

* **Experience:** 
 9–12 years of progressive experience in Salesforce delivery management, technical architecture, business analysis, and full lifecycle enterprise CRM implementations.

 Proven expertise in
 **Salesforce ARM (Agentforce Revenue Management / Revenue Cloud)** 
 , Salesforce CPQ, and Billing engines. Deep understanding of advanced revenue management workflows, contract lifecycle management, and asset state management.

 Salesforce Certified System / Application Architect, Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud / CloudSense certifications highly preferred.
* **Core Competencies:**
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with an ability to present to executive audiences.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and conflict\-management skills.
* Demonstrated track record of building, managing, and sustaining team\-oriented environments.
* Professional demeanor with a strong client\-first mentality and desire to innovate in a fast\-paced ecosystem.

a9e4337d.title: Oracle Cloud Supply Chain - Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation
a9e4337d.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level: Oracle Cloud Supply Chain – Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Partner with clients to assess and optimize complex supply chain business processes, translating requirements into robust Oracle Cloud Supply Chain solutions. Provide strategic leadership in the configuration and implementation of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules, overseeing fit\-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, testing, and user training. Take end\-to\-end ownership of issue resolution and risk management, collaborating with global teams to ensure the successful delivery of high\-quality solutions. Mentor and guide junior team members, drive continuous process improvements, and contribute to the development of best practices and organizational knowledge. Actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide support for delivery teams and staff in local offices
   

  

**The team:**
 Our Oracle Enterprise Solutions team partners with clients to modernize their core business environments, leveraging Oracle ERP Cloud, EBS, and other Oracle products. We work collaboratively to deliver projects that drive digital transformation, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes across industries.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills**
* 7–11 years of experience leading Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) implementations, including multiple full\-cycle projects as a solution architect or project lead.
* Deep expertise in Oracle SCM modules such as Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Material, and Costing, with a proven track record of delivering complex solutions.
* Advanced ability to define and document business requirements, lead fit\-gap analysis, architect business process designs, and oversee the configuration and integration of Oracle SCM applications.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with extensive experience partnering with clients to drive business process transformation and strategic enhancements. Demonstrated leadership in mentoring teams, managing cross\-functional initiatives, and contributing to best practices and organizational growth.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint)


**Good To Have Skills**
* Extensive experience managing onsite\-offshore delivery models, with a proven ability to mentor and develop junior team members across global teams.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing complex, end\-to\-end business cycles such as order\-to\-cash and procure\-to\-pay, ensuring seamless integration and process optimization.
* Proven capability to lead multiple work streams within large\-scale Oracle SCM projects, driving successful outcomes and aligning with organizational objectives.
* Comprehensive understanding of supply chain, planning, and manufacturing processes across diverse industry domains, enabling strategic solution design and implementation.
* Advanced negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of resolving conflicting priorities and building consensus among senior client and internal stakeholders.


**Education:**
**Location:**
* Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Chennai/Pune


**Shift Timings:**
* Applicable as per business requirements


 \#FY27OraclecloudskillsOpenroles
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

c045f116.title: Program Manager - IFS Loops
c045f116.description:
IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.
   

  





 At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.
   

  





 We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.
   

  





 By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a
 **global, diverse environment;** 
 you will be joining a
 **winning team** 
 with a
 **commitment to sustainability;**
 and a company where we get things done so that you can
 **make a positive impact** 
 on the world.
   

  





 We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can
 **\#MakeYourMoment** 
 so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
   

  





 If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 IFS Loops is revolutionizing how leaders and teams work with our agentic platform, driving
   

  

 unprecedented efficiency and scale. We’re establishing a new Program Management team and
   

  

 are looking for a Program Manager to join us in India, working with EST and UK time zones. This
   

  

 role is crucial for managing and delivering complex, high\-impact projects for our largest
   

  

 enterprise customers. You will work closely with clients, internal teams, and senior leadership to
   

  

 ensure successful project execution and long\-term business value.
   

  





**Key Responsibility**




 As a Program Manager, you will be a key member of a newly formed team, responsible for
   

  

 delivering our most high\-profile customer engagements. This means you’ll be:
   

  





  

  




* Program Management: Leading and managing multiple enterprise\-level projects from initiation through delivery, optimization, and tuning.
* You’ll ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget, adhering to our Services Methodology approach.
* Customer Engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leaders and project managers.
* You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for project\-related activities and help educate clients on the nuances of AI and AI assistants.
* **Workshop Ownership and Execution** 
 : Taking ownership of developing workshops to support the creation of user stories and technical requirements for our customers’ AI assistants.
* **Operations** 
 : Managing dependencies and resources, initiating change orders, and documenting all key decisions and meeting outcomes. You’ll also support the sales process as needed to instill customer confidence.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : Coordinating services team members—including solution architects, implementation specialists, and integration engineers—to ensure cohesive project execution. You’ll also collaborate with product, customer success, and sales teams.
* **Risk Management** 
 : Identifying potential project risks and proactively developing mitigation strategies. You’ll serve as the primary escalation point for issues that could jeopardize customer satisfaction or project completion.
* **Steering Committee Ownership**

 Job Description
   

  

 The Program \& Project Management team coordinates and lead the delivery of cross\-functional programs involving Agile software development teams in Germany, Poland, the U.S., and India. You have strong communication and meeting facilitation skills, a persistent drive for completion and process improvement, and an ability to clearly present information for decisions and approvals.
   

  

 The MES (Manufacturing Execution System) team is looking for a Project Manager who can manage projects and diverse programmes in growth engine. Plex MES is a cloud\-based product within the Rockwell Automation portfolio with multiple programs that enhance on capabilities available to customers including AI initiatives that enable productivity and efficiency from its comprehensive platform. Your initial focus will focus on these Plex initiatives, but you may also involve yourself in other software projects across the Software and Controls department, especially when India development teams involve themselves. You will report to Program Design Manager and will be based in Hinjewadi working in hybrid.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Manage project resourcing, schedules, scope, risks, issues, security requirements, and annual planning for programme areas.
* Tracks artifacts and facilitates Security compliance, SOC2/ISO auditing.
* Manage project financials including monthly forecasting and actuals including facilitating/validating SOWs, invoices, good receipts, etc.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years of professional experience with 5 years in program/project management.
* 1\+ years Cloud / SaaS software industry.

7cd7eb20.title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
7cd7eb20.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

319c6f10.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As a Salesforce Project Manager (Individual contributor), you will lead \& own the end\-to\-end delivery of global, outcomes\-based Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies and modern, AI\-enabled delivery practices. You will be accountable for delivery excellence, financial performance, governance, and stakeholder alignment, operating with a strong business\-owner \& customer\-first mindset. This role requires strategic thinking, executive presence, and hands\-on delivery leadership to manage complex Salesforce programs, protect project margins, and scale delivery impact across the organisation.
   

  

**What We Expect**
* End\-to\-End Salesforce Delivery \& Financial Ownership: Own the complete Salesforce delivery lifecycle, managing scope, timelines, risks, resourcing, and dependencies while ensuring high\-quality outcomes and protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Agile Delivery Leadership: Lead Agile delivery using frameworks such as Scrum and SAFe, driving sprint execution, backlog prioritisation, delivery predictability, and high\-performing cross\-functional Salesforce teams.
* Program Planning \& Roadmap Management: Develop and manage integrated project plans and delivery roadmaps, ensuring transparent progress reporting, risk visibility, and dependency management across the engagement lifecycle.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks from a delivery standpoint, establishing clear project tracking milestones for predictive and generative AI workstreams while managing downstream environment and data dependencies
* Stakeholder \& Executive Management: Drive stakeholder alignment through effective communication, executive reporting, governance forums, and proactive escalation management in complex, global environments.
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by tracking and showcasing program metrics that prove the business value, sprint velocity gains, and adoption rates of deployed Salesforce capabilities to client leadership
* Quality Governance \& Delivery Excellence: Establish and enforce delivery governance, standards, and best practices, ensuring compliance, quality benchmarks, and continuous improvement across projects.
* Champion an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants, and automated tracking to optimize implementation schedules and boost team development capacity
* Resource \& Budget Management: Plan and optimise project resourcing, manage budgets and forecasts, track financials, and mitigate delivery and financial risks throughout the engagement.
* AI\-Driven Productivity Enhancement: Encourage the strategic adoption of authorised AI technologies to boost team efficiency and optimise overall project delivery cycles.
* Timezone flexibility: Timezone flexibility to ensure comprehensive support and alignment with global customer needs.


**Requirements**
**Must Have**
* 10\+ years of total experience in the IT industry, with 5\+ years delivering Salesforce projects.
* Proven experience managing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ and Revenue Cloud.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce delivery lifecycle, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Architects and Technical Leads (hands\-on configuration is not required).
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with senior stakeholders and executives.

\#LI\-VC1
 



**About Boomi and What Makes Us Special** 




 Are you ready to work at a fast\-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award\-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800\+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world\-class people and industry\-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
 



 Presales Solutions Engineer
 



**Why Boomi?** 




 Boomi empowers organizations to move with agility, connect systems and people, and drive business innovation. As a Leader in Gartner’s Enterprise iPaaS Magic Quadrant for 12 consecutive years, and one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Boomi is a global integration and automation leader with over 30,000 customers.
 



 We're now accelerating our platform’s impact by:
 



 \- Launching Boomi AgentStudio to enable AI\-powered automation and governance
 



 \- Enhancing data integration and pipeline orchestration with the Rivery acquisition
 



 \- Expanding our offering to include Managed File Transfer (MFT) via the Thru acquisition
 



 At Boomi, we’re bold thinkers who are passionate about solving big challenges. If you’re excited to be part of a company shaping the future of integration, data management, API management and AI, we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Presales Solutions Engineer Overview** 




 Our sales team of Account Executives and Account Managers rely on proactive technical support during the sales process and our expert Presales Solution Engineering team is there to assist. Our Boomi SEs follow a prescriptive technical sales cycle and engagement model, focusing on effectiveness and efficiency. Our SE team is viewed as and treated more than just a technical resource. Rather, our SEs are considered valuable partners throughout the sales journey and help to build trust with our stakeholders and prospects.
 



 As a Presales Solutions Engineer, you will help provide pre\-sales technical support to our field sales teams throughout the sales process. This includes tasks such as account and prospect research, collaborative discovery and needs analysis, formulating a technical strategy and win\-team, executing on that strategy and ultimately getting the technical win.
 



**Job Roles and Responsibilities** 




 \- Lead technical discovery and consultative pre\-sales engagements with prospective customers.
 



 \- Design solution strategies across Boomi’s portfolio of integration, data management, API management and AI.
 



 \- Deliver tailored product demonstrations and technical presentations to both technical and business audiences.
 



 \- Partner with Account Executives and Solution Architects to craft compelling proposals that highlight business value and ROI.
 



 \- Support RFIs/RFPs and Proof\-of\-Concept activities.
 



 \- Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle as well as supporting trade shows, webinars and workshops.
 



 \- Work with Boomi’s Partners to help them position the Boomi platform to their customers.
 



 \- Stay current on AI trends, LLM\-based tooling, competitive offerings, Boomi platform innovations, as well as general customer and industry trends.
 



**Required Skills and Experience** 




 Essential
 



 \- Strong business acumen, with the ability to relate technical features to business impact and value.
 



 \- Technical aptitude and problem\-solving mindset, ideally with exposure to integration, data management, API management and AI platforms.
 



 \- Exceptional presentation and communication skills; comfortable engaging executives, developers, and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \- Self\-starter who thrives in collaborative, cross\-functional teams and dynamic environments.
 



 Preferred
 



 \- 5\-10 years in presales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, or technical sales roles—preferably in SaaS or iPaaS organizations.
 



 \- Familiarity with:
 



 \- Integration patterns, messaging queues, and middleware concepts
 



 \- APIs and API Management, including Federated API Management
 



 \- Data pipeline and orchestration tools
 



 \- Managed File Transfer (MFT) protocols and use cases
 



 \- AI and LLM\-based applications: familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, vector search, or agent\-based automation
 



 \- Experience in value\-based selling methodologies.
 



 \- Exposure to basic scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript or Groovy).
 



**Location** 




 \- Must be located in Bangalore
 



**Why Now?** 




 At Boomi, you won’t just showcase technology, you’ll help customers accelerate AI adoption, unlock data value, and build resilient digital ecosystems. It’s an exciting time to be part of a company driving innovation at scale.
 



  





  





**Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.** 
 We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.
 



*Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees.* 
 All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

a944954a.title: Solution Engineering - AIBS
a944954a.description:
**Overview**
 The mission of AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process is to help our customers digitally transform their businesses to drive new sources of revenue, create new and engaging ways to serve their customers, and to transform the way in which their business runs to drive new levels of profitability for their organization.
   

  

 We at the India and South Asia Business Applications Solutions team are seeking a highly skilled AI Business Solution Engineer with a focus on Customer Engagement/Experience and Customer Service to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Sales, Service and Marketing management/automation technologies, paired with extensive experience in CRM presales.
   

  


 As an AI Business Solution Engineer – Sales \& Service, you will provide technology expertise to help win deals by guiding Microsoft customers to successfully evaluate our CRM solutions. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your selling skills, and become adept at deal structuring. The role may need 0\-40% travel outside your base location.
   

  

 In this role you will be the Solution Engineer (pre\-sales consultant) for your assigned workload and a member of the sales team that consists of Solution Specialist, Customer Success Unit, partners, and engineering. In this role you will advance pipeline by assisting the Solution Specialist in qualifying the deal, developing the strategy, and inspiring the CxO/Business Decision Maker/Technical Decision Maker. You are responsible for designing/architecting the solution and delivering an industry\-aligned demonstration to the customer. You will engage partners for co\-sell and implementation considerations, engineering to assist with emerging technologies and Customer Success Unit for deal support. The demo will focus on solving the technical proof requirements while highlighting our business value and competitive differentiators and should result in securing the customer’s solution design endorsement. Once the solution design is secured, you will support the Solution Specialist in finalizing the customer proposal and assisting with licensing.
   

  

 You will develop relationships with the decision makers with our customers and position yourself as a trusted advisor in your domain. As a recognized product expert, you are responsible for sharing your technical, industry knowledge and best practices with your peers.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Advance qualified pipeline revenue by demonstrating solution capabilities, addressing technical proof requirements, and securing the customer’s solution design endorsement.
* Engage with the account team to land solution envisioning sessions and business value assessments.
* Proactively deliver compelling customer centric solution demonstrations based on technical workload expertise while building Business Decision Maker/CxO/Technical Decision Maker connections.
* Address solution architecture considerations and competitive objection handling.
* Assist in formalizing the customer proposal.
* Collaborate with Partners and Customer Success to align on agreed upon deployment plan and Key Performance Indicators.
* Lead discovery sessions in each opportunity, yielding output of customer\-agreed business challenges and win themes prioritized with business value.


**Scale Customer Engagements**
* Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide technical expertise during the presales process.
* Uses knowledge of customer context, solution or portfolio expertise, and technical and industry knowledge to build credibility with customers.
* Leads and ensures technical wins for AI driven Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, and adjacent technologies by leading technical discussions with customers and establishing rules of engagement (e.g., role boundaries, handoff strategies) for extended teams, leveraging knowledge of processes, tools, and programs (e.g., FastTrack, End Customer Investment Funds \[ECIFs]). Searches for customer references to use in engagements.
* Leverages foundational knowledge of resources (e.g., roles, Microsoft Innovation Hub \[MIH], demo sites, virtual sites, Value Based Delivery \[VBD], Customer Success Unit \[CSU]) and proactively engages product teams (e.g., engineering) to remediate blockers by conveying impact.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in Customer Relationship Management industry to provide innovative solutions to clients.
* Speak at public events, webinars, and conferences to share insights and promote AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process’ Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Microsoft Power Platform including Microsoft Copilot Studio (Agentic AI Platform) solutions.


**Leverage Partner Ecosystem**
* Engages in partner sell\-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and facilitating partner resources and processes throughout the course of the project.
* Supports partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams (e.g., Global Partner Solutions).


**Build Strategy**
* Captures core competitive knowledge and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies for assigned customers.
* Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability at the account level to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner, competitor, or open\-source knowledge.
* Works with account and marketing teams to shape strategic win and customer success plans and tailor Microsoft messaging to audience using knowledge of customer feedback, specific Microsoft solutions, and their context in a competitive landscape. Where applicable, build consumption plans with Partner and Industry Solutions Delivery teams after customer sign\-off.


**Solution Design and Proof**
* Create and deliver compelling presentations, demos, and proof\-of\-concepts to showcase the value of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform. Leverage partner/customer teams as needed to prove capabilities and integration into customer environment.
* Design, develop, and demonstrate CRM Sales, Service and Marketing propositions using Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights and associated Copilots (AI)
* Exposure/willingness to pick up skills in AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process’ Power Platform (Low\-Code/No\-Code) and Copilot Studio (Agentic AI platform) technologies.
* Respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) by providing detailed technical information and solutions tailored to client needs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights during the presales phase.
* Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate clients and stakeholders on the above\-mentioned technology areas as needed.


**Education**
* Builds their own readiness plan and proactively identifies learning gaps. Grows domain knowledge and practices expertise by communicating with customers, partners, and senior colleagues to expand knowledge of architecture.
* Demonstrates new and updated products to increase internal virtual teams' understanding of solutions and new opportunities.
* Monitors and responds to internal tech community posts, attends community calls, sessions, hackathons, etc., and acts as a mentor for their technology area.


**Other**
* Embody our culture and values


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications (RQs/MQs):**
* 6\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting, or related experience in Manufacturing vertical OR equivalent experience.
* 4\+ years' experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
* Exposure to Enterprise Customer Engagement platforms like Salesforce, CRMnext, ZOHO etc.,
* 7\+ years of related experience:
+ Solution pre\-sales for business applications and/or SaaS\-based company or similar technology.
+ Solution pre\-sales of complex business application deals requiring orchestration of large, dispersed, virtual teams composed of industry and solution team members.
+ Solutions pre\-sales best practices including but not limited to; discovery, building and crafting solution strategies that differentiate from the competition, value\-based selling, identifying, and expanding product opportunities.
+ Successful track record of competitive displacement.
+ Ability to drive and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries through organizational, presentation, envisioning, writing, and verbal communication skills.
+ Proven track record in prioritization and orchestration of resources for complex customer digital transformation engagements.
+ Deep understanding of Business application solutions
+ Commercial cloud offerings, ideally Microsoft’s cloud platform as well as competitive knowledge of other business applications and related ecosystems.
+ Customer\-facing business processes primarily in Financial Services and other industries like Manufacturing, Automotive, Oil \& Gas, Utilities, Retail \& Consumer Goods, Healthcare, Public Sector and Media \& Communications is a plus.
+ Business value selling methodologies and practices that successfully convey the value and business outcomes
+ How to uncover customer’s stated and unstated needs and how technology can be leveraged to solve business problems.
+ High level of self\-awareness, reflection, and empathy.
+ Ability to skillfully communicate, demonstrate, and prove the value of Dynamics 365 Business Applications.
+ Customer\-centric mindset with demonstrated passion for delivering customer value.
+ Excel at coordinating team resources to build and deliver a compelling solution demonstration
+ Proven collaborator capable of influencing internal and external teams.
+ Excellent presentation and communications skills across various customer stakeholders, e.g., CIO, CFO, CMO, VP of Sales, etc.
+ Adept at challenging perspectives and differentiating from the competition by reframing value and exemplifying customer obsession.
