9de63da7.title: Solutions Architect
9de63da7.description:
FEQ427R545
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI\-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long\-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You will help our customers achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. afff0ab4.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement Cloud Resources: Oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure High Availability: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Right\-size resources, develop cost\-effective solutions, and monitor usage patterns to optimize cloud costs.
* Automate Processes: Use automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Services Proficiency: Experience with cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, along with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* DevOps Practices: Experience with DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and applying these practices to cloud infrastructure management.
* Automation Tools: Experience using automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, and ability to manage and execute cloud migration plans.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Security Best Practices: Experience with implementing and enforcing cloud security measures to ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations, including data encryption, access controls, and threat detection.
* Advanced Cloud Automation: Experience with advanced automation tools and scripting languages, such as Python or PowerShell, to automate complex cloud infrastructure tasks and workflows.
* Multi\-Cloud Expertise: Experience managing and integrating multiple cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and others, to provide a seamless and efficient cloud infrastructure.

92802647.title: ServiceNow-Service Now Architect - ITOM-Manager
92802647.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager \- ITOM Technical Architect**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using the ServiceNow platform, specifically focusing on IT Operations Management (ITOM). You will get an opportunity to work with a high\-quality team and build innovative solutions that address complex enterprise challenges.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Technical Architect with expertise in ServiceNow ITOM architecture and implementation to join the EY GDS ServiceNow team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in driving ITOM transformation and platform strategy for global clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management
* Define and implement scalable CMDB architecture, governance frameworks, and data models
* Drive end\-to\-end ITOM strategy, aligning ServiceNow capabilities with enterprise IT operations and business goals
* Architect and deliver event correlation, observability, and AIOps solutions using ServiceNow Event Management and integrations
* Design and implement Service Mapping solutions for business services and applications
* Lead Discovery implementation, including MID Server setup, credential management, and troubleshooting
* Drive integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and third\-party monitoring tools
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to development and implementation teams
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical and architectural specifications
* Ensure adherence to platform best practices, governance, and security standards
* Support performance tuning, scalability optimization, and platform upgrades
* Drive DevOps and Agile delivery practices across ITOM implementations
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, Cloud Management
* Deep understanding of CMDB data modeling, CSDM framework, and data governance
* Experience in AIOps, event correlation, and monitoring tool integrations (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds)
* Knowledge of infrastructure technologies: servers, networks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong JavaScript, Glide scripting, and ServiceNow platform development skills
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* Approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with significant exposure to ServiceNow ITOM
* Proven experience as a Technical Architect or Lead in ServiceNow ITOM implementations
* ServiceNow CSA certification (mandatory)
* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery / Service Mapping (mandatory)
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred)


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with CSDM adoption and enterprise CMDB strategy
* Exposure to multi\-cloud environments and cloud discovery
* Knowledge of latest ServiceNow releases and features


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with strong technical expertise, consulting mindset, and innovation\-driven approach
* Individuals passionate about digital transformation and IT operations modernization
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast\-paced global environment
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**Overview**
**Senior Cloud Specialist**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Cloud Specialist is primarily responsible for responding to and resolving cases from customers, partners, and the company's services team. This role independently manages incidents and service requests, troubleshoots complex cloud issues, and works cross\-functionally within cloud environments. The Senior Cloud Specialist serves as a trusted advisor and escalation resource, driving proactive improvements to cloud operations while ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
   

  

**Please note:** 
 This role operates on a 24x7 rotational shift schedule based on roster.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Serve as a primary escalation resource for team members and customers, resolving complex cloud\-hosted solution requests received via tickets, phone, and email while applying best practice knowledge.
* Take proactive measures to identify trends, improve monitoring of cloud\-hosted solutions, and enhance internal efficiencies — remaining current on emerging best practices.
* Operate as a trusted advisor on scheduled environment refresh requests, assisting customers, partners, and internal resources while applying best practices throughout the process.
* Develop and implement enhancements to audit information gathering, ensuring compliance with established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines.
* Assist with implementing, testing, and maintaining systems and processes related to the cloud business continuity and disaster recovery plan.
* Mentor, coach, and train team members; develop internal documentation that fully reflects all activity related to issue resolution and the maintenance of hosted systems.


**Role Essentials**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with demonstrated experience in process improvement and resolving complex technical issues.
* ITIL4 Foundation certification with working knowledge of Service Request and Incident Management practices.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Server environments, including Microsoft Active Directory, networking, storage, and virtualization technologies.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate goals into innovative design solutions.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, maintaining professionalism and discretion at all times.


**What We'd Like to See**
* Hands\-on experience with cloud environments and tools such as Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Remedy, Dynatrace, Splunk, and AWS services.
* Demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, and mobilize team members and business partners, both independently and in a team environment.
* Experience developing comprehensive internal documentation related to issue resolution and hosted system maintenance.
* Proven track record of proactively identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements while staying current on industry best practices.
* Ability to provide general consulting services as a trusted advisor, leveraging deep expertise and best practice knowledge across cloud operations.

 Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com .
   

  

 © Hyland. All rights reserved.

Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.

63ae88d3.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
63ae88d3.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

Role Overview
  
The Senior Program Manager will lead a multi\-year SAP S/4HANA transformation program within a semiconductor manufacturing environment, integrating tightly with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), and Kinaxis RapidResponse.
  
This role is accountable for orchestrating cross\-tower delivery (SAP, MES, PLM, Planning), ensuring end\-to\-end process integration from engineering to manufacturing to supply chain, while driving business outcomes such as cycle time reduction, planning accuracy, and manufacturing efficiency.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Lead end\-to\-end S/4HANA transformation program across SAP, MES, PLM, and Kinaxis workstreams
* Establish integrated program governance, roadmap, and cross\-system architecture alignment
* Manage complex semiconductor use cases:


o Engineering\-to\-Manufacturing (PLM MES SAP)
  
o Plan\-to\-Produce (Kinaxis SAP MES)
  
o As\-built / as\-designed traceability and genealogy
  
* Drive alignment across business (engineering, manufacturing, supply chain), IT, and system integrators
* Oversee delivery of:


o SAP core (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing)
  
o Data migration (material master, BOMs, routings, quality data)
  
o Integrations (PLM–SAP–MES–Kinaxis)
  
* Lead cutover planning and go\-live readiness across multiple plants/sites
* Ensure strong governance on RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, Dependencies), KPIs, and value realization
* Manage vendors, global delivery teams, and offshore/onshore coordination
* Drive business readiness, training, and adoption across manufacturing sites


Must\-Have Skills
  
* Deep S/4HANA transformation experience (Greenfield/Brownfield; ECC S/4 migration)
* Strong understanding of semiconductor or discrete manufacturing processes:


o BOM complexity, routings, work centers, shop floor integration
  
* Proven experience integrating SAP with MES and PLM systems
* Hands\-on experience with planning tools (Kinaxis or equivalent APS solutions)
* Expertise in cross\-system integration, data migration, and end\-to\-end process design
* Strong program governance, PMO, and multi\-workstream leadership capabilities
* Experience managing large global programs with multiple system integrators
* Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain leadership
* Strong command of risk, dependency, and change management


Nice\-to\-Have Skills
  
* Experience in semiconductor industry (e.g., LAM, Applied Materials, Intel ecosystem)
* Exposure to fab operations, equipment integration, and manufacturing analytics
* Knowledge of SAP Digital Manufacturing / OpCenter / Industry 4\.0 solutions / S4HANA Supply Chain
* Familiarity with PLM platforms (Teamcenter, Windchill) and MES tools
* Experience with SAP BTP, cloud integration, and data platforms (Databricks, AI/ML use cases)
* Certifications: PMP, SAP Activate, SAFe Agile
* Experience leading multi\-site / global rollouts and template\-based deployments
* Experience with all MS tools especially MS Project


Experience \& Qualifications
  
* 12–18\+ years overall IT / transformation program experience
* 7–10\+ years SAP program leadership, including S/4HANA implementations
* Delivered at least 3\+ full lifecycle S/4HANA transformations (design deploy)
* Proven experience managing large\-scale programs ($10M\+ budgets, global teams)
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred

d936e1a3.title: Program Manager - Agile
d936e1a3.description:
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
Job Summary
  
This position entails overseeing program management activities and implementing Agile methodology to ensure the successful delivery of programs. The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the overall program scope, schedule, budget, and resources to meet the objectives and deliverables.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1\. Develop and maintain program management plans, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and communication plans.
  
2\. Implement agile methodology to drive iterative development, continuous improvement, and effective resource utilization.
  
3\. Lead and facilitate cross functional teams to achieve program goals and milestones.
  
4\. Identify and mitigate program risks and issues proactively to ensure successful program delivery.
  
5\. Track and report on program progress, including key performance indicators and success metrics.
  
6\. Foster a collaborative and transparent working environment to promote effective communication and problem\-solving.
  
7\. Ensure alignment between program objectives and business goals to deliver value to stakeholders.
  
Skill Requirements
  
1\. Strong proficiency in program management methodologies and tools.
  
2\. In\-depth knowledge and experience in agile methodologies, particularly scrum and kanban.
  
3\. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels.
  
4\. Strong leadership abilities to inspire and motivate cross functional teams towards achieving program objectives.
  
5\. Exceptional problem\-solving skills to address challenges and drive innovative solutions.
  
6\. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and navigate complex organizational structures.
  
7\. Proven track record of successfully managing programs from initiation to closure.
  
Other Requirements
  
1\.PMP (Project Management Professional) certification and Agile certifications (e.g., CSM, PMIACP) are preferred.

35ef984b.title: Managed Services - Data Visualization - Manager
35ef984b.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Managed Services \- Data Visualization \- Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping organizations streamline their operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency by managing key processes and functions on their behalf. You will leverage your skills in project management, technology, and process optimization to deliver services that meet client needs. As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style, motivating and developing your team to deliver quality outcomes. You will be responsible for coaching, utilizing team members' strengths, and managing performance to meet client expectations. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on transitioning and running services, managing delivery teams, programs, and performance. Your work will involve continuous improvement and optimizing managed services processes, tools, and services. Within our Assurance practice, you will embrace technology and innovation to enhance delivery, encouraging others to do the same. You will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, while addressing conflicts or issues and engaging in meaningful conversations with clients and stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading the transition and management of outsourced services to streamline client operations
* Guiding delivery teams in optimizing managed services processes, tools, and services
* Overseeing project planning, budgeting, execution, and completion to meet client expectations
* Utilizing automation and process optimization techniques to enhance service delivery
* Developing and implementing business process improvement strategies for operational excellence
* Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
* Engaging in strategic questioning and stakeholder engagement to identify opportunities for business transformation
* Confirming data quality and compliance within service management frameworks
* Facilitating continuous process improvement initiatives to drive efficiency and reduce costs
* Addressing conflicts and issues with clients and team members, escalating when necessary


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Excelling in data visualization and analytics
* Utilizing automation frameworks for process improvement
* Demonstrating proficiency in business process automation
* Managing operational performance and risk management
* Leading digital transformation initiatives
* Mentoring teams in strategic planning and execution
* Embracing change and innovation in managed services

4ee1e0ab.title: Technical Account Manager (Offshore Delivery & People Management)
4ee1e0ab.description:
**About the Role:**
 The Technical Account Manager will lead and mentor a high\-performing offshore team of approximately 30 professionals supporting an enterprise account. This role is responsible for delivery excellence, operational governance, client relationship management, technical leadership, and people development to ensure the successful execution of business objectives and continuous improvement.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Delivery \& Account Management\- Lead offshore delivery, ensuring quality, timely execution, resource optimization, KPI/SLA compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement while serving as the primary client contact
* Technical Leadership\- Mentor technical teams, drive engineering best practices, DevOps and automation adoption, and support solution reviews, technical decisions, and issue resolution
* Operations \& Performance Management\- Oversee production support and operations, monitor performance metrics, and implement process improvements to enhance service delivery and operational excellence
* Client Engagement \-Build strong client relationships, present delivery performance and risks, provide strategic recommendations, and align offshore execution with business objectives
* People Leadership\- Lead and develop a team of \~30 associates, managing performance, career growth, succession planning, engagement, hiring, retention, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning


**What You Bring:**
* 10\+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, or account management roles
* Proven experience managing offshore delivery teams of 25\-50 members
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and operational support models
* Experience working with financial services or banking clients
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including performance management and career development


**Nice to Have:**
* Delivery quality and predictability
* Client satisfaction and stakeholder feedback
* Team productivity and operational efficiency
* SLA/KPI adherence
* Employee engagement, retention, and career progression
* Continuous improvement and innovation outcomes


**About Simeio And What We Do**
 Simeio has over 650 talented employees across the globe. We have offices in USA (Atlanta HQ and Texas), India, Canada, Costa Rica and UK.
   

  

 Founded in 2007, and now backed by private equity company ZMC, Simeio is recognized as a top IAM provider by industry analysts.
   

  

 Alongside Simeio’s identity orchestration tool ‘Simeio IO’ \- Simeio also partners with industry leading IAM software vendors to provide access management, identity governance and administration, privileged access management and risk intelligence services across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid technology environments.
   

  

 Simeio provides services to numerous Fortune 1000 companies across all industries including financial services, technology, healthcare, media, retail, public sector, utilities and education.
   

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
 Simeio is an equal opportunity employer. If you require assistance with completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our recruitment team \- recruitment@simeio.com.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 We carefully review every application we receive. If your skills and experience match our needs, we’ll be in touch. If you don’t hear from us within 10 days, please don’t be discouraged. We may retain your application for future opportunities. We also encourage you to check our careers page for other openings.

 As a Delivery Manager, you will oversee and manage one or more projects simultaneously, depending on the organization’s requirements. You will play a pivotal role in delivering projects successfully, ensuring effective collaboration between stakeholders and project teams. 2f0251de.title: Delivery Manager
2f0251de.description:
Acu ity Analytics
   

  

 Acuity Analytics (the trading name of Acuity Knowledge Partners) is a global, tech\-first organisation helping financial institutions and corporates make better decisions through research, data, analytics and AI\-enabled solutions. We combine deep financial services expertise with strong engineering, digital and AI capabilities to solve complex, real\-world problems.
   

  

 With a team of 7,200\+ analysts, data specialists and technologists across 28 locations, we work with more than 800 organisations worldwide to drive efficiency, unlock insight and deliver measurable impact. Our success is built on the strength of our people—by investing in talent, encouraging collaboration and creating room to grow, we enable our teams to do their best work for clients.
   

  

 Acuity became an independent business in 2019 following its acquisition from Moody’s Corporation by Equistone Partners Europe. In 2023, funds advised by global private equity firm Permira acquired a majority stake, with Equistone remaining a minority investor—supporting our continued growth and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.acuityanalytics.com
   

  

 Basic Information
   

  

 Position Title – Delivery manager
   

  

 Experience Level – min 6 Years
   

  

 Department – Private Markets
   

  

 Location – Gurgaon
   

  

 Position reports to – Associate Director
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 We are looking for dedicated and motivated individuals with strong leadership, organisational and teamwork skills for their Private Markets team based in Gurugram
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead competitive intelligence, peer screening, and fund benchmarking initiatives to evaluate fundraising strategies, fund performance, positioning, terms, fee structures, and key differentiators across the private markets landscape.
* Conduct in\-depth market, industry, and thematic research to develop actionable insights, opportunity assessments, case studies, and strategic recommendations supporting fundraising and business development efforts.
* Analyze LP preferences, mandate opportunities, capital flows, and fundraising trends to identify investor targeting opportunities and support capital formation strategies.
* Develop and review high\-impact client deliverables, including pitchbooks, investor presentations, consultant decks, fund summaries, competitive analyses, newsletters, and other marketing materials tailored to institutional investors.
* Support the development and enhancement of fund economics and strategy assessment models, including fee, expense, profitability, commitment, and capital flow analyses.
* Present findings, market intelligence, and strategic insights to clients, senior management, and investment professionals, while serving as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders across private equity and alternative investment firms.


 Ensure excellence in deliverable quality through rigorous review processes, analytical validation, and adherence to the highest professional and client service standards.
   

  

 Key Competencies:
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in private markets research and analytics, including fund benchmarking, fundraising strategy support, LP and mandate screening, market intelligence, performance analysis, fund economics review, investor presentation development, and preparation of strategic insights for senior investment professionals and institutional investors.
* Hands on experience in using financial databases (Preqin, eVestment, Fundmap, Bloomberg etc.)
* Strong understanding of various types of funds (evergreen/ open /close ended) and strategies employed by private equity / hedge funds
* Team leadership and client handling skills
* CFA, Chartered Accountant, MBA from a top tier business school
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills and experience in client relationship management


 Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines.

8b7f2f6a.title: Technical Program Manager (EG), Manufacturing
8b7f2f6a.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

 At Fictiv, we’re building a company that is developing the operating system for sourcing custom mechanical parts. We already enjoy manufacturing and delivering highly complex, high quality parts for our Fortune 500 customers who are building the future with products like autonomous electric vehicles, surgical systems, and industrial robots. As we scale our business, we are looking to expand our growth within India.
   

  

 In your role as Technical Program Manager, you will be working directly with our MPs, you’ll be using your engineering background, manufacturing process knowledge and management experience, to develop and implement effective and efficient program plans to ensure we’re executing programs within scope, budget and timing; while meeting or exceeding our customer’s expectations. You will also be the customer’s point of contact; you will drive scope clarity (internally and externally), issue resolution, stakeholder management and program success. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple programs across multiple regions, proactively managing risk, addressing any customer requests and coordinating across corresponding regional operations teams to keep programs on track and provide the corresponding program updates/status reports.
   

  

 As an experienced member of the team, you will be following our defined processes and driving their use in a new region with new manufacturing partners. Additionally, you will actively identify areas for improvement in your workflow and in the systems used by the Technical Program Management team, and will drive those improvements through cross functional projects. You will also be working cross functionally to support the development of robust processes which will ensure the successful introduction of new service offerings that Fictiv launches to the public.
   

  

 You will report on\-site to the Program Management Lead in our office in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 This is a high\-impact role where you’ll help shape the future of hardware manufacturing through smart program leadership. If you thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy building processes, and are excited about working on cutting\-edge programs with global stakeholders, we’d love to meet you
   

  

**Program Execution \& Oversight**
 Lead end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring adherence to defined scope, budget, and timelines.
   

  

 Oversee cross\-functional coordination and execution across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and quality.
   

  

**Program Planning \& Risk Management**
 Develop comprehensive and realistic project/program plans.
   

  

 Identify and proactively manage program risks and mitigation strategies, ensuring alignment with internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Stakeholder \& Partner Management
   

  

 Engage regularly with internal teams, customers, and manufacturing partners to ensure alignment.
   

  

 Build strong working relationships with stakeholders to facilitate quick decision\-making and issue resolution.
   

  

**Customer \& Fulfillment Alignment**
 Understand and define customer requirements and fulfillment needs.
   

  

 Drive resolution of open gaps to ensure program success and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Change Management**
 Own the evaluation and execution of post\-sale change requests.
   

  

 Balance scope, risk, and cost implications while maintaining overall program objectives.
   

  

**Program Monitoring \& Communication**
 Track and report on program performance using defined metrics (cost, time, quality, risk).
   

  

 Escalate issues as necessary and keep leadership informed with timely updates and clear documentation.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Identify areas for improvement across the program lifecycle and TPM workflow.
   

  

 Drive both tactical and strategic improvements to enhance operational effectiveness and program quality.
   

  

 Sitting and working at a computer for extended periods of time.
   

  

 Travel 0\- 10%
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
   

  

 Minimum 7\+ years of experience in a technical project or program management role within fast\-paced manufacturing environments.
   

  

 Proven track record managing programs through NPD (New Product Development) and Mass Manufacturing.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience managing suppliers/manufacturers and external stakeholders
   

  

**Technical \& Domain Knowledge**
 Must\-Have: Deep experience with CNC Machining.
   

  

 Good to Have: Familiarity with Composite and Sheet Metal Fabrication processes.
   

  

 Solid understanding of quality systems, PPAP, and supply chain management (SCM).
   

  

 Knowledge of logistics, sourcing, and finance related to project execution.
   

  

**Soft Skills \& Work Style**
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Fluent in English and any other Local Language
   

  

 Strong interpersonal skills with a team\-first mindset.
   

  

 Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and drive results in ambiguous environments.
   

  

 Gritty, adaptable, and able to operate in under\-defined or evolving processes.
   

  

 Data\-driven decision maker with a methodical and detail\-oriented approach.
   

  

 A systems thinker: capable of developing repeatable, flexible, and reliable processes.
   

  

 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

50dda3e0.title: Technical Program Manager
50dda3e0.description:
A Technical Program Manager (TPM) is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of complex technology programs, including product development, deployment, and lifecycle management for communication platforms such as SMS, WhatsApp, Email, RCS and Voice solutions. The role acts as a bridge between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of products.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of technical programs and product initiatives.
 



 Manage the complete product lifecycle for SMS, WhatsApp Business, Email, and Voice communication platforms.
 



 Lead product deployment, implementation, onboarding, and rollout activities across customers and internal stakeholders.
 



 Coordinate with Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, Compliance, and Business teams to deliver solutions on time.
 



  





 Define program scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
 



 Manage customer integrations, platform migrations, and deployment strategies.
 



 Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth execution.
 



 Track program KPIs, adoption metrics, service performance, and customer satisfaction.
 



 Drive process improvements, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
 



 Provide executive\-level reporting and stakeholder communication.
 



  





 Required Skills
 



 Strong program and project management experience.
 



 Good understanding of CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) products including SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Email, and Voice solutions.
 



 Experience managing product deployments, customer implementations, and platform integrations.
 



 Knowledge of APIs, cloud platforms, system architecture, and enterprise software delivery.
 



 Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
 



 Experience with Agile, Scrum, and product development methodologies.
 



 Excellent problem\-solving, risk management, and analytical abilities.
 



  





 Success Metrics
 



 Successful delivery and deployment of communication products.
 



 On\-time program execution and customer go\-live completion.
 



 Platform adoption and utilization growth.
 



 Service reliability, uptime, and operational efficiency.
 



 Customer satisfaction and business impact.
 



 Effective management of risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
 



  





 One\-line Summary:
 



 A TPM drives the development, deployment, and adoption of SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and Voice products, ensuring seamless execution of technical programs, customer implementations, and business outcomes across cross\-functional teams.

f6c6df78.title: APAC Climate Operations Program Manager
f6c6df78.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience with carbon accounting and methodologies or energy markets.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of experience in climate science, Green House Gas (GHG) Standards and accounting, or the energy industry.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data\-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C\-Suite level.
* High\-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate\-related goals.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high\-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross\-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.
   

  

 The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

71f92dd7.title: Sr. Solution Consultant III
71f92dd7.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.



What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.



Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.



Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together!


We are looking for a self\-motivated **Sr.** **SOLUTION CONSULTANT** to join our Asia Presales team, to support our Philippines business\- An excellent opportunity for candidates who are looking for regional exposure and willing to relocate to Philippines.



A position with Anaplan's presales team means being part of one of the fastest growing cloud vendors and making your mark on a changing industry. You get to meld your love of numbers with your love of sales and be rewarded for success with an outstanding commission structure in a fast moving, stimulating environment. As a Solution Consultant, you enjoy helping people solve hard problems. You are a bit savvy about cool products and you love showing people how those products can help their businesses.  

You will join a team of individuals who embrace and respect diverse perspectives, aren't afraid to push boundaries and try new insights, and are passionate about helping our customers and each other succeed. We work hard, but we also don't wait for an excuse to have fun. In fact, we're so serious about it that it's one of our core values.


**What you will be doing:**


* Engaging with targeted, large enterprise prospects to identify broken business processes and problems. Ascertaining and explaining Anaplan's outstanding ability to solve them.
* Developing planning function\-specific solutions, demos, and messaging. Building Proof of Concept models that are tailored to solve prospects' problems.
* Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to facilitate the adoption of the Anaplan solution.
* Cross\-training teammates on solution expertise.
* Creating product awareness in the marketplace.


**More about you:**


* BS / BA / Finance or equivalent. (Post Grad and Professional Qualifications a plus)
* A background in financial planning / planning, budgeting \& forecasting / financial operation planning / financial analysis
* Experience with multi\-dimensional modelling, business intelligence, or analytics
* Prior experience in Enterprise Planning Management a plus
* Aptitude for quickly ramping up on new technology
* Excellent presentation, client relationship, and interpersonal skills\- both internally and externally


**Preferred skills and technical familiarity:**


* Growth mentality
* You're comfortable challenging old ways of doing things
* Ability to take a consultative selling approach by listening to customer needs and shaping a shared vision for a solution
* 8\+ years of presales/consulting/implementing or like experience

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**



It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.



Anaplan does not:


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.


All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.



Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

31775062.title: Solution Engineering - AIBS
31775062.description:
**Overview**  

The mission of AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process is to help our customers digitally transform their businesses to drive new sources of revenue, create new and engaging ways to serve their customers, and to transform the way in which their business runs to drive new levels of profitability for their organization.

  

We at the India and South Asia Business Applications Solutions team are seeking a highly skilled AI Business Solution Engineer with a focus on Customer Engagement/Experience and Customer Service to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Sales, Service and Marketing management/automation technologies, paired with extensive experience in CRM presales.

  

As an AI Business Solution Engineer – Sales \& Service, you will provide technology expertise to help win deals by guiding Microsoft customers to successfully evaluate our CRM solutions. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your selling skills, and become adept at deal structuring. The role may need 0\-40% travel outside your base location.


In this role you will be the Solution Engineer (pre\-sales consultant) for your assigned workload and a member of the sales team that consists of Solution Specialist, Customer Success Unit, partners, and engineering. In this role you will advance pipeline by assisting the Solution Specialist in qualifying the deal, developing the strategy, and inspiring the CxO/Business Decision Maker/Technical Decision Maker. You are responsible for designing/architecting the solution and delivering an industry\-aligned demonstration to the customer. You will engage partners for co\-sell and implementation considerations, engineering to assist with emerging technologies and Customer Success Unit for deal support. The demo will focus on solving the technical proof requirements while highlighting our business value and competitive differentiators and should result in securing the customer’s solution design endorsement. Once the solution design is secured, you will support the Solution Specialist in finalizing the customer proposal and assisting with licensing.


You will develop relationships with the decision makers with our customers and position yourself as a trusted advisor in your domain. As a recognized product expert, you are responsible for sharing your technical, industry knowledge and best practices with your peers.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Advance qualified pipeline revenue by demonstrating solution capabilities, addressing technical proof requirements, and securing the customer’s solution design endorsement.
* Engage with the account team to land solution envisioning sessions and business value assessments.
* Proactively deliver compelling customer centric solution demonstrations based on technical workload expertise while building Business Decision Maker/CxO/Technical Decision Maker connections.
* Address solution architecture considerations and competitive objection handling.
* Assist in formalizing the customer proposal.
* Collaborate with Partners and Customer Success to align on agreed upon deployment plan and Key Performance Indicators.
* Lead discovery sessions in each opportunity, yielding output of customer\-agreed business challenges and win themes prioritized with business value.

**Scale Customer Engagements**

* Leads and ensures technical wins for AI driven Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, and adjacent technologies by leading technical discussions with customers and establishing rules of engagement (e.g., role boundaries, handoff strategies) for extended teams, leveraging knowledge of processes, tools, and programs (e.g., FastTrack, End Customer Investment Funds \[ECIFs]). Searches for customer references to use in engagements.

* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in Customer Relationship Management industry to provide innovative solutions to clients.
* Speak at public events, webinars, and conferences to share insights and promote AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process’ Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, Microsoft Power Platform including Microsoft Copilot Studio (Agentic AI Platform) solutions.

**Leverage Partner Ecosystem**

* Engages in partner sell\-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and facilitating partner resources and processes throughout the course of the project.
* Supports partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams (e.g., Global Partner Solutions).

**Build Strategy**

* Captures core competitive knowledge and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies for assigned customers.
* Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability at the account level to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner, competitor, or open\-source knowledge.
* Works with account and marketing teams to shape strategic win and customer success plans and tailor Microsoft messaging to audience using knowledge of customer feedback, specific Microsoft solutions, and their context in a competitive landscape. Where applicable, build consumption plans with Partner and Industry Solutions Delivery teams after customer sign\-off.

**Solution Design and Proof**

* Create and deliver compelling presentations, demos, and proof\-of\-concepts to showcase the value of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform. Leverage partner/customer teams as needed to prove capabilities and integration into customer environment.
* Design, develop, and demonstrate CRM Sales, Service and Marketing propositions using Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights and associated Copilots (AI)
* Exposure/willingness to pick up skills in AI Business Solutions \- Biz Process’ Power Platform (Low\-Code/No\-Code) and Copilot Studio (Agentic AI platform) technologies.
* Respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) by providing detailed technical information and solutions tailored to client needs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Dynamics 365 Customer Insights during the presales phase.
* Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate clients and stakeholders on the above\-mentioned technology areas as needed.

**Education**

* Builds their own readiness plan and proactively identifies learning gaps. Grows domain knowledge and practices expertise by communicating with customers, partners, and senior colleagues to expand knowledge of architecture.
* Demonstrates new and updated products to increase internal virtual teams' understanding of solutions and new opportunities.
* Monitors and responds to internal tech community posts, attends community calls, sessions, hackathons, etc., and acts as a mentor for their technology area.

 **Other**

**Qualifications** **Required/Minimum Qualifications (RQs/MQs):**

* 6\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
	+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4\+ years of technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience

 **Additional or Preferred Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of related experience:

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 You are the technical trust in the room. Most of our leads arrive through Google and Meta partner programmes; your job is to convert qualified leads into live implementations by showing exactly how Datahash Signals fits the client's data architecture and what it does for their measurement. You own the journey from lead to demo to solution to conversion for mid\-market opportunities, and you support the account executives on enterprise pursuits where the buyer is technical. An agent researches every prospect's website, tag stack and likely event volume before your call; you bring the judgement, the demo and the conversation. This is not a media buying role; it is data infrastructure, signal quality and measurement.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Pitch the solution. Run product demos and walkthroughs of Datahash Signals on real integration use cases; articulate the value of first\-party data activation, conversions APIs and server\-side tracking.
* Discover. Understand a client's data architecture across CRM, web, app and ad platforms; find the gaps in signal quality, attribution and data flow.
* Map the integration. Translate client systems into clear source\-to\-destination flows and explain how Datahash cuts the engineering effort.
* Position measurement. Connect data\-quality improvements to attribution accuracy and campaign outcomes, aligned with what Google, Meta and the others actually reward.
* Close mid\-market. Drive opportunities from solution to closure: scope into commercials, timeline and approach; handle basic negotiation; align stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like**
* High conversion of partner\-sourced leads into active implementations.
* Independent end\-to\-end demos for common use cases within three months; independent conversion with minimal support thereafter.
* Positive partner feedback from Google and Meta ecosystems.
* Shorter sales cycles on mid\-market opportunities.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. An AI assistant helps us screen applications against the must\-haves in this description and helps schedule conversations; every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Four to five years in martech, adtech, analytics or similar client\-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of first\-party data, measurement frameworks and attribution.
* Familiarity with conversions APIs, enhanced conversions or server\-side tracking; working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads from a data and signals perspective.
* Comfort with integrations: APIs, CRMs, e\-commerce platforms, event tracking; you think in data flows, identifiers and signal quality.
* Strong communication that turns technical concepts into business value; basic comfort with pricing and proposals.
* Strong comfort with AI tools for content, communication and workflow; disciplined CRM hygiene.


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on GTM, GA4 or MMP experience.
* Experience in a partner\-led sales motion.


**Probably not a fit if**
* Your experience is limited to media buying or campaign execution.
* You prefer roles without client\-facing demos or solution ownership.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.

The role combines discovery, solution shaping, technical demonstrations, proposal development, and customer engagement. * Previous experience in a customer\-facing or cross\-functional technical role such as presales, solutions engineering, technical account management, consulting, or technical delivery.
* Ability to understand and discuss system architecture, software integrations, and data\-flow concepts without necessarily being responsible for hands\-on implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences.

* Nice to have: exposure to DERMS or VPP platforms, energy markets, ISO operations, or utility demand\-response programs.
* Nice to have: previous experience representing a technology organization at conferences, trade shows, or industry events.


**Benefits**
* High\-autonomy and high\-visibility position with direct exposure to customer relationships.
* Opportunity to influence how power\-systems and energy software solutions are positioned in the market.
* Competitive compensation aligned with the seniority and scope of the role.
* Remote working opportunity in India.

* Opportunity to collaborate closely with engineering and leadership teams on complex customer challenges.

 This role is an opportunity to help customers turn complex data challenges into practical, high\-impact analytics solutions. You will implement an enterprise analytics platform against diverse technical and business requirements, while becoming a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams. The position combines hands\-on technical delivery with solution design, customer enablement, and project scoping. You’ll work across data platforms, cloud environments, databases, and analytics use cases. The role involves close collaboration with customers, partners, and cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment. You’ll also contribute to technical documentation and help ensure implementations follow scalable, effective best practices.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Implement the analytics platform according to complex customer requirements and project objectives.
* Develop a strong understanding of platform capabilities, features, and implementation best practices, and apply them across customer use cases.
* Guide customers and colleagues on how to effectively use the platform for different analytics and business scenarios.
* Contribute to defining project scope, technical requirements, and level\-of\-effort estimates for implementation engagements.
* Create detailed technical design documentation covering the architecture, configuration, and implementation approach for delivered solutions.
* Collaborate effectively with customers, partners, and internal teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver successful implementations.
* Communicate project progress, requirements, risks, and technical considerations clearly across stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement by sharing implementation knowledge, technical learnings, and recommended practices with the wider team.
* Report to the Solution Engineering leadership team and contribute to successful delivery across multiple customer engagements.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of professional experience implementing analytics, business intelligence, or related data software products.
* Experience working with at least one major data platform or database, such as Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, or Amazon S3\.
* Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with Linux server administration.
* Practical understanding of data modeling principles and their application to analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based applications and architectures running on Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or AWS.
