aee57fa1.title: Archon Solution Architect
aee57fa1.description:
**Archon Solution Architect**

**OpenText InfoArchive \& Platform 3 Services (Archon)**

**Experience Level: 10\+ Years**

**Role Type: Architect / Technical Lead**

**Position Summary:** We are seeking an experienced architect specializing in OpenText InfoArchive and Platform 3 Services (Archon) to lead the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise information archiving and data retirement solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep archiving platform expertise with strong database/ETL engineering, robust Java development skills, and the leadership ability to guide a technical team toward successful delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and implement end\-to\-end OpenText InfoArchive solutions, including data ingestion pipelines, holdings, SIP generation, retention policies, and content query/retrieval.
* Lead Platform 3 Services (Archon) configuration, integration, and administration across archiving and decommissioning initiatives.
* Define and drive Enterprise Data Retirement (EDR) and legacy application decommissioning strategies and roadmaps.
* Design and optimize database ETL workflows to extract, transform, and load structured/unstructured data from legacy source systems into the archive.
* Develop, review, and maintain Java\-based components, custom transformations, and API integrations supporting the archiving platform.
* Provide technical leadership to a team of engineers — assigning work, conducting design/code reviews, mentoring, and ensuring adherence to architectural standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders, data owners, and compliance teams to translate retention and regulatory requirements into technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues spanning authentication (OTDS), storage/file store provisioning, database schema, and application layers.
* Produce clear architecture documentation, runbooks, and status communications for both technical and executive audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with OpenText InfoArchive (ideally 21\.x/22\.x) and Platform 3 Services (Archon).
* Strong experience designing and building database ETL pipelines using tools such as Informatica, Talend, Pentaho, SSIS, or equivalent.
* Advanced SQL and relational database skills (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server); ability to profile source schemas and validate archived data.
* Solid Java development experience, including REST APIs, Spring/Spring Boot, and integration components.
* Proven experience leading application decommissioning / data retirement programs.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor a technical team and own delivery outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present to technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with OTDS authentication, SIP/SIData configuration, and InfoArchive storage (Store/Space/Holding) architecture.
* Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and containerized deployments.
* Familiarity with scripting (Python, Shell) for automation and data validation.
* Background in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance).
* Relevant certifications (OpenText, AWS Solutions Architect, PMP/SAFe).

**Core Competencies**

* Enterprise archiving \& data retirement strategy
* ETL / data migration engineering
* Java solution development
* Technical team leadership \& mentoring
* Stakeholder communication \& documentation

Pay: ₹150,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Experience:

* Archon: 5 years (Required)
* OpenText InfoArchive (ideally 21\.x/22\.x) : 5 years (Required)
* Platform 3 Services (Archon): 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

d0d91c4c.title: Oracle PaaS Solution Architect
d0d91c4c.description:
**Job Description**
 Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and technical expert on technologies across the marketplace to shape guidance provided to customers. Serves as a go\-to technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across Oracle and non\-Oracle technologies, products, services, and best practices. Leads organization\-wide optimizations (e.g., automation) into solutions and technical delivery in coordination with the customer team. Acts as an internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues and provides proactive and reactive technical assistance in close cooperation with Support and Product Development teams for problem analysis and investigation. Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, configuration, and incident remediation and educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product features, upgrades, and best practices. Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables to help customers with solution implementation. Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test, and maintain. Drives cross\-functional solution alignment with technology strategy and business goals. Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence during presentations for junior engineers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership:**
* Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical expert on technologies across the marketplace (e.g., technical speaking engagements, publications) to shape guidance provided to customers.
* Recognized as a technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across Oracle and non\-Oracle technologies, products, services, and market trends, serving as a go\-to expert for complex or high\-impact scenarios.
* Defines or adjusts strategy for highly complex pre\-sales activities, contributing to long\-term account growth and solution fit.
* Leads organization\-wide and customer fleet\-wide optimizations or efficiency efforts (e.g., automation, streamlined processes, elimination of redundant effort), coordinating with the TAM, ASE engineers and others on the Oracle customer team.
* Works with external partners to ensure appropriate design and implementation of solutions and promote best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.


**Service Delivery:**
* Acts as internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues encountered in the customer's supported environment.
* Provides proactive and reactive remote or onsite technical assistance in close cooperation with Support and Product Development teams, for problem analysis and investigation and providing and verifying workarounds and acting as a field point of contact for various LOBs.
* Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, change management, and incident remediation, identifying key risks and mitigation strategies that may impact project success.
* Analyzes new and highly complex issues encountered by customers by performing thorough technical root cause investigations.
* Reviews themes across lessons learned post\-project and leads changes to improve technology implementation.


**Global Customer Engagement \& Education:**
* Acts as expert technical lead for customers and partners with customer leadership to, ensuring solutions address business needs and drive long\-term business transformation.
* Educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product features, upgrades, and patches, and drives and shapes adoption of best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.
* Provides executive presence for junior team members during customer meetings where technical expertise is required for critical or escalated issues or where expert technical direction is needed for key decisions.
* Uses holistic view of solutions and contextual understanding of customer solutions to influence customer direction.


**Technical Design \& Documentation:**
* Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables, SOPs, and documentation to help customers implement solutions.
* Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test and maintain.
* Oversees how solution designs are developed across programs, ensuring the use of appropriate methodologies and adherence to Oracle and enterprise architectural standards.
* Scopes potential customer requests and clarify value\-add for a service during pre\-sales.
* Defines best practices and provides mentorship to engineers across multiple teams.
* Ensures technical designs are forward\-looking, scalable, and aligned with broader strategic direction.
* Translates market trends into design strategies that prepare the business for future growth.


**Influence \& Collaboration:**
* Drives cross\-functional alignment of internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with technology strategy and business goals, facilitating collaboration across multiple programs and senior stakeholders.
* Identifies opportunities for expanding partnerships and with key contacts across functions and creates opportunities to facilitate networking for lower levels.
* Works with customer senior leadership to influences priorities based on technical vision to support customer's technical roadmap.


**Innovation \& Business Development:**
* Leverages customer insights and partners with product management to ensure alignment with technical ecosystem when driving new service offerings and engagement methods.
* Leverages customer insights to shape new service offerings and engagement methods.
* Leads technical scoping in strategic deals, partnering with sales teams to define the solution approach and ensure business needs are translated into viable technical deliverables.
* Shapes growth opportunities by aligning Oracle solutions with customer roadmaps and business drivers.
* Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence during presentations for junior team members and communicates details on integrated solutions that drive strategy.
* Uses deep technical, functional, and service delivery expertise across technologies to strategically influence customer perception of value.


**Additional Responsibilities (as Needed)**
**Technical Solution Design:**
* Drives technical strategy and architecture across the organization, mentoring technical leaders and ensuring alignment with business goals using broad knowledge across multiple technologies/ services.
* Oversees architectural and solution design reviews across programs, ensuring technical excellence and mentoring senior engineers across technologies and services in scalable design principles.
* Guides teams in applying consistent design practices aligned to current and emerging business needs using expertise across multiple technologies/services.
* Shapes and maintains architectural principles, introducing innovative approaches and evolving design practices to remain competitive in a rapidly changing market.
* Drives high\-level design (HLD) development by introducing new methods across technologies/services, promoting creativity, and ensuring solutions reflect a deep understanding of organizational technical operations.
* Creates and establishes internal policies, processes, and standards for security, scalability, and other product/service fundamentals related to solution delivery across a family of technologies or services at the organization or cross\-organization level.


**Delivery Program Management:**
* Owns the planning, execution, and service value creation of delivery engineering projects across multiple customer accounts within a technical domain.
* Leverages deep project management knowledge to scope delivery engineering projects, design project schedules, and document resource requirements.
* Manages technical delivery along with Technical Leader, coordinating resources and managing projects to drive results and maximize value to customers.
* Proactively partners with customers and other account team members (e.g., TAM, Technical Leader) to understand customers' technical projects, goals, and KPIs, and provide required technical guidance to delivery engineering team.
* Leverages domain expertise to lead escalation calls and assist in managing all aspects of escalations, including situation management and executive communication.
* Oversees the quality and completeness of deliverables across customers.
* Acts as a domain technical expert to represent delivery engineering in sales opportunities with customers.


**Core Responsibilities**
**Collaboration \& Partnership:**
* Influences cross\-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long\-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.


**Continuous Improvement:**
* Drives implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Seeks and integrates diverse feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.


**Planning \& Execution:**
* Manages and provides direction on timelines and budgets for critical high\-impact projects, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.


**Problem Solving:**
* Leads specialized, advanced problem\-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for highly complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data\-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions that prevent future issues.


**Continuous Learning:**
* Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise within a specialty area to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC5
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

0a06dc8e.title: Senior Solution Architect — Sales AI Applications
0a06dc8e.description:
NVIDIA pioneers computer graphics, gaming, AI, and accelerated computing. We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect with full\-stack software engineering experience to join our team and play an important role in developing Sales AI applications. This position offers the opportunity to design, build, and evolve solutions that bring generative AI and intelligent workflows into everyday sales experiences.
   

  

 You will work across the application stack and collaborate with Product, AI and machine learning, Data, Security, Solution Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions used globally.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Collaborate with application teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack solutions for enterprise sales workflows.
* Guide technical solutions across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, data services, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Translate product requirements and business needs into secure, maintainable solutions and intuitive user experiences.
* Integrate generative AI models, AI services, APIs, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows into production applications.
* Design application architectures that support performance, availability, observability, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical design discussions, compare implementation approaches, make informed architecture decisions, and evaluate emerging technologies.
* Improve engineering practices for testing, code quality, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. Investigate complex issues and develop solutions that improve reliability and user experience.
* Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards and collaborative team practices.


**What We Need To See**
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is encouraged.
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating production applications.
* Experience developing full\-stack applications with modern front\-end, back\-end, and web application technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more languages or frameworks, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing APIs, distributed applications, data services, enterprise integrations, scalable cloud applications, databases, and messaging systems.
* Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities through APIs, models, retrieval systems, or AI services.
* Knowledge of software architecture, system design, security, testing, observability, and production operations.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, make informed engineering decisions, communicate with technical and non\-technical teams, and mentor engineers.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience building generative AI applications, including AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, AI productivity tools, Python\-based AI services, large language model APIs, vector databases, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
* Experience combining traditional software systems with AI models and data pipelines and progressing AI capabilities from prototype through production.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, security, or enterprise AI governance.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, microservices, infrastructure as code, DevOps practices, application performance, reliability, scalability, observability, cloud cost efficiency, or globally distributed engineering teams.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative, eager to tackle meaningful business problems, and enjoy having fun, NVIDIA is the perfect company to work for.

49770518.title: Architect - Infra
49770518.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings.  Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. 09887da5.title: Associate Program Manager
09887da5.description:
**Role Overview**
=================

This role combines functional expertise in regulatory tax compliance with strong business analysis and operational leadership. The individual will act as a bridge between client stakeholders, product, and engineering teams, while also managing tax operations to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant deliverables.


The role requires hands\-on involvement in requirement analysis, system validation, reporting accuracy, and operational oversight across compliance processes such as FATCA, CRS, and Chapter 3 withholding and reporting.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Business Analysis and Delivery**
----------------------------------
* **Requirements Gathering \& Documentation**
	+ Conduct detailed requirement gathering sessions with client stakeholders and internal teams.
	+ Undertake system and functional impact, translate business requirements and regulatory tax rules/ updates (Chapter 3, FATCA, CRS) into structured documentation (BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, etc.).
	+ Produce use cases, data flow diagrams, process flow diagrams and sequence diagrams.
	+ Create and maintain documentation for specific client implementation/ integration, API, and product release notes.
* **Developer and Tester Enablement**
	+ Conduct walkthroughs with developers and testers to explain requirements, and regulatory logic in precise technical terms and in simple understandable ways.
	+ Actively participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
* **Test Case Design \& Execution**
	+ Create comprehensive test cases and test scripts covering functional, regression, edge\-case and negative scenarios.
	+ Work closely with QA teams to create/ clarify acceptance criteria.
	+ Lead and manage System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) end\-to\-end, including defect lifecycle management and sign\-off.
* **Report Validation \& Compliance Review**
	+ Validate system\-generated regulatory reports i.e. general compliance/ ad\-hoc report requests from clients and year\-end tax filing outputs (e.g., 1042\-S, 1099, 8805, 8966 FATCA, CRS).
	+ Review reporting logic, data mapping, and output accuracy against applicable regulatory schemas and filing standards.
	+ Validate the XML generated for FATCA and CRS for submission into the government portals and deliver to the client/ client’s auditors.
	+ Lead client data migration as part of the new client onboarding process.
* **Leadership and Backup Coverage**
	+ Act as a Project Manager / Technology Delivery Lead in the absence of the manager, ensuring continuity of delivery and decision\-making
	+ Coordinate with onshore/offshore teams, track progress, and manage priorities across workstreams
	+ Drive status updates, stakeholder communication, and issue escalation as needed

* **Tax Operations Management**
-----------------------------
* **Team Leadership and Oversight**
	+ Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Tax Ops team, providing clear direction, prioritisation, and escalation management.
	+ Assign tasks and allocate resources based on team capacity, skillsets, and urgency.
* **Process Improvement and Automation**
	+ Assess operational workflows to identify inefficiencies and areas for process improvement or automation.
	+ Partner with technology teams to scope and drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
	+ Document updated SOPs and train team members on revised processes.
* **Guidance and Support**
	+ Provide subject matter guidance to team members on new regulatory requirements, withholding obligations, and reporting (general or year\-end) activities.
	+ Act as the first point of contact for complex operational queries.
	+ Train new joiners.
* **General Reporting and Year\-End Reporting Support**
	+ Oversee operational readiness for reporting cycles and contribution/ delivery to year\-end regulatory reporting cycles.
	+ Provide hands\-on support for the preparation and review of year\-end tax reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy across all reportable populations.

* **Product Subject Matter Expertise**
------------------------------------
* **Deep System Knowledge**
	+ Develop and maintain comprehensive, end\-to\-end knowledge of the tax compliance platform, including functional working, data ingestion, processing logic, and output generation.
	+ Serve as the internal SME and go\-to authority on system capabilities, limitations, configuration options, and known behaviours.
* **Report \& Reporting Logic Mastery**
	+ Maintain thorough working knowledge of all reports (general or regulatory year\-end reporting related) generated by the system\- their data sources (high level), business rules, transformation logic, and output formats.
	+ Identify and escalate discrepancies between expected regulatory output and actual system behaviour, partnering with development for resolution.
	+ Contribute to product roadmap discussions by providing informed feedback grounded in regulatory requirements and operational experience.

**Required skills and qualifications**
======================================

* Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst in a software delivery or financial services environment. Candidates with a background in finance, tax, or accounting functions within a technology delivery context.
* Total experience of 13 years, with a minimum of 7/8 years in a Business Analyst role within a finance, banking, or tax\-technology environment.
* Mumbai location is preferred (primary).
* Hands\-on experience in SIT/UAT testing, test case creation, and defect management.
* Experience managing teams or leading operational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly with data validation and reporting.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including working with large datasets, complex formulas, data validation, and reconciliation (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, conditional logic).
* Prior experience or exposure to FATCA, CRS, or Chapter 3 regulations is preferred.
* Experience with regulatory reporting (e.g., 1042\-S, 1099, CRS/FATCA submissions) is an added advantage.
* Candidates without prior tax regulatory experience but with strong analytical and functional skills are encouraged to apply; structured on\-the\-job training will be provided to build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CBAP, ICA, CIPP) are advantageous.

abbcba15.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a seasoned Technical Program Manager who thrives on orchestrating complex, high\-impact initiatives across multiple teams? Do you have a passion for translating strategic vision into flawlessly executed technical programs? Join our Seller Fees Tech organization and lead critical expansion efforts that will shape the 3P Stores business for millions of sellers globally.  

  

The Seller Fees Tech organization forms the foundation of Amazon's marketplace financial ecosystem, responsible for calculating, processing, and managing the complex fee structures that enable sellers to do business across Amazon's global marketplaces. Supporting over 2MM\+ active sellers, our systems handle billions of transactions annually, ensuring accurate and transparent fee calculations, incentive distributions, and financial adjustments for selling partners worldwide. Our work is fundamental to overall seller economics \- we enable sellers to build sustainable businesses through transparent fee structures, provide financial clarity that informs their pricing strategies and inventory decisions, and create incentive mechanisms that reward seller behaviors aligned with customer\-centric goals.  

  

As a TPM III on our Expansions team, you'll spearhead end\-to\-end execution of complex technical initiatives that require coordinating across multiple engineering teams, business units, and stakeholders. In addition, you'll lead the adoption of GenAI technologies to improve team efficiency and delivery capabilities, ensuring our technical solutions scale effectively across Amazon's growing global marketplace portfolio.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on both Amazon's marketplace growth strategy and the success of millions of entrepreneurs worldwide. Your ability to navigate technical complexity, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment will be crucial to our success.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key Responsibilities  

A. Program Leadership \& Execution  

Lead complex cross\-team programs
  

Develop comprehensive program plans with clear milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and resource requirements  

Proactively identify and mitigate risks that could impact program delivery or quality  

Drive execution through effective stakeholder management, clear communication, and disciplined issue resolution  

Define and track program success metrics, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements  

Facilitate decision\-making processes to resolve blockers and maintain program momentum  

B. Technical Leadership  

Partner with engineering leaders to align on technical approaches that balance scalability, performance, and time\-to\-market  

Lead the adoption of GenAI technologies to improve development efficiency and code quality across engineering teams  

Ensure architectural decisions consider cross\-marketplace compatibility and global scalability  

Facilitate technical design reviews and architecture discussions to drive consensus on implementation approaches  

Identify and address technical dependencies across systems and teams  

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define technical requirements that meet business needs  

C. Stakeholder Management  

Build strong relationships with engineering, product, operations, and business teams across the Seller Fees Tech organization  

Communicate program status, risks, and achievements effectively to senior leadership and key stakeholders  

Manage expectations and negotiate trade\-offs when facing competing priorities or resource constraints  

Create visibility into program progress through clear metrics, dashboards, and regular updates  

Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration to ensure alignment on program objectives and approaches

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with Gen\-AI technologies and tools

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

04385f8f.title: SAP Configuration Delivery Lead-Project Manager
04385f8f.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager**
**Job Title:**
 SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide executive\-level delivery leadership for global SAP transformation programs from planning through deployment and steady\-state support.
* Own delivery governance for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, RISE, testing, release management, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across business, functional, technical, application support, infrastructure, and third\-party teams to protect delivery quality and business continuity.


**Key responsibilities include:**
**Project \& Program Management**
* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**
* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.


**Business Process \& Solution Design**
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**
* Be a thought leader on data migration strategy and execution for master and transactional data.
* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**
* Engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.
* Mentor consultants and develop effective project teams through clear direction, knowledge sharing, and delivery discipline.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires sound judgment across delivery scope, schedule, budget, risk, testing, cutover, data migration, integration, and stakeholder decisions. The candidate will evaluate cross\-functional trade\-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and resolve issues in a global, matrixed SAP environment while protecting release quality, service stability, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Strong command of SAP delivery methods, governance routines, risk controls, testing models, release practices, and global rollout execution.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full\-cycle SAP implementations, migrations, production cutovers, and global rollouts.
* Experience leading SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE delivery across testing, release governance, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.
   

  

* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.
* Flexible work arrangements: EY flexible work policies are designed to support balance, trust, and autonomy, subject to business and role requirements.
* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.
* Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential performance\-based incentives.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
